**501748 Senior Mission Systems Engineer**

Work Location: Huntsville, Alabama

Schedule: Full Time

IronMountain Solutions is currently seeking a highly qualified and experienced **Senior Mission Systems Engineer** to support a government customer in the Huntsville, AL area. The ideal candidate will be a self-motivated leader capable of operating with minimal supervision, building strong relationships across multiple project offices, and managing complex technical programs from concept through fielding.

**Education and General Experience:**

* **Possess a Bachelor of Science degree in engineering discipline.**
* Minimum 12 years' experience in a technical field related to Army Aviation.
* Demonstrated experience in senior-level program execution, from concept design to product integration and obtaining Airworthiness Release.
* Extensive background in technical project management, weapons integration, and Launched Effects (LE) integration.
* Expert knowledge of aircraft systems and formal systems engineering processes, including requirement development, analysis, and verification.
* Understanding of aircraft mission systems, including navigation, communication, sensor suites (e.g., EO/IR, Radar), and electronic warfare systems.
* Experience with Modular Open Systems Approaches (MOSA), including standards like Future Airborne Capability Environment (FACE) and Open Mission Systems (OMS).
* Familiarity with military data bus architectures (e.g., MIL-STD-1553) and Ethernet-based data networks.
* Experience working on Army Aviation development programs and supporting government Project Management Offices (PMO) is highly desired. A background in Special Operations Forces Support Activity (SOFSA) is a plus.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills are required to facilitate coordination with government leadership, prime contractors, and cross-functional teams.

**Job Duties:**

* Serve as the Integrated Product Team (IPT) Lead, responsible for the strategic management of development, integration, and sustainment programs.
* Act as the primary technical Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the integration of mission equipment, including conventional weapon systems (e.g., bomb racks, rocket pods, cannons), Launched Effects (LE), and aircraft survivability equipment (e.g., flare dispensers, radar warning).
* Lead coordination efforts between key government stakeholders, including the Army Future Concepts Directorate (FCD), Project Manager Uncrewed Aerial Systems (PM UAS), and other major aviation platform organizations.
* Develop and manage comprehensive program acquisition strategies, program cost and schedule estimates, and program risk assessments and mitigations.
* Oversee the development and execution of all documentation for Contracts Requirements Packages (CRPs), including Statements of Work (SOW), Performance Work Statements (PWS), Contracts Data Requirements Lists (CDRLs), and Independent Government Cost Estimates (IGCEs).
* Serve as the lead technical evaluator for contractor proposals and ensure prime contractor performance meets all technical, schedule, and cost requirements.
* Collaborate with prime contractors, vendors, and government airworthiness and test organizations to define, resource, and execute a clear path to qualification and safety confirmation for new and modified configurations.
* Brief senior government management on the status, progress, and risks of all assigned projects on a regular basis.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use tools or controls; normal physical activity (reach with hands and arms; climb stairs); and communicate effectively with all levels of employees and leadership. The employee must occasionally lift or move office products and supplies, up to 25 pounds.

**Minimum Requirements:**

* Must currently hold a Secret level security clearance; a Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) clearance is desired.
* Must be able to commit to job-related travel (up to 25%).

IronMountain Solutions is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer

jobs.title: Systems Engineer III (Audio/Visual)
jobs.description:
**SYSTEMS ENGINEER III – AV/COLLABORATION ENGINEER**

**Location:** NASA Marshall Space Flight Center, Huntsville AL
  
**Work Arrangement:** 100% On-Site  
**Clearance Requirement:** Public Trust  
**Education:** Bachelor's Degree (Possible waiver if there is enough experience in lieu of degree)

**SUMMARY**

Noetic is seeking a highly skilled **Systems Engineer III – AV/Collaboration Engineer** to design, deploy, integrate, and manage workplace collaboration environments at NASA Marshall Space Flight Center. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with **Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR), Logitech, Crestron, Cisco, and other conferencing technologies**, along with a strong understanding of AV systems, networking, Microsoft 365, and collaboration infrastructure. This role will serve as a technical subject matter expert responsible for maintaining reliable, high-quality collaboration environments, troubleshooting complex AV and connectivity issues, and supporting the deployment and lifecycle management of collaboration technologies across MSFC and other NASA centers as needed.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design, deploy, integrate, and manage physical workplace collaboration environments at NASA MSFC and support collaboration environments across other centers as needed.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR), including Logitech, Crestron, Cisco, and other conferencing technologies.
* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot conferencing systems and peripherals, including displays, cameras, microphones, speakers, and other collaboration hardware.
* Lead physical installation, structural mounting, cable management, and hardware configuration of MTR Windows and Android endpoints.
* Manage and monitor Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro Management Portal, Teams Admin Center, Cisco Control Hub, Crestron XiO Cloud, Logitech Sync, and other approved tools.
* Monitor hardware health, device status, and peripherals to maintain high availability and optimal audio/video quality.
* Plan, test, and deploy software updates, security patches, and OEM firmware upgrades.
* Provide hands-on troubleshooting for complex audio, video, control programming, and connectivity issues.
* Evaluate, select, and standardize Microsoft Teams-certified AV hardware, including microphones, cameras, DSPs, and control panels.
* Configure Teams resource accounts and Exchange integrations.
* Support enterprise and federal Conditional Access policies and network optimization, including Quality of Service (QoS).
* Apply systems engineering concepts to the design, development, integration, and testing of cloud, hardware, software, and system-level requirements.
* Develop integrated system test requirements and strategies and support overall system-level testing.
* Some travel may be required to support installation teams at other centers.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree.
* 3–5+ years of experience in AV engineering, unified communications, or collaboration workspace management.
* Direct, hands-on experience deploying and programming Logitech, Crestron, Cisco, and other conferencing devices.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Teams Rooms architecture across Windows and Android ecosystems.
* Experience with Microsoft Teams Rooms hardware, networking, software, and management tools.
* Understanding of collaboration and conferencing control environments.
* Ability to read high-level wiring diagrams for installation and troubleshooting.
* Understanding of Crestron and AMX control systems, display technologies, and audio/video switching technologies.
* Understanding of AV-over-LAN technologies and audio DSP configuration and gain structure.
* Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, and firewall rules.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 Conditional Access policies.
* Experience managing Teams resource accounts, licenses, and Exchange room calendars.
* Ability to work 100% on-site at NASA MSFC.
* Ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust designation.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Microsoft MS-700 – Managing Microsoft Teams certification or specialized Microsoft Teams Rooms training.
* CTS – Certified Technology Specialist certification.
* CTS-I – Certified Technology Specialist – Installation certification.
* Knowledge of government network and hardware security requirements.
* Experience supporting enterprise or federal collaboration environments.

jobs.description:
**Electrical Engineer II**

*This position must meet Export Control compliance requirements, therefore a “US Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120.15 is required. “US Person” includes US Citizen, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.*

  

Canyon AeroConnect stands as one of the world’s leading suppliers of avionic-standard aircraft communications, navigation and audio/intercom systems. Canyon’s products have been widely adopted and proven in-service across a wide range of civilian, paramilitary and military fixed-wing and rotorcraft applications. Over the years, we’ve become known as the benchmark in aircraft tactical communication and audio equipment for Air Ambulance, Law Enforcement, SAR, EMS, Electronic News Gathering, Military and Marine applications. Products include digital and analog radio/audio management systems, Tac/Com, VHF/UHF radio systems, intercoms, data interface accessories, and aural warning.

  
  

**Role purpose (position scope):**

The Electrical Engineer supports the design, development, integration, verification, qualification, production, and sustaining engineering of airborne communication and control electronics within the Radio Business Unit. The position works cross-functionally with RF, software, systems, mechanical, manufacturing, test, quality, and supply chain teams to deliver reliable, configuration-controlled products and technically sound evidence for customer and regulatory requirements.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and maintain electronic assemblies, schematic designs, circuit interfaces, wiring/interconnects, and supporting engineering drawings for airborne radio and control products.
* Perform circuit-level analysis, component selection, derating, power-budget assessment, signal integrity evaluation, and troubleshooting of analog/digital and power-distribution functions.
* Develop or support engineering requirements, design documentation, interface definitions, test procedures, and requirements-to-verification traceability.
* Plan and execute bench verification and design characterization using oscilloscopes, DMMs, electronic loads, power supplies, spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, and automated test systems as appropriate.
* Investigate anomalies and field/production failures through structured root-cause analysis, controlled experiments, data evaluation, and documented corrective actions.
* Support environmental and EMC qualification activities, including preparation, testing, discrepancy resolution, and objective-evidence packages to applicable program requirements (e.g., DO-160 and other contractual standards).
* Partner with Manufacturing and Test Engineering to improve production testability, work instructions, acceptance criteria, first-pass yield, reliability, and transition of designs into repeatable manufacture.
* Participate in engineering change control, configuration management, supplier technical reviews, obsolescence mitigation, and sustaining-engineering activities.
* Coordinate technical deliverables with internal teams, suppliers, and customers; communicate risks, dependencies, verification status, and recovery actions clearly.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered under company policy.
* Practical experience with electronic hardware design, integration, debugging, and laboratory verification.
* Ability to interpret schematics, assembly drawings, specifications, test data, and component datasheets.
* Working understanding of analog and digital circuits, interfaces, basic RF concepts, power electronics, and PCB manufacturing constraints.
* Strong technical writing, problem-solving, prioritization, and collaboration skills.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with airborne radios, avionics, embedded systems, or safety/mission-critical electronics.
* Familiarity with DO-160, MIL-STD-461, AS9100, IPC workmanship standards, or similar qualification and manufacturing frameworks.
* Experience with Altium, OrCAD, Cadence, or comparable ECAD tools; Jira/SVN or other engineering configuration tools.
* Experience with automated test equipment, Python/LabVIEW or other instrumentation automation, and structured statistical analysis.
* Knowledge of failure analysis, DFMEA/PFMEA, design-for-test, design-for-manufacture, and supplier technical investigations.

  

**Measures of Success**

* Timely completion of assigned design and verification deliverables with traceable evidence.
* Effective closure of technical investigations and reduction in repeat production or field failures.
* Improved test coverage, production yield, and engineering-change execution with controlled documentation.
* Clear communication and proactive resolution of technical risks and cross-functional dependencies.

  

**Role Expectations and Working Conditions**

Collaborates across engineering, manufacturing, test, quality, supply chain, program management, and external technical stakeholders. Work is primarily office/laboratory based with occasional factory-floor activity and potential program-related travel. Must follow site safety, ESD, quality, document-control, and information-security procedures.

### **Overview**

The Georgia Tech Research Institute (GTRI) is the nonprofit, applied research division of the Georgia Institute of Technology (Georgia Tech). Founded in 1934 as the Engineering Experiment Station, GTRI has grown to more than 2,900 employees, supporting eight laboratories in over 20 locations around the country and performing more than $940 million of problem-solving research annually for government and industry. GTRI's renowned researchers combine science, engineering, economics, policy, and technical expertise to solve complex problems for the U.S. federal government, state, and industry.

### **Georgia Tech's Mission and Values**

Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do:

1. Students are our top priority.
  
2. We strive for excellence.
  
3. We thrive on diversity.
  
4. We celebrate collaboration.
  
5. We champion innovation.
  
6. We safeguard freedom of inquiry and expression.
  
7. We nurture the wellbeing of our community.
  
8. We act ethically.

jobs.description:
US > Arizona > Phoenix

  

**Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture.**

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.

**Job Mission**

The Senior Engineer (II), Systems Engineering is a technical leader responsible for the development, integration, qualification, and deployment of advanced sensor technologies across ASM product platforms. This role focuses on transforming sensor data into actionable insights by driving sensor architecture, data acquisition strategies, signal analysis, and data-driven decision-making.

Working closely with Mechanical, Electrical, Firmware, Software, Process, and Manufacturing Engineering teams, this individual will define sensor requirements, integrate sensing technologies into complex equipment, and develop analytical methods that improve process understanding, equipment performance, and product outcomes.

This position requires strong systems thinking, expertise in sensor technologies and data analytics, and the ability to lead multidisciplinary projects from concept through deployment.

**What You Will Be Working On**

**Sensor Systems Leadership**

* Lead the development and integration of advanced sensor technologies for semiconductor manufacturing equipment.

* Define sensor architecture, performance requirements, interfaces, and validation strategies.

* Evaluate and select sensing technologies for process monitoring, equipment health monitoring, and advanced control applications.

* Drive sensor system design reviews focused on performance, scalability, and robustness.

* Identify emerging sensor technologies and assess their applicability to future ASM products.

  

**Sensor Integration & Data Acquisition**

* Lead integration of sensors with hardware, firmware, software, and control systems.

* Develop and implement data acquisition architectures for collecting high-quality sensor data.

* Define calibration, synchronization, and validation methodologies for multi-sensor systems.

* Support integration of optical, thermal, pressure, flow, plasma, gas, vibration, acoustic, and environmental sensors.

* Establish best practices for sensor characterization, performance evaluation, and deployment.

  

**Data Analytics & Insight Generation**

* Develop data analysis methodologies to extract meaningful insights from sensor and equipment datasets.

* Apply statistical analysis, signal processing, and machine learning techniques to identify patterns and correlations.

* Analyze process and equipment data to improve product performance, process understanding, and operational efficiency.

* Develop dashboards, KPIs, and health-monitoring metrics for sensor-enabled systems.

* Generate data-driven recommendations that influence product design and technology roadmaps.

  

**Product Development & Program Leadership**

* Lead sensor technology development projects from concept through qualification and release.

* Define verification and validation plans for sensor-enabled subsystems.

* Drive proof-of-concept studies and technology demonstrations for next-generation sensing solutions.

* Coordinate technical activities across multiple development programs and stakeholders.

* Collaborate with suppliers and technology partners to evaluate and qualify new sensor solutions.

  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Process, Software, Firmware, Electrical, Mechanical, and Product Engineering teams to deploy sensor solutions.

* Work closely with data scientists and software engineers to operationalize sensor data.

* Support customer-facing activities requiring sensor characterization, performance analysis, and technology assessments.

* Present technical findings and recommendations to engineering leadership and business stakeholders.

  

**Mentorship & Technical Leadership**

* Mentor engineers in sensor technologies, systems engineering, and data analytics methodologies.

* Promote best practices for sensor integration, experimental design, and data analysis.

* Lead technical working groups focused on sensor innovation and advanced monitoring capabilities.

* Drive continuous improvement in sensor development processes and analytical workflows.

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* BS in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Physics, Optical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.

* 5+ years of experience in sensor systems, system integration, data acquisition, process diagnostics, or related engineering functions.

**Production Support Electrical Engineer**
==========================================

**Location:** Tucson, AZ (Onsite)  
**Schedule:** 1st Shift | 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM  
**Security Clearance:** Secret  
**Company:** Legion Technical Solutions (LTS)

About the Opportunity

Legion Technical Solutions (LTS) is seeking a talented **Production Support Electrical Engineer** to support a leading defense and aerospace technology organization in Tucson, Arizona.

This is an excellent opportunity for an electrical engineer who enjoys hands-on troubleshooting, solving complex technical challenges, and working directly with manufacturing teams to keep critical hardware production moving forward.

In this role, you'll work with advanced electronic and electromechanical systems, identify and resolve hardware issues, and collaborate with cross-functional engineering and production teams to deliver effective solutions.

We're looking for a proactive problem-solver who can quickly assess technical challenges, develop actionable troubleshooting plans, and take ownership of issues through successful resolution.

What You'll Do

Troubleshoot and resolve electrical hardware issues involving complex circuit card assemblies (CCAs), electronic subsystems, and electromechanical systems.  

Diagnose hardware failures using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, function generators, power supplies, and other electronic test equipment.  
Quickly assess production issues, determine root causes, prioritize corrective actions, and drive solutions to completion.  
Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, design engineering, and supplier teams to resolve technical challenges and minimize production disruptions.  
Interpret electrical schematics, PCB layouts, bills of materials (BOMs), and engineering documentation to support troubleshooting and corrective actions.  
Prepare engineering change documentation, update technical drawings, and present change packages for review and approval.  
Analyze production defects, hardware failures, and yield data to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.  
Coordinate supplier issue resolution, support corrective action initiatives, and assist with technical Statements of Work (SOWs).  
Communicate troubleshooting plans, technical findings, and resolution status to cross-functional stakeholders.  

What You'll Bring

**Required Qualifications**

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related technical discipline, or equivalent qualifications.  

Typically 2–5 years of relevant electrical engineering experience.  
Hands-on experience testing, troubleshooting, or debugging digital, analog, RF, or mixed-signal electronic circuits, complex circuit card assemblies, and/or electromechanical systems.  
Experience using electronic laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, function generators, and power supplies.  
Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, PCB layouts, and bills of materials.  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently investigate and resolve technical issues.  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to collaborate across engineering and manufacturing teams.  
Ability to obtain or maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience supporting electrical engineering activities in a manufacturing or production environment.  

Background in electronic circuit design, electro-optical subsystems, or electronic hardware fabrication and assembly.  
Experience with engineering analysis, simulation, and electronic measurement tools.  
Familiarity with hardware integration, system testing, failure analysis, and root cause corrective action (RCCA).  
Experience preparing engineering change packages and supporting configuration management processes.  
Knowledge of production yield improvement, defect analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies.  
Experience coordinating technical activities with suppliers, manufacturing personnel, and multidisciplinary engineering teams.  
Demonstrated ability to independently manage technical issues from identification through final resolution.  

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?

The ideal candidate is a hands-on electrical engineer who thrives in a fast-paced production environment. You enjoy getting into the details of complex hardware problems, using test equipment to identify failures, and developing practical solutions.

You'll succeed by combining strong technical troubleshooting skills with effective communication, sound judgment, and the ability to take ownership of problems until they're fully resolved.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

Work with sophisticated electronic systems supporting critical aerospace and defense technologies.  

Gain hands-on exposure to complex hardware, manufacturing processes, and multidisciplinary engineering challenges.  
Collaborate with experienced engineers and technical specialists.  
Make a direct impact on production efficiency, hardware reliability, and product quality.  
Enjoy a consistent first-shift schedule in Tucson, Arizona.  

About Legion Technical Solutions

Legion Technical Solutions (LTS) connects talented engineering and technical professionals with challenging opportunities across the aerospace, defense, and advanced technology industries.

We focus on matching skilled professionals with positions where their expertise can make a meaningful impact while supporting their long-term career goals.

Apply Today

If you're an Electrical Engineer with strong hardware troubleshooting skills and a passion for solving complex technical problems, we'd like to hear from you.

**Apply today to explore this opportunity with Legion Technical Solutions.**

jobs.description:
**The Job:**

We are seeking an exceptional and innovative Controls Engineer to design, develop, and implement control systems for our unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). The ideal candidate will have a strong background in control theory and hands-on experience with UAV systems. Experience applying machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) to enhance autonomous navigation, path planning, and flight performance is a distinct advantage.

**What You'll Do:**

* **Flight Control System Design:** Design, implement, and test advanced control algorithms for UAVs to ensure stability, maneuverability, and reliable performance.
* **Modeling and Simulation:** Create and maintain dynamic flight models for various UAV platforms to simulate and validate control strategies.
* **Path Planning and Autonomy:** Integrate path planning algorithms for autonomous navigation, obstacle avoidance, and optimal flight route generation.
* **ML/DL Integration:** Apply machine learning and deep learning techniques to enhance flight control and dynamic flight models.
* **Embedded Systems:** Develop and optimize robust, compute-constrained code for embedded systems, ensuring reliability and real-time performance.
* **Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) Testing:** Conduct comprehensive system testing, including Hardware-in-the-Loop simulations and flight testing, to validate control system performance.
* **Troubleshooting and Optimization:** Analyze flight data to troubleshoot system issues, optimize control parameters, and continuously improve overall performance.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with cross-functional teams, including mechanical, software, and systems engineers, to deliver high-quality and reliable drone solutions.

**What You Bring:**

* **EITHER** PhD & 2+ years of work experience: PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or a related field AND 2+ years of hands-on experience in control system design, modeling, and simulation.
* **OR** Masters & 5-8+ years work experience: Masters in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or a related field AND 5-8+ years of hands-on experience in control system design, modeling, and simulation.
* Strong proficiency in programming languages like C++ and Python.
* Familiarity with embedded systems and real-time operating systems

**Bonus Points For:**

* Hands-on experience with UAVs, autopilots (e.g., PX4, ArduPilot, Betaflight), and sensor integration.
* Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) for robotics or autonomous systems.
* Knowledge of computer vision principles and techniques.
* Familiarity with aviation regulations and safety protocols.

**What We Offer:**

* **Competitive Salary** – Reflective of your skills and experience
* **Equity Compensation** – Be a part-owner in the company's future
* **Comprehensive Health Coverage** – Including medical, dental, and vision plans
* **Health Savings Account (HSA)** – Optional pre-tax savings for medical expenses
* **Unlimited PTO** – Flexible time off to recharge, plus paid company holidays

**About Us**  
Seneca is building cutting-edge drone and sensor technology for wildfire suppression, aiming to eliminate wildfire risk across 500 million acres of high-risk U.S. + allied territory. Backed by top-tier investors, including Convective Capital, Caffeinated Capital, First Round Capital, Slow Ventures, Nextview Ventures, Transition Capital, Bullpen Capital, Stepstone Group, Roar Capital, Offline Ventures, and leaders from Palantir, Google, Meta, and many others. Founded by Stu Landesberg (former Founder & CEO of Grove Collaborative — IPO in 2022 at $1.7B) and fire industry experts, Seneca is a mission-driven company dedicated to climate resilience and fire prevention.

Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G & 6G, ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. The Principal Engineer will lead hardware embedded system development of data center platforms built on Qualcomm SoCs, from test platforms, R&D, accelerator / CPU cards to multi-card server systems and rack-level designs. These platforms serve as production products, reference designs, verification and validation systems, software and firmware development vehicles, and SoC test platforms.

  

The systems are high-power and high-density, with very high-speed interconnects. They include high-bandwidth memory (LPDDR/HBM/DDR5), PCIe Gen5/Gen6 and CXL, high-speed Ethernet scale-out fabrics (400G/800G), 112G+ SerDes, multi-phase power delivery at very high current, advanced thermal solutions including direct liquid cooling, and board management and security subsystems. The role works closely with server ODMs and Qualcomm's SoC, software and systems teams to deliver platforms and sys designs that perform, scale and are reliable in production.

  

* Lead hardware projects and design teams from architecture and requirements phases through design, validation, bring-up, system integration and production.
* Develop and drive advanced hardware design methodologies, design rules, implementation flows, validation strategies and engineering best practices.
* Lead system-level design optimization and resolution of complex electrical, optical, mechanical, compatibility, compliance, manufacturing and cost issues.
* Provide technical leadership for advanced analysis including signal integrity, power integrity, feasibility, characterization and hardware validation.

* Collaborate across diverse cross-functional teams including IC design, software, systems, test, Customer Engineering, manufacturing and operations to deliver high-quality production solutions.
* Coordinate design handoff to ODM and provide support for ODM design and production.
* Serve as a technical authority and mentor, providing design reviews, technical direction and guidance across multiple engineering teams and projects.

* Drive innovation, intellectual property, process improvement and future product capabilities by applying technical expertise
* Define platform architecture for performance, power, density and total cost of ownership, including memory subsystem topology, host and accelerator-to-accelerator interconnect, scale-up and scale-out networking, and power and thermal budgets.
* Lead design of high-current, low-voltage power delivery networks: multi-phase VRs. Drive power integrity analysis from board through package to die.
* Provide technical leadership for signal integrity on 112G/224G SerDes, PCIe Gen5/Gen6, CXL, Ethernet and high-speed memory interfaces, including channel modeling, pre- and post-layout simulation, and correlation with lab measurements.
* Develop and drive advanced hardware design methods, design rules, validation strategies, DFx and RAS (reliability, availability, serviceability) practices suited to 24x7 data center deployment.

**About Harbinger**

Harbinger is an American commercial electric vehicle (EV) company on a mission to transform an industry starving for innovation. Harbinger's best-in-class team of EV, battery, and drivetrain experts have pooled their deep experience to bring a first-of-its-kind EV platform to support the growing demand for medium-duty EVs and Hybrids. Harbinger: Familiar Form, Revolutionary Foundation.

### **Role Overview**

Harbinger is looking for a Controls Engineer to join our Vehicle Controls team and help develop, validate, and debug the control algorithms that run our medium-duty EV and hybrid platforms. Working primarily on supervisory controls (vehicle state management, powertrain and energy management, torque arbitration, and fault handling), you will turn system requirements into production-quality Simulink/Stateflow models, verify them through model-in-the-loop (MIL) testing, and debug them on real vehicles using CAN data. You will also support other control domains as program needs evolve. You will work closely with systems, EE, and vehicle test teams, and your work will directly shape how our vehicles drive, protect themselves, and perform for fleet customers.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and improve control algorithms in MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow, with a primary focus on vehicle supervisory controls (vehicle state machine, charging controls, thermal management, drive modes, torque request and arbitration, energy management, and diagnostics/fault reactions).
* Write, review, and refine software requirements derived from system-level requirements; maintain traceability between requirements, models, and test cases.

jobs.title: Principal Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
*Aerospace is at a turning point — costs are rising, supply chains are strained, and old ways of building can't keep up. At Neon Aero, we're breaking that mold. We move fast, think big, and combine start-up agility with aerospace expertise to design, build, and scale aircraft in ways the industry has never seen. Our team leverages automation, AI-driven tools, and a fully connected digital backbone to accelerate innovation and reduce barriers to production.*

*Here, you won't just take a job — you'll help reinvent how the world flies. If you're ready to solve complex problems, push technology further, and work alongside some of the brightest minds in aerospace, this is your chance to make a real impact.*

We are seeking a Principal Electrical Engineer to provide technical leadership in the architecture, design, and qualification of high-integrity electronic control systems across Neon's product portfolio.

This role is focused on the controller and system-electronics side of the architecture: command/monitor architecture, flight control computers and LRUs, embedded compute, sensing, communications, fault detection, redundancy, and the electrical interfaces that tie complex products together. It is complementary to our Principal Engineer – High Voltage Power Electronics role, which owns high-voltage motor-drive and power-stage design.

This is a deeply hands-on individual contributor role. You will develop system architectures, block diagrams, schematics, interface definitions, safety concepts, and the analysis behind them. You will work directly with embedded software, motor control, systems, mechanical, power electronics, test, manufacturing, and certification teams to bring high-reliability electronic systems from concept through qualification and production.

This role does not require direct people management, but it requires principal-level technical leadership, mentoring, and ownership of difficult cross-functional decisions.

**Why This Role Matters**

* Own electrical system architecture for high-integrity controller electronics, FCCs, LRUs, actuator controllers, avionics/compute platforms, sensing systems, and related embedded hardware.
* Architect command/monitor, active-active, simplex, duplex, or other redundant control architectures based on system safety, integrity, availability, and cost requirements.
* Define partitioning between command processors, monitoring processors, motor-control electronics, power electronics, sensors, communications, and vehicle-level interfaces.
* Translate system requirements and safety objectives into practical electronic architectures, hardware requirements, interface definitions, and verification strategies.
* Select microcontrollers, processors, FPGAs, memories, communication devices, supervisors, watchdogs, isolation components, and sensor interfaces appropriate for high-reliability applications.
* Design and review embedded digital, analog, and mixed-signal electronics, including low-voltage power supplies, power sequencing, reset architecture, discrete I/O, signal conditioning, protection, and health monitoring.
* Architect fault detection, fault containment, redundancy management, cross-monitoring, heartbeat, synchronization, and safe-state mechanisms.
* Define communication architecture and physical layers for interfaces such as CAN / CAN FD, ARINC 825, ARINC 429, Ethernet, RS-422/485, SPI, and similar embedded or aerospace buses.
* Own electrical interface definitions and collaborate with systems and software teams on ICDs, timing assumptions, diagnostic coverage, degraded modes, and hardware/software partitioning.
* Establish grounding, shielding, isolation, EMI/EMC, signal-integrity, and power-integrity approaches across boards, harnesses, sensors, and enclosures.
* Lead schematic development and critical PCB design reviews using Altium or equivalent ECAD tools.
* Personally perform or direct worst-case circuit analysis, tolerance analysis, derating, signal-integrity analysis, power-budget analysis, and fault analysis.
* Lead board bring-up, system integration, lab debugging, and root-cause investigations for issues spanning hardware, firmware, software, sensors, communications, and power electronics.
* Define hardware verification strategies and support qualification testing for environmental, EMC, electrical power, and fault conditions.
* Support certification-oriented development including requirements traceability, design assurance, configuration control, verification evidence, and hardware change management.
* Drive DFM, DFT, DFA, production test strategy, and manufacturing readiness for controller electronics and LRUs.
* Mentor electrical engineers through architecture reviews, schematic reviews, design analysis, bring-up, and debugging while remaining deeply hands-on.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
* 12+ years of experience developing and shipping complex electronic systems.
* Demonstrated ownership of system-level electrical architecture for embedded control, avionics, industrial control, automotive, robotics, medical, aerospace, or similarly high-reliability products.
* Deep hands-on experience with embedded digital and mixed-signal hardware, including microcontroller-based systems, sensing, communications, and board-level power architecture.
* Strong proficiency with schematic capture and PCB design using Altium or equivalent ECAD tools.
* Strong understanding of processor selection, watchdog and reset architecture, communication interfaces, sensor interfacing, low-voltage power conversion, grounding, isolation, and EMI/EMC.
* Experience designing fault-tolerant or redundant electronic architectures and reasoning about failure detection, fault containment, and safe-state behavior.
* Experience bringing electronic assemblies from concept through prototype, qualification, industrialization, and production.
*

jobs.title: Mechatronics Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Astera**
----------------

Astera Institute is a private foundation supporting ambitious work in science and technology through grants, investments, and in-house research. Its research programs combine the pace and autonomy of a startup with the freedom to pursue difficult scientific questions. Learn more about Astera’s mission at astera.org/vision.

**About the Robotics Lab**
--------------------------

We are building a frontier robotics lab at Astera Institute. We believe neuroscience and AI will converge in embodied intelligence: animals and robots face shared challenges of perceiving their surroundings, navigating, manipulating objects, and using memory and reasoning to accomplish tasks in the physical world. Robotics provides a powerful testbed for investigating how biological neural circuits solve these challenges and for developing AI systems that turn perception, learning, and cognition into effective action.

Our strategy starts with making robots useful, while developing a mechanistic understanding of how neural circuits can generate intelligent behavior. We aim to continually expand the repertoire of behaviors a robot can perform reliably in real environments, while improving its ability to learn new skills, adapt to changing conditions, and recover from failure. These practical capabilities provide both measurable outcomes and a foundation for investigating deeper principles of intelligence.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

We are looking for a hands-on mechatronics engineer to design and build the mechanisms, electronics, and sensing systems our robots use to interact with the world. You will take hardware from concept and CAD through fabrication, board bring-up, integration, and testing on physical robots.

Based in our Robotics Lab in Emeryville, California, you will work closely with learning and control researchers on manipulators, dexterous hands, and humanoids. The role combines mechanical and electrical engineering with careful physical experimentation: understanding how a design behaves under load, finding the source of a failure, and improving the hardware.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* **Design and build robot mechanisms.** Design mechanisms, end-effectors, arm–hand interfaces, and experimental fixtures; create CAD assemblies, fabrication drawings, and working prototypes.
* **Develop robot electronics.** Design and bring up PCBs for sensing, embedded interfaces, and power distribution, including component selection, schematic capture, layout, and board debugging.
* **Integrate actuation and sensing.** Integrate motors, drives, encoders, force/torque sensors, and tactile sensors with embedded firmware and robot control systems.
* **Characterize and troubleshoot hardware.** Measure and troubleshoot backlash, compliance, friction, drift, latency, thermal behavior, and other effects that influence robot motion and manipulation.
* **Collaborate on robot design.** Work with learning and control researchers to improve geometry, actuation, and sensor placement based on experiments with real robots.
* **Make hardware reproducible and maintainable.** Build repeatable bench and robot tests, document design decisions, and maintain the CAD, PCB, firmware, and assembly files needed to reproduce and service the hardware.
* **Explore AI-assisted engineering.** Explore AI-assisted CAD scripting, firmware development, and test automation, with engineering review and physical validation.

**Desired Qualifications**
--------------------------

* **Electromechanical systems experience.** Experience delivering complete electromechanical systems, with substantial personal responsibility for design, integration, and debugging.
* **Mechanical design and prototyping.** Strong CAD and mechanical design skills, including tolerancing, fabrication, assembly, and hands-on prototyping.
* **PCB design and bring-up.** Hands-on PCB experience from schematic capture and layout through board bring-up and troubleshooting.
* **Actuation and electronics.** Practical knowledge of motors, encoders, sensor electronics, power distribution, and embedded interfaces.
* **Programming and firmware.** Python, C/C++, or microcontroller programming skills for hardware integration, testing, and data collection.
* **Experimental judgment and collaboration.** A careful, measurement-driven approach to debugging and the ability to collaborate across hardware, controls, and machine learning.
* **Robotics hardware experience.** Robot manipulators, dexterous hands, compliant mechanisms, or contact-rich manipulation. Helpful, but not required.
* **Sensing and test experience.** Force/torque or tactile sensing, actuator characterization, and instrumented test fixtures. Helpful, but not required.
* **Hardware and learning integration.** Hardware iteration informed by control or learning experiments, and AI-assisted engineering workflows. Helpful, but not required.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

Shape the physical systems through which robots learn and interact with the world. Your work will connect mechanical design, electronics, and sensing directly to the capabilities of manipulators, dexterous hands, and humanoids.

You will work closely with learning and control researchers, using real robot experiments to inform hardware decisions. This is an opportunity to build complete systems and explore how the robot’s body and its intelligence can be developed together.

Compensation Range: $180K - $280K

jobs.description:
**Electrical Engineer II: Job Posting**

RESOLVEM Inc. | Irvine, CA / Carlsbad, CA (On-site) | Full-time | Mid-level

**Apply here directly: https://resolvem.com/careers*****(****Do not apply via indeed****)***

**About the job**

At RESOLVEM Inc., you'll work across multiple medical device clients and product types, which means you'll accumulate range that engineers at a single-product company simply don't get. You'll take designs into actual field operation of medical line test equipment and medical products, drive root cause investigations when things fail, and grow into the engineer customers ask for by name.

**Why RESOLVEM?**

We're an engineering services firm specializing in R&D design support of new products and transferring product designs to design control and manufacturing. We help medical device companies bring their designs under design control, prepare them for mass manufacturing, and support their pilot manufacturing and transition to commercial-scale production. Because we work across multiple clients and products, you won't spend years on one subsystem. You'll build breadth and depth, fast, and you'll be trusted with real ownership from day one.

**What you'll do**

We'll be straight with you: this is regulated-industry work, and a real share of it is documentation. In medical devices paperwork is part of the product. An undocumented change is an unapproved change that could harm a patient. If that sounds like a chore rather than a craft, this isn't the right role. If you want to be an engineer whose design record holds up under an audit, read on.

Also, a board that works on the bench is not good enough. Our products are electromechanical systems, and you'll own how your design behaves inside the enclosure, on the harness, and inside the rest of the system. You will need to understand mechanical concepts, bills of materials, and how the electrical fits into a wider system.

* **Keep the design record airtight.** You'll author and process Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) on behalf of customers, redline drawings and specifications, compare design revisions, maintain BOMs, purchasing specifications, and obsolescence plans, route changes through approval, and keep the Design History File current and traceable.
* **Own electrical designs.** Lead schematic capture and PCB layout for analog, digital, power, and mixed-signal circuits, including sensor interfaces and microcontroller-based subsystems. Drive component selection, stack-up and layout strategy, signal integrity and power integrity considerations, and design-for-manufacturability/testability (DFM/DFT). Validate with LTspice/PSpice simulation before committing to hardware.
* **Take it from bring-up to production.** Own board bring-up, debug, and characterization. Build custom benchtop test equipment and fixtures, and automate test and data acquisition with Python, MATLAB, or LabVIEW. Support design transfer, pilot builds, and the handoff to contract manufacturers.
* **Lead investigations.** Drive electrical failure analysis and root cause analysis on complex issues. Author investigation reports, propose and verify corrective actions, and present findings to internal teams and customers.
* **Work fluently in the regulated world.** Execute within a certified quality management system (ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR 820) and design control processes. Own Design History File (DHF) deliverables and requirements traceability for your subsystems. Apply ISO 14971 risk management (DFMEA, hazard analysis), support IEC 62304 software lifecycle activities, and lead EMI/EMC design and pre-compliance testing toward IEC 60601-1-2 and IEC 60601-1 certification.
* **Own verification and validation.** Define V&V strategy for your subsystems; author and execute protocols and reports; support test method validation (TMV), process development, inspection criteria, statistical data analysis, and equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ).
* **Support firmware and system integration.** Develop or guide firmware for microcontroller-based designs using C/C++ and protocols such as I2C, SPI, and UART, and integrate electrical subsystems with mechanical, software, and systems engineering.
* **Raise the team.** Mentor interns and Electrical Engineer I staff, review their work, and serve as a technical point of contact for customers and contract manufacturers on assigned projects.

**Apply here directly: https://resolvem.com/careers**

**Do not apply via LinkedIn EZApply**

**You bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university
* Minimum of 3-5 years of hands-on experience in schematic capture and PCB design, with demonstrated ownership of boards from concept through fabrication and bring-up
* Working understanding of mechanical and electromechanical systems: enclosures, connectors and cable harnesses, sensors, and thermal and vibration considerations, including the ability to read a mechanical drawing, reason about how a board fits and performs inside a real assembly, and work through fit, tolerance, grounding, and serviceability questions with mechanical engineers
* Proficiency with PCB design software (Altium Designer preferred; OrCAD, PADS, or KiCad acceptable) and circuit simulation tools (LTspice, PSpice, or equivalent)
* Strong benchtop skills: oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, power meters, DMMs, and programmable supplies/loads
* Solid grounding in analog and digital circuit design and troubleshooting, including power supplies, signal conditioning, and noise mitigation
* Demonstrated experience leading electrical failure analysis and root cause investigations, including written reports
* Proficiency in at least one of MATLAB, Python, or C/C++
* Strong written and verbal technical communication; comfortable presenting in design reviews and to customers
* Ability to work independently on moderately complex projects and to collaborate across disciplines

jobs.description:
**About IonQ:**  
  
IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  
  
**About Vector Atomic:**

Vector Atomic, an IonQ company, is building quantum technology to transform navigation, timing, geophysical exploration, and telecommunications. Our team of engineers, scientists, software developers, and operations professionals works together to solve complex challenges and turn bold ideas into real-world solutions. We value collaboration, curiosity, and diverse perspectives, and we give every team member the opportunity to make an immediate impact while growing their skills. If you're excited to work on breakthrough technology in a fast-paced, hands-on environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Vector Atomic is hiring **electrical engineers** to build ultraprecise quantum devices for applications that include autonomous/GPS-free navigation, high-bandwidth satellite communications, and geophysical exploration. This hands-on role requires strong electronic design skills with emphasis on analog and mixed-signal circuits. We are seeking strong individual contributors who can take ownership of their work while supporting overall team goals. Vector Atomic produces a large volume of custom PCBAs for both manufacturing and R&D projects.

**Location: This role is based onsite at our office in Pleasanton, CA (Bay Area)**

* Work with a cross-functional team of physicists, electronics engineers, firmware programmers and optical engineers to create next-generation quantum instruments.
* Design, implement and verify analog and mixed signal circuits for precision INS instruments. This work requires an understanding of electronic noise sources, measurement techniques and mitigation strategies. New hires will need to have a solid understanding of these principles and the ability to learn quickly and solve design challenges.
* Develop schematics in Altium. Apply layout techniques to improve signal integrity.
* Select parts and work with purchasing to procure, fabricate and assemble PCBAs.
* Assist with board “bring-up” and debugging. Use laboratory test equipment such as scopes, signal generators and spectrum analyzers to test and validate your designs.
* Document results and create test procedures to collaborate with software engineers and provide support and technical guidance as they program and interact with your circuits.
* Contribute to our goals of continuous improvement by documenting issues, rework and feature requests using project tracking tools.

**What We're Looking For**

* BSEE/MSEE Degree with substantial course/lab/intern work in analog circuit design. Other technical degrees will be considered, with 2+ years of directly relevant experience.
* To comply with the US export control laws, Vector Atomic employees must be U.S. citizens (born or naturalized), lawful U.S. permanent residents (i.e. green card holders), and certain categories of refugees, and asylees.
* Must be comfortable working in a laboratory environment.
* Ability to communicate effectively with coworkers and collaborators, both written and verbal.

**Required expertise:**

* Experience using Altium design tools to create schematics, BOMS and layouts for complex PCBAs. Must be able and willing to perform placement and routing in Altium to meet complex performance requirements.
* Expertise with analog and mixed-signal circuit design.
* Training/expertise with POL power supply circuit design.
* Simulation of circuits using Spice.
* Laboratory test and measurement equipment including oscilloscopes, power supplies, function generators and DVMs.

**Nice-to-have expertise:**

* Design training/expertise with EDA tools for signal integrity
* Experience designing boards with Microcontrollers and FPGAs
* Previous expertise with low-power design techniques and power supply design is a plus.
Experience writing test code for scripting languages such as Python or TCL to control laboratory equipment.  

  
  
**Benefits**

Vector Atomic values teamwork, open and honest discourse, and work-life balance. We offer competitive compensation and benefits including:

* Platinum-level family health coverage (medical, dental, vision)
* Health and dependent care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)

jobs.description:
**Who we are**

Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We're changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don't just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

  

**What you'll do**

  

* Lead electrical system design and analysis — power distribution, service entrance design, panel/switchgear sizing, lighting, and emergency/standby power — for new and retrofit facilities across Atoms' portfolio.
* Prepare electrical calculations, drawings, and specifications for permit submittal across multiple jurisdictions.
* Design power distribution and charging circuits for EV/AV charging and support infrastructure, including coordinating transformer and service upgrades.
* Partner with utility providers to secure power availability, service upgrades, and timely energization for new sites.
* Partner with Structural, Building Design, Civil, and MEP consultant teams to resolve system conflicts and keep designs constructible and cost-effective.
* Review and respond to plan check comments from Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs) and utility providers to keep permitting and energization on schedule.
* Evaluate vendor and manufacturer electrical equipment submittals (switchgear, EV charging hardware, backup power systems) for code compliance and site suitability.
* Support construction administration, including RFIs, submittal review, and field observation for electrical systems.
* Build and refine standardized electrical details and design templates that can be reused across Atoms' different business lines to support rapid, repeatable deployment.

  

**What we're looking for**

* 7–10 years of electrical engineering experience, including design for commercial, industrial, or high-power facilities
* Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred; ability to obtain additional state licensure/reciprocity as needed
* Demonstrated experience with power distribution, service entrance, and panel/switchgear design
* Working knowledge of NEC, NFPA 70/70E, and local utility interconnection requirements
* Experience preparing permit-ready electrical drawings and independently managing AHJ and utility plan review/energization cycles

  

**Why join us**

At Atoms, you'll work on one of the defining challenges of our time—bringing automation into the physical world to drive real, lasting impact. We exist to uncover valuable unknown truths and turn them into progress, which means constantly pushing beyond what's known and building what doesn't yet exist. The work is ambitious and often challenging, but it's grounded in a shared sense of purpose and a team committed to seeing it through together. Our work only matters if it serves others, and we know that meaningful progress depends on the trust of the people we serve and the strength of our team—so we invest in both, creating an environment where you can do your best work and grow.

  

**What else you need to know**

This role is based in our San Francisco office. Atoms is a company driven by invention and continuous change - we are constantly reimagining our industries, building new products, and refining how we operate. We do our best work together. That's why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

### **Overview**

The Senior Sustaining Controls Engineer will play a crucial role in the success of our product automatically and reliably fulfilling customers’ electricity demand. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to diagnose and resolve issues, differentiate between mechanical, electrical, and software-related problems, and document solutions to increase product reliability and reduce maintenance needs. This position is ideal for a multidisciplinary engineer who enjoys working on complex systems and has a keen eye for detail.  
  
In this role, you will act as an electromechanical generalist, bridging the gap between hardware and software across our linear generator fleet, lab operations, and manufacturing processes. Following our rapid transition from R&D to full production, you will take a structured, methodical approach to untangling complex legacy issues and clearing the issue backlog. Applying a strong foundation in physics and systems engineering, you will trace root causes across C++ software, electrical circuits, and mechanical components, using these insights to develop targeted sustaining features that improve long-term product stability and fleet performance.

### **Responsibilities**

* Manage, document, and resolve fleet issues ensuring clear communication and follow-up on resolutions and improving the process
* Diagnose root causes of system issues, distinguishing between mechanical, electrical, and software-related problems
* Categorize, systematize, and address gaps in automated system behavior
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to provide technical support and enhance system behavior
* Debug and troubleshoot existing control algorithms to improve system performance and reliability
* Analyze and understand C++ code to interpret behavior
* Implement fixes to field issues in C++ code, and test them in simulation and laboratory environments
* Adjust feature designs to address field issues
* Use Python for data analysis, scripting, and system diagnostics
* Tune control gains and calibrate systems, documenting the process for future reference
* Identify and address gaps in system performance, ensuring continuous improvement
* Support reliability and manufacturing testing, contributing to the system's life cycle maintenance

### **Qualifications**

* Experience in successful root cause analysis of complex software-mechatronic systems
* Driven and self-directed systems-thinker responsible for creating or improving effective sustaining engineering processes
* Excellent communicator with demonstrated collaboration across multidisciplinary teams
* Degree in mechanical or electrical engineering with controls focus
  + Senior level: BS and six years or MS and five years

* Collaborate with RF, systems, mechanical, software, and manufacturing engineers to integrate electronics into complete antenna systems.
* Support design verification, reliability testing, and the transition of products from prototype to production.

* Experience with schematic capture and PCB layout using Altium, OrCAD, Allegro, or similar tools.
* Working knowledge of analog, digital, RF, or power electronics, with hands-on experience in at least one of these areas.
* Familiarity with signal integrity, power integrity, transmission lines, and basic PCB design principles.
* Hands-on experience with electronic circuit testing, debugging, and laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, multimeters, and spectrum analyzers.
* Basic understanding of PCB fabrication, assembly, and design for manufacturability (DFM).
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work collaboratively across engineering disciplines.

### **Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field.
* Master’s degree is a plus.

### **What Makes You Stand Out**

* Experience designing and laying out high-density PCBs, including HDI technology and fine-pitch BGA components.
* Familiarity with RF design principles, transmission lines, impedance matching, and RF PCB layout.
* Experience with high-speed digital interfaces, signal integrity, or power management circuitry.
* Hands-on experience testing RF systems, active antenna modules, or phased arrays.
* Familiarity with PCB manufacturing, DFM/DFT, and transitioning electronics from prototype to production.
* Experience with GNSS/INS systems, including antennas and associated electronics.
* Experience developing electronics for high-reliability applications, including aerospace, aviation, or automotive systems.

jobs.title: Staff Instrumentation and Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Valar Atomics**

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

**The Team**

You will be joining Valar Atomics' I&C and Controls Engineering team within the Fuel Manufacturing group. I&C Engineers at Valar own the full controls stack — from PLC logic and batch sequences at the field level to SCADA displays, historian data infrastructure, and enterprise integration at the supervisory level. You will work alongside process, electrical, and nuclear safety engineers in a hands-on environment where the quality of your control system engineering directly supports production reliability and nuclear safety. The team values technical depth, disciplined documentation, and a safety-first culture.

**The Role**

Valar Atomics is seeking a Staff Instrumentation and Controls (I&C) Engineer to design, develop, commission, and maintain control systems for nuclear fuel manufacturing facilities. The role spans the full controls stack — PLC and DCS programming, SCADA and HMI development, ISA-88 batch control, safety instrumented systems, historian and enterprise integration, and field commissioning — with senior responsibility for technical leadership of complex projects, contractor oversight, and mentorship of junior engineers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain PLC and DCS programs using platforms such as Rockwell ControlLogix/CompactLogix, Siemens S7/TIA Portal, Emerson, or equivalent; program in ladder logic, function block, structured text, and sequential function chart per IEC 61131-3.
* Develop and configure SCADA applications on platforms such as Ignition, Rockwell FactoryTalk, Wonderware AVEVA System Platform, Siemens WinCC, or equivalent; build and maintain tag databases, communication drivers, scripting, and alarm configuration.
* Design HMI displays at both the local panel level (Rockwell PanelView, WinCC, or equivalent) and the supervisory SCADA level in accordance with ISA-101 and High-Performance HMI (HPHMI) principles.
* Develop batch control sequences in accordance with ISA-88; configure phase logic, unit procedures, and recipe management; monitor batch execution, unit status, and recipe progress at the supervisory layer.
* Configure and manage alarm systems to ISA-18.2 including setpoints, priorities, suppression logic, and alarm KPI monitoring.
* Configure and commission safety instrumented functions (SIFs) on SIS platforms (Rockwell GuardLogix, Siemens F-CPU, Triconex, or equivalent) in accordance with IEC 61511.
* Configure plant historian systems (OSIsoft PI / AVEVA PI, Ignition Historian, Rockwell FactoryTalk Historian, or equivalent); build process data dashboards and reports; support ISA-95 enterprise-control integration including data exchange interfaces between control systems and MES, ERP, or LIMS.
* Tune PID and advanced regulatory control loops; commission instrumentation including flow, pressure, temperature, and level devices; support loop calibration and documentation.
* Own instrument engineering scope including sizing and specification of field devices (transmitters, control valves, flow elements), instrument index and hook-up drawing development, and hazardous area classification for new and modified installations; review instrument specifications prepared by junior engineers and contractors.
* Implement and configure industrial communication protocols (OPC-UA, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, Modbus TCP/RTU, DeviceNet); configure interfaces between PLCs, SCADA, historian, and third-party systems.
* Support OT network cybersecurity hardening in accordance with IEC 62443 or NIST SP 800-82.
* Prepare and execute control system FAT, SAT, and commissioning plans; perform loop checks, instrument calibration verification, interlock functional testing, and regulatory control loop tuning; maintain engineering documentation including functional specifications, control narratives, I/O lists, cause-and-effect matrices, tag lists, and as-built records.
* Diagnose and resolve control system faults including PLC/SCADA communication failures, I/O faults, loop deviations, and software defects; perform root cause analysis and document corrective actions.
* Provide technical direction to contractors and consultants on I&C scope; review and redline control system deliverables to ensure compliance with project standards and nuclear quality requirements.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronic, Computer, or Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 8+ years of I&C or controls engineering experience in process industries, with demonstrated ownership of complex control system projects from design through commissioning.
* Hands-on PLC programming experience with at least one major platform (Rockwell, Siemens, Emerson, or equivalent) using IEC 61131-3 languages.
* Experience developing or maintaining SCADA applications on at least one major platform (Ignition, FactoryTalk, AVEVA, WinCC, or equivalent).
* Experience developing batch control sequences in accordance with ISA-88.
* Familiarity with ISA-95 enterprise-control integration concepts.
* Experience commissioning instrumentation and tuning regulatory control loops.
* Working knowledge of OPC-UA, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, or Modbus communication protocols.
* Ability to read and interpret P&IDs, electrical drawings, and instrument data sheets.

This experienced person will utilize their professional background to provide project management and design engineering on winery, custom residential, restaurants, apartment buildings and other commercial building type projects.

As an Electrical Project Manager at Summit, you will serve as the firm’s direct contact with the client and will be responsible for developing and maintaining positive relationships with clients. You will be responsible for design team leadership, internal project organization, preparing project proposals, design engineering, scheduling and budgeting, as well as business development and generating new work for the firm. The job requires getting things done quickly, handling a variety of activities, and effectively delegating to others. Being able to purposely drive toward results while problem-solving and engaging the commitment of others is essential.

**Salary Range:** $130,000 to $180,000 annually (range includes PM to Sr. PM level)

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

In addition to duties and responsibilities of Project Engineer:

* Responsible for preparation of project proposals.
* Establishes direction of work to be performed and holds staff accountable for executing on schedule and on budget.
* Prepares project specifications including conditions of contract and General Conditions.
* Performs and/or checks work performed by other staff.

* Responsible for meeting project budget and schedule objectives and provides input to project team and Principal in Charge regarding status of project and budget. Takes action to seek approval for additional services prior to beginning work.
* Performs regular operational tasks that support the overall health of the firm and inform the management team of firm performance (i.e., invoicing, backlog, contract management).
* Provides mentoring and training for staff in Summit systems. Provides training or serves as resource to staff regarding engineering design principles and concepts and/or problem resolution.
* Provides input to the management team regarding staff performance reviews and training needs.
* Coordinates in-house and/or external consultant-based design teams as required for the successful completion of the work.
* Effectively manages several projects at one time.
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned by supervisor.

**Qualifications/Skills:**

* Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering or Architectural Engineering, with a concentration in power distribution or lighting design.
* Registered Professional Electrical Engineer.
* Minimum five years of related project management and engineering experience.
* Demonstrates a proficient knowledge of AutoCAD, Bluebeam Civil 3D, or Revit.
* Exhibits strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficient with use of computers including spreadsheets, word processing, and engineering software and ability to prepare electronic design documents.
* Ability to oversee the work of others and delegate work effectively.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and budgets, and meet project deadlines.
* Ability to coordinate in-house and/or external consultant-based design teams.
* Experience in business development with proven expertise in relationship building.
* Technical competency in design and engineering for the following technical areas:

* Emergency power distribution systems
* Lighting design

* Title 24 Lighting

* We do not hold a visa sponsorship license and are therefore unable to offer sponsorship now or in the future.

**Driving Requirement**

This position requires regular travel to attend site visits using the Company vehicles. Employees must be able to independently, reliably, and timely transport themselves, necessary tools, equipment, and materials to and between assigned job sites as required. Because of the nature of the work, use of rideshare services, public transportation, or other third-party transportation arrangements does not satisfy this job requirement.
