Senior Systems Engineer - Electronic Warfare

We are seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to help develop and assess electronic warfare (EW) systems and concepts supporting naval aviation. You’ll work with government and contractor engineers to turn operational needs into system requirements, evaluate design approaches, and support the integration and testing of EW prototypes and production systems.

This role works across software, FPGA, hardware, RF and antenna, mechanical, and systems engineering. Experience in electronic warfare is valuable, and candidates with related backgrounds in radar, RF, signal processing, or airborne systems may also be a strong fit.

**Essential Job Functions:**

Analyze system and subsystem components and develop implementation strategies for EW systems.

Translate operational needs and analysis results into clear system requirements.

Support system design, integration, testing, and evaluation.

Develop or use models and simulations to assess system performance and support trade studies.

Analyze areas such as sensor behavior, signal processing, detection, tracking, and discrimination.

Coordinate technical analyses with engineering leads, program leadership, government personnel, and partner vendors.

Document results in technical reports and briefings for customers and stakeholders.

**Required Skills:**

Due to the sensitivity of customer related requirements, U.S. citizenship is required.

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, mathematics, physics, or a related technical field with 10 plus years of experience.

Must be able to obtain and maintain a secret clearance throughout the duration of employment.

10 or more years of relevant engineering experience with depth in systems engineering, RF engineering, radar, electronic warfare, signal processing, or a closely related discipline. Senior level experience is expected; Equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered.

Experience contributing to technical analysis, system design, requirements development, modeling, integration, or test.

Ability to learn new physical and mathematical concepts and apply them to engineering problems.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a multidisciplinary team.

**Desired Skills:**

Experience with electronic warfare, including electronic attack, electronic protection, or related mission systems.

Background in radar sensing, radar scheduling, signal processing, detection, tracking, or target discrimination.

Experience developing or using MATLAB models and simulations. Experience with other modeling or analysis tools is also relevant.

Experience with airborne systems or defense system development.

A master’s or doctoral degree in engineering, mathematics, physics, or a related technical field.

Experience leading small technical teams or coordinating complex analysis efforts.

jobs.title: Senior Power Systems Engineer, Lunar
jobs.description:
Vast is developing next-generation **space stations and space infrastructure** using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo's 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world's first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced **Vast Satellite**, a high-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.

Headquartered in **Long Beach, California**, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America's next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is looking for a **Senior Power Systems Engineer, Lunar**, reporting to the **Senior Vice President, Lunar Programs,** to support the development of the systems that will be required for Vast's Lunar ecosystem. Our team is applying the technology, infrastructure, and knowledge built across our Haven Demo, Haven-1, Haven Station, and Vast Satellite programs to a new frontier: the Moon. Our Lunar program isn't starting from scratch, giving this founding team an extraordinary running start to help shape humanity's next era of lunar exploration from day one.

This will be a **full-time, exempt** position located in our **Long Beach** location.

**Responsibilities:**

* End-to-end ownership of power system architecture, electronics specification, simulation, schematic capture, PCB design, mechanical packaging design, board-level bring-up and validation, environmental qualification, and integrated system-level validation
* Define and own power architecture tradeoffs for lunar applications - including energy storage integration, solar array interfaces, eclipse and survival-mode power budgets, and fault-tolerant distribution topologies
* Design circuits to implement functions such as power conversion, load switching, hot-swapping, power conditioning, inrush control, over-current fault detection, and more, with margin appropriate to long-duration lunar surface and cislunar operation
* Lead radiation, thermal, and dust-mitigation design considerations for power hardware operating beyond LEO, coordinating part selection, derating, and screening
* Perform failure modes and effects analyses and drive reliability design and validation plans at the system level, including single-point-failure retirement for human-rated applications
* Own qualification campaigns end-to-end, partnering with the test lab across random vibration, shock, thermal cycling, burn-in, TVAC, and radiation testing
* Drive design reviews and present architecture, analysis, and test results to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders at key program milestones
* Mentor junior engineers, review their designs, and help build the power electronics design standards, component libraries, and processes that scale across Vast programs

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering
* 6+ years of experience developing power electronics
* Demonstrated ownership of at least one power electronics product from architecture through hardware bring-up and validation

**Preferred Skills & Experience:**

* Master's degree in Electrical Engineering with a power electronics emphasis
* Experience designing electronics for the spaceflight environment, verifying workmanship and operability through environmental test (random vibration, shock, thermal, burn-in, and TVAC)
* Experience with hardware intended for beyond-LEO, lunar, planetary, or other high-radiation and extreme-thermal environments, including radiation-tolerant part selection, derating, and screening
* Experience with human-rated or other high-consequence systems where fault tolerance and single-point-failure retirement drive the architecture
* Professional experience with instrumentation and data acquisition
* Experience with software programming: MATLAB, Python, C/C++, etc
* Experience with vehicle and instrumentation buses such as Ethernet, CAN, SPI, and I2C, as well as serial I/O (RS422)
* Experience with full-lifecycle product development, including transition to production and manufacturing support

**Additional Requirements:**

* Willingness to work evenings and/or weekends to support critical mission milestones
* Ability to travel up to 5% of the time to support customer meetings
  

*We calibrate level and compensation to the selected candidate's experience and demonstrated capability. We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels to apply.*

  

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS**  
  
Base salary will vary depending on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10+ days of vacation for non-exempt staff with the ability to cash-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, On-Device Health Agentic Systems
jobs.description:
We are seeking a senior iOS Software Engineer with deep experience building applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs). This is a hands-on development role focused on creating the next generation of intelligent on-device experiences for Apple users.  
  
You will be responsible for building cutting-edge iOS applications that serve as the primary interface for on-device AI. A key part of your role will be to explore and define the software architecture for a scalable, high-performance system that seamlessly integrates powerful LLM agents into the Apple ecosystem, all while prioritizing user privacy and on-device performance. This role is for an expert iOS developer passionate about building the foundational architecture for AI-driven applications.  
  
This is a unique opportunity to define the future of intelligent applications at Apple. You will be at the center of building a new class of on-device experiences, setting the architectural foundation for how millions of users will interact with AI on a daily basis.  
  
**Description**  
  
What you'll build:  
  

* AI-Powered iOS Applications: Architect and build innovative, high-performance on-device apps that showcase the power of intelligent LLM agents.

  

* Scalable On-Device Architecture: Design the client-side frameworks and architectural patterns for integrating LLM systems efficiently on iOS.

  

* LLM Agent Integration: Implement the software that connects user-facing applications to on-device and hybrid AI reasoning and planning engines.

  

* Interactive AI Prototypes: Rapidly build and iterate on application prototypes to explore new user interactions and architectural options.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Experience with on-device ML frameworks like Core ML, Foundation Model, etc.  
  
Experience in SwiftUI and modern iOS architectural patterns.  
  
Knowledge of model quantization, caching, and other on-device optimization techniques.  
  
Experience with multi-platform development (e.g., building for both iOS and macOS).  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
BS and 10+ years of professional software development with expert-level experience building high-performance, consumer-facing mobile applications and frameworks.  
  
Strong proficiency in a modern systems programming language such as C++, ObjectiveC/Swift, or Rust.  
  
Deep understanding of mobile system fundamentals: concurrency, memory management, and power optimization.  
  
Practical knowledge of how LLM-powered systems work, including agent frameworks and RAG architectures.  
  
Proficiency in AI-assisted development workflows, with experience going beyond simple code suggestions to tackle complex debugging, architectural trade-offs, or automation tasks.  
  
**Pay & Benefits**  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $184,700 and $324,800, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  
  
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

jobs.description:
**Description**

Sanmina Corporation (Nasdaq: SANM) is a global powerhouse in integrated manufacturing solutions serving the fastest growing segments of the global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) market. We are a global engine providing the end-to-end manufacturing backbone for the world's most essential and innovative brands. Whether it's autonomous vehicles, life-saving medical tech, next-gen aerospace, or AI/cloud infrastructure - our integrated solutions don’t just meet standards—they redefine them.

**Summary:**

Viking Enterprise Solutions (VES) has a rich history of leadership in providing storage and storage server platforms to hyperscale and enterprise data centers worldwide. The division leads the market with ultra-high capacity and high-performance systems. Now VES provides advanced software solutions supporting ML/AI applications for generative and inferential AI in the data center and at the Edge. Software is at the heart of what makes VES a solutions provider. Cloud native systems are designed and built to simplify the use of tools and hardware so users get the job done quickly and efficiently. VES also designs and builds NVMe flash based server appliances, JBOD storage systems and related products for a variety of data center and storage applications. Viking Enterprise Solutions products are tailored for integration into OEM, System Integrator and data center products.

Viking Enterprise Solutions is proud to be part of the Sanmina family. Sanmina is recognized as a technology leader, providing end-to-end design, manufacturing and logistics solutions, maintaining a global footprint of design and manufacturing operations in 23 countries on six continents.

**What You’ll Do:**  
In this role, the Principal Firmware Development Engineer will participate in firmware engineering activities for the VES firmware development group in support of cutting edge data storage products and server product design in Colorado Springs. This person will report to the Firmware Engineering Manager. The successful candidate will participate in storage/server product development activities on Baseboard Management Controllers (BMC) and storage controllers. The candidate will also be responsible for supporting field issues related to BMC firmware, and engage with our external partners to resolve problems. The ideal candidate will have a successful track record of independently completing firmware design document creation, firmware code development and unit test activities to ship firmware projects on time with good quality.

* Working closely with Storage/Server HW design and firmware leads to provide early input on firmware design requirements
* Collaborate on high level design and low level design documents
* Work closely with project teams to provide schedules on given tasks
* Drive firmware development efforts for design, implementation, unit test, and integration
* Participate in firmware code development and code review process
* Provide weekly status updates to program management team on development status
* Provide support to field application engineers to debug and resolve problems at customer sites

**What You’ll Bring:**

* BS or MS degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Science
* 12+ years of related hands on experience in product design, firmware development in a medium or large global organization
* Excellent working knowledge of embedded system design and embedded firmware development
* Must have working knowledge of Yocto
* Preferred working knowledge and hands on experience with Open BMC firmware development
* Excellent working knowledge of the Linux OS and embedded Linux environments
* Experienced in Server/Storage system architecture
* Preferred experience in testing of Open BMC, BIOS firmware for storage/server applications
* Good system Hardware/Software integration skills
* Good communication skills to interact with external customer and engineering team
* Experienced in system level problem debug, problem determination and finding resolution
* Knowledge of IP Networking
* Familiar with Open BMC / Yocto community
* Preferred knowledge of protocols including IPMI, Redfish

**Why Join Us?**

At Sanmina, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $140,000 - $150,000 and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Sanmina employees also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Sanmina, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation.

Sanmina is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment. Sanmina provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Please be aware that this position may require access to technology, software, or technical data that is subject to U.S. export control laws. All offers of employment are contingent on the applicant either 1) being a "U.S. Person," defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident, or (iii) other protected individual, such as a refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157 or asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158; or 2) being eligible to obtain a timely export control license or license exception from the applicable U.S. federal agency.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Electrical Engineer

**Location:** Colorado Springs, CO  
**Work Arrangement:** Onsite  
**Industry:** Aerospace, Space & Defense

Job Summary

We are seeking an Electrical Engineer to support the design, development, testing, and optimization of advanced electronic products for aerospace, space, and defense applications. This role offers an opportunity to work across the full product development lifecycle, from circuit design and PCB layout to prototyping, troubleshooting, qualification testing, and final product delivery.

The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in analog and digital circuit design, schematic capture, PCB design, and electrical testing. Candidates at various experience levels, including recent graduates with relevant academic projects, internships, or hands-on engineering experience, are encouraged to apply.

Working closely with the Lead Electrical Engineer and a collaborative engineering team, the successful candidate will contribute to innovative engineering solutions for mission-critical applications.

Key Responsibilities

* Assist in the design, development, and optimization of analog and digital electronic circuits.
* Create, review, and maintain electrical schematics and engineering design documentation.
* Support PCB design and layout, including component selection, placement, and signal routing.
* Perform circuit analysis, simulation, troubleshooting, and performance verification.
* Support firmware development and hardware-software integration as required.
* Research, evaluate, and select electronic components, including components suitable for space and defense applications.
* Build and test prototypes, perform hands-on assembly and soldering, and troubleshoot electronic hardware.
* Develop and maintain test procedures, test fixtures, and automated testing solutions.
* Conduct electrical testing and support environmental and qualification testing, including thermal vacuum, random vibration, electromagnetic interference (EMI), and stability testing.
* Use SPICE and other engineering analysis tools to simulate and evaluate circuit performance.
* Document test results and prepare technical reports, including worst-case circuit analysis and reliability assessments.
* Support system-level integration, product optimization, final testing, and performance verification.
* Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, and cross-functional teams to meet technical specifications and customer requirements.
* Participate in technical reviews, resolve product-related issues, and assist with customer technical inquiries.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field.
* Strong foundational knowledge of analog and digital circuit design.
* Experience with schematic capture and PCB design/layout tools through professional experience, internships, or academic projects.
* Understanding of circuit analysis, electrical testing, and electronic troubleshooting.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical documentation skills.
* Hands-on interest in prototyping, hardware development, testing, and product integration.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a small, cross-functional engineering environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Must meet applicable U.S. export control eligibility requirements for the position.

Preferred Qualifications

* Approximately five years of relevant electrical engineering experience; however, candidates with less experience are encouraged to apply.
* Experience with embedded firmware development and hardware-software integration.
* Familiarity with FPGA technology and hardware description languages such as Verilog or VHDL.
* Experience with LabVIEW or other automated test and measurement software.
* Familiarity with SPICE circuit simulation and electrical engineering analysis tools.
* Knowledge of environmental testing, reliability analysis, and space qualification requirements.
* Experience in aerospace, defense, satellite electronics, or other space-related applications.
* Experience with component derating, worst-case circuit analysis, and reliability engineering.

Benefits

The organization offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* Short-term and long-term disability coverage.
* Basic and supplemental life insurance.
* Accident and critical illness insurance.
* Employee assistance programs.
* Retirement savings plan with employer matching.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.

Additional Requirements

* **Work Location:** Colorado Springs, Colorado; onsite attendance is required.
* **Export Compliance:** This position involves access to information controlled under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Candidates must satisfy the applicable U.S. person requirements under 22 CFR 120.15, which include U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees, as applicable.
* **Equal Employment Opportunity:** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics. Reasonable accommodations are available during the application process.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on Electrical Engineer with a solid foundation in analog and digital electronics, PCB design, circuit simulation, and hardware testing. Candidates who demonstrate practical engineering skills, attention to detail, a collaborative mindset, and an interest in aerospace and space-based electronic systems will be well suited for this opportunity.

jobs.title: Embedded Engineer
jobs.description:
Xcimer Energy leverages decades of research on Inertial Fusion Energy (IFE) combined with groundbreaking new laser architecture. Our mission is to deploy fusion power plants to meet global decarbonization goals as fast as possible. Xcimer has assembled a team of leaders in tough tech, fusion science, and manufacturing with a track record of rapid execution. Supported by leading investors, Xcimer is uniquely positioned to deliver limitless, clean, fusion power to combat climate change. Join us in powering a better world with inertial fusion!

**This is a full-time, onsite role based at our headquarters in Denver, CO.**

As an **Embedded Engineer**, you will apply your skills to the design, bring-up, and integration of custom electronics and the firmware that runs on them, for systems that sense, time, control, and protect Xcimer’s laser and pulsed power systems, initially in support of Xcimer’s directed energy program, which is developing multi-kilojoule-class pulsed lasers for air defense applications. Working within the Electrical Engineering department, you will own boards and their firmware from requirements through fabrication, bring-up, test, and deployment, working independently on problems of diverse scope with review at key design milestones. We are looking for our engineers to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

### **Responsibilities:**

* Design, simulate, and lay out mixed-signal printed circuit boards, including schematic capture, component selection, and multi-layer layout in Altium Designer.
* Design, implement, and maintain firmware for microcontroller and FPGA SoC based boards in C/C++, including drivers, board support, communication stacks, and application logic.
* Own assigned boards and their firmware end to end: derive requirements with system owners, produce design documentation, present at design reviews, manage fabrication and assembly, and support installation and commissioning.
* Perform board bring-up and debug at the register and signal level, root-cause hardware and firmware issues together, and close out findings through documented design changes.
* Implement deterministic, real-time control and data acquisition, including interrupt handling, DMA, timing and trigger capture, and RTOS based execution.
* Integrate custom electronics with the broader control system, including PLC and EtherCAT I/O, LabVIEW and Python based data acquisition, and precision timing and trigger networks.
* Develop test procedures, automated test fixtures, hardware-in-the-loop tests, and regression tests, and document verification and acceptance results.
* Solicit feedback from end users such as operators, physicists, and controls engineers, and close the design loop through iterative improvements.
* Lead small projects or work packages, coordinating with controls, mechanical, software, and manufacturing teams, and begin mentoring junior engineers and interns.
* Contribute to Electrical Engineering department standards, including design guides, component libraries, coding standards, shared firmware libraries, and design review practices.

### **Qualifications:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related STEM field; an advanced degree is a plus.
* **Experience:** Typically 5+ years of relevant experience spanning embedded hardware and firmware development, or a PhD with relevant hands-on embedded experience.
* Solid foundation in:
  + Analog and digital circuit design, including mixed-signal PCB design and power supply design
  + Embedded C/C++ on bare-metal and RTOS based targets, including peripheral configuration at the register level
  + Real-time systems, interrupts, DMA, and deterministic timing
  + Signal integrity, grounding, and EMI/EMC fundamentals
* Proficient in debugging hardware and firmware together using JTAG/SWD debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers.
* Working knowledge of microcontroller families (ARM Cortex-M such as STM32, NXP, or TI) and at least one RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar).
* Working knowledge of common communication interfaces, including SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, and USB.
* Experience with version control (Git) and structured design and code review processes.
* Ability to work independently on problems of diverse scope, with work reviewed at critical milestones, and to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance if required by future program work; a clearance is not required at the time of hire.
* Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum

### **Desired:**

* **Education:** Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related STEM field
* Experience designing electronics and firmware for high voltage, pulsed power, or laser environments, including isolation, fiber optic signaling, interlocks, and fault handling.
* Experience with FPGA development (Xilinx/AMD, Intel, or Microchip), HDL, and high-speed ADC/DAC interfaces.
* Experience with embedded Linux (Yocto or Buildroot, device trees, kernel drivers) on ARM SoC platforms.
* Familiarity with industrial control platforms (Beckhoff TwinCAT/EtherCAT, PLCs) and protocols such as EtherCAT, Modbus, or EPICS.
* Proficiency in design principles for data acquisition, signal processing, and test automation.
* Experience with precision timing and trigger distribution (PTP, White Rabbit, IRIG).
* Knowledge of DFM/DFT practices and experience working with contract manufacturers.
* Experience mentoring junior engineers or leading small projects.

Candidates may be considered for other positions at Xcimer Energy, and our actual base salary will be determined on an individual basis and may vary based on job-related

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer - Broadband CPE
jobs.description:
At T-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package - this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!

Job Overview  
T-Mobile Home Internet is one of our fastest growing businesses, and the software this team builds runs on every gateway and mesh extender we put in a customer's home. We're a small development team on a large program, so you'll contribute to meaningful software development work from the start.  
  
You'll develop the device agents that manage, monitor, and troubleshoot our broadband customer premises equipment. They're written in C and C++ against the Broadband Forum's open USP standards and run on the RDK-B platform. The agent uses a microservice architecture, and you'll develop and maintain assigned services within the established architecture.  
  
Your agents will interface with the device's Wi-Fi and cellular subsystems through RDK and RBUS. You won't be writing Wi-Fi drivers or modem firmware, but understanding those technologies, and how RDK components talk to each other, is central to doing this job well.

**What you'll do**

* Develop and maintain one or more microservices within the device management agent, in C and C++ on RDK-B.
* Implement and maintain device data model parameters and USP protocol behavior across supported hardware platforms.
* Interface with the device's Wi-Fi and cellular subsystems through RDK and RBUS to configure them, query state, and report it upstream.
* Build and maintain the containerized services that run on the device, delivered through a Kubernetes-based packaging and deployment pipeline.
* Write unit tests for new and changed code and extend our automated test coverage.
* Debug across the device software stack, from log analysis and root cause investigation through to fix verification.
* Support device maintenance releases, including test support, firmware validation, and release verification.
* Work with OEM partners on defect triage and reproduction.
* Improve how we collect data and logs from the field so issues can be triaged and resolved faster.
* Contribute ideas that improve how we build, test, and deliver device software.
* Document your code, the data model and device behavior.

**Job Summary**

This role is essential for designing, implementing, and deploying scalable software solutions that meet customer requirements and support high availability environments. The role involves collaborating with engineering teams to develop software components using technologies such as virtualization, microservices, software-defined networking, network functions virtualization, and broadband device management. This position requires independent development of software components and understanding system protocols, data flows, and technology interactions, including those supporting broadband customer premises equipment (CPE). Success is measured by the ability to deliver technical solutions, produce clear documentation, and contribute to technology strategy and innovation. The work impacts the organization by enabling advanced software systems that improve operational efficiency and support business goals.

**Main Responsibilities**

* Develop software solutions that support engineering projects and meet customer requirements, including developing and maintaining embedded software components and device management services for broadband CPE.
* Collaborate with technical teams to deliver effective technical solutions and continuously learn new technologies, including supporting software debugging, testing, release verification, and defect investigation with OEM partners.
* Create clear documentation for software code, system designs, and business requirements, including device data models and software behavior.
* Contribute to technology strategy by understanding current technologies and supporting business goals, including improvements to device software testing, diagnostics, and development processes.
* Present innovative ideas to improve systems, processes, or services based on industry research, including improvements to device software reliability and troubleshooting.
* Also responsible for other duties/projects as assigned by business management as needed.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree plus 3 years of related work experience OR advanced degree with 1 year of related work experience OR combination of education and experience deemed equivalent.
* Acceptable areas of study include Computer Science or Engineering.
* 2-4 years of technical engineering experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

jobs.description:
About us:

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.

What you'll do:

As a Senior Systems Engineer on the ACT team, you’ll turn early ideas into working prototypes — spanning satellite communications, PNT, and related systems — to test technical and operational hypotheses. You’ll own the front-end analysis — trade studies, feasibility assessments, and system architecture — that shapes what we build, and you’ll produce the clear artifacts that let a concept move forward for execution at scale. As the team’s senior systems engineer, you’ll be the technical anchor for the system model — driving how it’s structured and built, guiding the engineers doing the hands-on build, and keeping architecture, interfaces, and analysis coherent as prototypes evolve. This is a fast-paced, integrative role focused on prototyping, not production hardening.

The day-to-day:

* Run trade studies and feasibility analysis to compare concepts and recommend an approach.
* Develop system and subsystem concepts and architectures, and define interfaces (ICDs) across RF, digital, software, and timing — including for components sourced from different groups, aligned to representative open-architecture interfaces.
* Model and analyze system performance in MATLAB and/or Python (for example, link budgets, RF cascades, and error budgets).
* Perform quantitative modeling and analysis of signal, propagation, and geometry effects to support PNT, signals-of-opportunity, and communications concepts.
* Produce clean specifications, models, and hand-off artifacts so prototypes can transition for build-out at scale.
* Work closely across signal processing, embedded, FPGA, software, and integration & test to keep the integrated system coherent and performing — supporting prototype bring-up and testing, and keeping the system model current as the design evolves.

What you'll need:

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 8+ years of systems engineering or related experience.
* Systems engineering fundamentals: requirements development, trade studies, interface definition, and analysis.
* Proficiency in MATLAB and/or Python for modeling, simulation, and analysis.
* Working knowledge of RF, SATCOM/communications, or PNT domains.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including clear diagrams and documentation.
* Self-motivated and comfortable driving from concept to prototype implementation — working independently within your area while collaborating across disciplines.
* US citizenship required, with the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret clearance.
* This is an onsite role based in Duluth, GA, with up to 10% travel.

What will help you on the job:

* Model-based systems engineering (MBSE) and tools such as Cameo or Jama.
* Familiarity with open-architecture standards / modular open systems (for example, a Government Reference Architecture) for defining interfaces across components and vendors.
* Ability to work with satellite ephemeris and orbital geometry to derive Doppler/geometry predictions.
* Familiarity with SATCOM terminals or satellite communications networks, and how positioning, navigation, and timing services ride on them.
* Familiarity with digital phased arrays, beamforming, or timing distribution and synchronization.
* Exposure to electronic warfare, contested operations, or resilient PNT concepts.
* Familiarity with precision timing (time transfer, synchronization) given the team’s timing work.
* Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or a related field.
* An active DoD Secret (or higher) clearance.

jobs.title: Mechatronics Engineer
jobs.description:
Mechatronics Engineer

**About Us**
============

Schweid & Sons is a family-owned and operated premium ground beef company with a proud heritage spanning four generations. We supply top-quality beef to Retail, Foodservice, and National Account customers across the U.S. and are committed to quality, customer service, and innovation in protein manufacturing.

**The Role**
============

The Mechatronics Engineer is a professional engineering position responsible for researching, designing, developing, and testing automation, intelligent systems, and industrial control systems used in Schweid & Sons’ food manufacturing operations. Applying principles of mechanical, electrical, controls, and engineering, the Mechatronics Engineer designs and implements automated solutions and electromechanical and control-system improvements that increase the reliability, safety, quality, and throughput of production and facility systems. The position leads engineering analysis of equipment performance and failures, and provides technical direction to maintenance technicians and contractors in implementing engineered solutions.

**What You’ll Work On**
=======================

* **Automation Design.** Design, develop, and implement engineering systems and control solutions for the automation of industrial tasks, including the automated transfer, handling, processing, and packaging of materials, components, and finished goods.
* **Controls Engineering.** Design, develop, program, and implement control circuits, algorithms, and PLC, HMI, servo, and motion-control programs for electromechanical, pneumatic, and hydraulic devices and systems.
* **Component Selection.** Research, select, and apply sensors, communication technologies, industrial networks, and control devices for motion control, position sensing, pressure sensing, and electronic communication, and identify materials appropriate for mechatronic system designs, including sanitary-design requirements.
* **Equipment Upgrades and Design Documentation.** Upgrade the design of existing production equipment by adding mechatronic elements; create mechanical design documents, electrical drawings, and specifications for parts, assemblies, and modifications using computer-aided design (CAD) software.
* **Modeling, Testing, and Commissioning.** Create models or simulations to evaluate mechatronic design concepts; implement, test, and commission design solutions; and document qualification test results before release to production.
* **Feasibility and Cost Analysis.** Determine the feasibility, costs, and performance benefits of new mechatronic equipment and capital or continuous-improvement projects; prepare engineering cost estimates and project justifications, and monitor project and equipment-related costs against budget.
* **Engineering Analysis and Process Improvement.** Analyze existing manufacturing procedures and equipment performance, downtime, and failure data; lead engineering root-cause analysis; and recommend and implement design or process improvements that increase reliability, safety, quality, throughput, and maintainability.
* **Calibration and Optimization.** Monitor and calibrate automated systems, industrial control systems, and system components to maximize efficiency of production.
* **Reliability Engineering.** Define the engineering requirements of preventive and predictive maintenance programs for automated production equipment, utilities, and facility systems; evaluate equipment condition and lifecycle; and recommend repairs, replacements, upgrades, and lifecycle plans.
* **Technical Troubleshooting Support.** Provide engineering support in diagnosing complex mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, instrumentation, robotics, PLC, HMI, servo, sensor, and controls failures, and direct the restoration of safe operation to minimize downtime.
* **Technical Direction and Training.** Provide technical guidance, consultation, and training on mechatronics and automated control to maintenance technicians, operations personnel, and management; assign, schedule, and review the technical work of maintenance technicians in accordance with company policies.
* **Contractor Oversight.** Oversee the work of contractors, integrators, and vendors in accordance with project requirements, including scope, specifications, schedule, safe work practices, quality, and acceptance testing.
* **Technical Records.** Maintain technical project files and publish engineering reports documenting design details; maintain electrical drawings, control-program backups, technical documentation, spare-parts specifications, and standard operating procedures.
* **Standards and Compliance.** Ensure designs and work comply with applicable electrical and mechanical codes and standards, workplace safety requirements (including lockout/tagout), food-safety and sanitary-design practices, company procedures, and regulatory requirements.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration.** Partner with Operations, Quality, Safety, and vendors to define equipment requirements, prioritize engineering work, and plan shutdowns and project execution.
* **On-Call Engineering Support.** Participate in an on-call rotation and provide after-hours engineering support when required by operational needs.
* Complete additional responsibilities as assigned, consistent with the professional engineering nature of the position.

**What You Bring**
==================

**Must-Haves**
--------------

* Bachelor’s degree, or foreign equivalent (including a Mexican licenciatura or Canadian baccalaureate degree), in Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation or Controls Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline.
* At least 3 years of professional engineering experience designing, programming, testing, or improving automated manufacturing equipment, including PLC-controlled electromechanical systems.
* At least 2 years of experience leading technical project tea

jobs.title: Substation Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

ENERCON's Substation Group is at the forefront of the energy transition, tackling real-world challenges as the grid evolves. With the rapid growth of smart home technology, electric vehicles, battery energy storage, and renewable energy sources, we’re facing a new era of power systems—one defined by multi-directional power flows, advanced data acquisition, and dynamic load management. Join us as we help redefine how energy is delivered, managed, and sustained for generations to come.

Due to continued growth, our Power Delivery group is seeking a Substation Automation Engineer in one of the following office locations:

* Houston, TX
* Orlando, FL
* Overland Park, KS
* Kennesaw, GA
* Covington, LA (Hybrid)
* Remote

This position may be filled at various engineering levels. Job title and job level will be determined based upon candidate’s qualifications and experience.

Responsibilities:

Imagine a day where you're helping utilities modernize the power grid through advanced automation and digital substation technologies. You develop SCADA systems, integrate intelligent electronic devices (IEDs), configure communication networks, and support field commissioning activities that bring substations to life. Your work enables operators to monitor, control, and respond to changing grid conditions in real time, helping deliver safe, reliable, and sustainable power to millions of customers.

**Substation Automation & Integration**

* Develop and implement substation automation systems, including SCADA, RTU, HMI, and Intelligent Electronic Device (IED) integration.
* Configure and test communication protocols such as DNP3, IEC 61850, IEC 60870, and Modbus.
* Design and develop automation databases, point lists, communication mappings, and control logic.

**Engineering & System Configuration**

* Configure and commission substation automation equipment, including RTUs, gateways, protocol converters, network switches, and automation controllers.
* Develop and maintain engineering documentation including automation architecture drawings, communication diagrams, device configuration files, and testing procedures.
* Support cybersecurity and network design efforts for modern digital substations.

**Collaboration & Quality Assurance**

* Work closely with protection and control engineers, network engineers, project managers, and clients to develop integrated automation solutions.
* Perform quality reviews to ensure compliance with client standards and industry best practices.
* Support troubleshooting and resolution of automation, communication, and system integration issues.

**Field Support & Commissioning**

* Provide technical support during system installation, energization, and commissioning activities.
* Conduct field testing and validation of automation systems and communication networks.
* Travel to client sites as required to support project execution and startup activities. #LI-MD1

Qualifications:

* Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering or related engineering discipline required
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in electric utility, substation automation, SCADA, or control systems engineering
* Familiarity with utility communication protocols including DNP3, IEC 61850, IEC 60870, or Modbus
* Understanding of substation protection and control system and IED applications
* Experience configuring automation equipment, RTUs, gateways, HMIs, or communication processors
* Ability to read and interpret substation drawings, communication diagrams, and protection and control schematics
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with both internal and external stakeholders
* Must be self-driven in time management to meet deadlines and provide accurate deliverables, with the ability to communicate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Willingness to enter energized electric substations with proper training and PPE
* Willingness to travel for client site visits, commissioning activities, and project meetings

Preferred Qualifications

* Professional Engineer License or equivalent certification
* Five or more years of experience in substation automation, SCADA integration, or utility controls engineering
* Experience with SEL, Novatech, Siemens, GE Vernova, Hitachi Energy, Schneider Electric, ABB, or similar utility automation platforms
* Hands-on experience with SEL RTAC, SEL-3530 RTAC, SEL Blueframe, Beckwith M-3931, or comparable automation systems
* Knowledge of utility networking, Ethernet switches, fiber-optic communications, and cybersecurity principles
* Experience performing field commissioning activities
* Experience working within electric utility organizations or consulting engineering environments
* Utility-scale transmission or distribution substation experience up to 500 kV

jobs.title: Trading Systems Engineer - Global Options
jobs.description:
**DRW** is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it's not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. **DRW** is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

Our Global Trade Support team provides mission critical support for many of our proprietary and third-party trading systems as well as our proprietary middle and back-office systems. They support a wide variety of trading teams globally who are participating in markets such as equities, fixed income and cryptoassets. They perform technical support and engineering functions that include application support in testing and production environments, software deployment and configuration, and system monitoring.

**What you'll do in this role:**

* Work as part of a team to establish best-in-class production support, efficient software deployment, configuration processes, and proactive monitoring, with a goal of anticipating and avoiding issues before they occur, minimizing downtime and quick recovery from any incidents.
* Ensure maximum trading system availability to avoid missing any key trading opportunities
* Provide support for various trading groups' production systems across a variety of asset classes and geographic locations deployed across a multi-platform production environment (primarily Linux with a little Windows)
* Develop proprietary process automation and monitoring tools and leverage third-party technologies as appropriate
* Troubleshoot trading system production incidents resulting from internal (proprietary software / systems) or external factors (markets, data feeds, telecommunication lines)
* Automate software configuration and rollout procedures to reduce manual configuration errors and strive for flawless change management
* Support core market connectivity and correspond with exchanges regarding trade order activity, connectivity, and other related technical support issues
* Collaborate with traders, DBAs, development, back office, QA, infrastructure, technical support, business development and various management teams around the globe.
* Help end users and developers understand core trading and back-office systems to ensure efficient and correct use of available tools.
* Build documentation for common procedures, troubleshooting scenarios and system architecture.
* Coordinate efforts with other global support teams to ensure continuity and consistency of support in a 24x7 environment

**What's needed in this role:**

* Superior troubleshooting skills and the ability to navigate issues efficiently that do not have a pre-defined runbook process
* Prior experience supporting high performance applications, process monitoring, and troubleshooting
* Prior experience supporting equities/equity options trading
* Prior experience working with FIX protocol and alternative exchange protocols
* Script development experience a plus
* SQL experience including queries/updates/table creation/basic database maintenance
* Linux & Windows platform support experience in a large-scale production environment
* Experience supporting electronic trading systems; prior experience at proprietary trading firm preferred
* Demonstrated knowledge of network communications, including use of multicast networking
* Must have some flexibility in work schedule to help ensure team coverage; rotating on-call coverage required
* B.S. in Computer Science or equivalent degree
* Self-motivation and intellectual curiosity; desire to continually grow and always seek improvements in production support function
* High level of ownership and accountability, reliability, and strong follow through
* Ability to handle pressure and time constraints with composure; ability to multitask and context switch efficiently
* Strong organizational skills, including ability to effectively plan and prioritize
* Must have strong communication skills and demonstrate the ability to have clear and concise conversations, both written and verbal, with a variety of personalities
* Must be able to quickly apply prior context to troubleshooting and communication efforts

The annual base salary range for this position is $175,000 to $225,000 depending on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set. The position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition, DRW offers a comprehensive suite of employee benefits including group medical, pharmacy, dental and vision insurance, 401k (with discretionary employer match), short and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, health savings accounts, and flexible spending accounts.

* **Strengthen Product Reliability:** Mitigate failure modes by identifying critical interfaces, functions, interactions, and risks to improve long‑term product robustness.

* **Architect Scalable Product Platforms:** Develop holistic product platforms, evaluate architectural trade‑offs, and maintain traceable plans that align future products with market needs.
* **Deliver High‑Quality Software:** Build and verify software using strong engineering principles, ensuring updates are reliable, maintainable, and aligned with product requirements.
* **Lead Verification & Validation Strategy:** Create and manage validation plans, assess risk, interpret analytical and physical test results, and recommend solutions that ensure requirement compliance.
* **Define and Govern System Requirements:** Translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements, manage lifecycle changes, and maintain the linkages that keep teams aligned and designs on track.
* **Apply Systems Thinking to Improve Outcomes:** Analyze interactions across the system to predict behavior, refine designs, and drive modifications that deliver the intended product effects.
* **Drive Collaboration and Technical Clarity:** Partner across functions, communicate effectively, apply statistical methods, solve problems with rigor, and document insights to elevate organizational knowledge.

**To be successful in this role you will need the following:**

* **Strong Software Engineering & Diagnostic Skills:** You’ll need the ability to investigate software issues, understand causal mechanisms, recommend corrective actions, and use coding, compiling, static analysis, integration tools, and HIL environments to deliver verified, high‑quality software builds.
* **Systems‑Level Decision‑Making:** Success requires applying systems knowledge to make sound choices in requirements, architecture, design, and testing—decisions that directly influence software performance, product quality, and cross‑BU integration.
* **Collaboration & Cross‑Functional Influence:** You’ll rely on effective communication and teamwork to gather input, coordinate with product and software teams, guide technicians or student contributors, and contribute meaningfully to shared goals.
* **Process Discipline & Independent Execution:** You’ll need the ability to execute established development processes independently, improve tools and workflows, manage ambiguity in moderately complex systems, and steadily build proficiency while influencing team outcomes.

**Education, Licenses, Certifications:**

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Entry level/Early career professional. --------------------

* Develop or review controls hardware and software designs, including PLCs, HMIs, robots, drives, safety systems, industrial networks, machine vision, error proofing, and plant-floor interfaces.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

***\*This role requires working on-site daily M-F at our Grand Rapids, Michigan facility. For external candidates that reside more than 50 miles outside of Grand Rapids MI, a relocation bonus of $5K is available for a qualified candidate.***

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

**Job Summary**

Reports to Sustaining Engineering Manager. The incumbent will lead momentum product improvement initiatives and support troubleshooting and root cause corrective action activities for field and production issues. Assignments will be predominantly focused on reliability and quality improvements of Eaton’s Grand Rapids products, which would include but is not limited to motor controllers, DC motors, electrical circuit boards, electromechanical actuators, and other related components. Responsibilities include troubleshooting of electronic hardware at the component level and supporting management of electrical component obsolescence. Additionally, the incumbent is expected to provide technical support to the operations personnel, procurement group, and customers as required.  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

Drive product improvements through engineering analysis, redesign and testing of electromechanical actuators and system hardware.

Sustain product viability through proactive evaluation and redesign of hardware with obsolete components.

Develop test plans, specifications and general test procedures for requalification activities; coordinate requalification testing, advise laboratory personnel supporting efforts, evaluate test results, and develop test reports.

Support Printed Wire Assembly (PWA) Supplier transfer initiatives.

jobs.title: Thermal and Fluid Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

This entry level/early career professional, applied science position utilizes the core competencies of thermal and fluid sciences, using and advancing analytical and experimental approaches to answer key questions about the performance and architecture of a system or component. This drives decisions and creates technical content which ultimately leads to state of the art, highly effective, environmentally friendly, and competitive products.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Investigates product, system, and/or technology problems that are related to thermal and fluid sciences, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution and documents results with guidance from more experienced team members. Applies and supports the improvement of processes such as Pre Program Planning, (PPP), Product Preceding Technology, (PPT), Value Package Introduction (VPI), or Value Package Change, (VPC), Engineering Standard Work, (ESW), Functional Excellence Practice (FEP) and tools related to thermal and fluid sciences such as GT-Suite, Boost, Fluent, Converge, Concerto, CyberApps (virtual application model), Cummins Data Analysis Tool (CDAT), Mach, test data calculation, DARTS, test data storage, Calterm, Electronic Control Module (ECM) calibration tool, Emissions data system, Integrity, and ACCEPTS ECM in-loop test bench required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making. Obtains input and negotiates with immediate stakeholders, such as team members, technical managers, project leaders, other Thermal Sciences engineers, product and manufacturing engineers, and supplier partners and delivers information and recommendations to support project decisions, or to provide input related to further analysis, design optimization, feasibility studies, or architecture definition. Makes decisions in the areas of day to day project details, such as conducting analysis, testing, and communication with stakeholders that impact and support the successful progression of projects. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role.

**Competencies:**

Applies Principles of Fluid Dynamics and Heat Transfer - Interprets and predicts the performance of fluid and thermal systems by leveraging a quantitative and intuitive comprehension of the flow of liquids and gases, the transfer of thermal energy between elements of a system, and the application of modeling and experimental tools, to answer key questions about the system or component.

Applies Principles of Thermodynamics and Energy Conversion Systems - Interprets and predicts the performance of energy conversion systems such as IC engines, gas turbines, fuel cells, and batteries, by leveraging a quantitative and intuitive comprehension of thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, modeling tools, controls, and experimental tools to answer key questions about the system or component.

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged

jobs.description:
At T-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package - this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!

Job Overview  
T-Mobile Home Internet is one of our fastest growing businesses, and the software this team builds runs on every gateway and mesh extender we put in a customer's home. We're a small development team on a large program, so you'll contribute to meaningful software development work from the start.  
  
You'll develop the device agents that manage, monitor, and troubleshoot our broadband customer premises equipment. They're written in C and C++ against the Broadband Forum's open USP standards and run on the RDK-B platform. The agent uses a microservice architecture, and you'll develop and maintain assigned services within the established architecture.  
  
Your agents will interface with the device's Wi-Fi and cellular subsystems through RDK and RBUS. You won't be writing Wi-Fi drivers or modem firmware, but understanding those technologies, and how RDK components talk to each other, is central to doing this job well.

**What you'll do**

* Develop and maintain one or more microservices within the device management agent, in C and C++ on RDK-B.
* Implement and maintain device data model parameters and USP protocol behavior across supported hardware platforms.
* Interface with the device's Wi-Fi and cellular subsystems through RDK and RBUS to configure them, query state, and report it upstream.
* Build and maintain the containerized services that run on the device, delivered through a Kubernetes-based packaging and deployment pipeline.
* Write unit tests for new and changed code and extend our automated test coverage.
* Debug across the device software stack, from log analysis and root cause investigation through to fix verification.
* Support device maintenance releases, including test support, firmware validation, and release verification.
* Work with OEM partners on defect triage and reproduction.
* Improve how we collect data and logs from the field so issues can be triaged and resolved faster.
* Contribute ideas that improve how we build, test, and deliver device software.
* Document your code, the data model and device behavior.

**Job Summary**

This role is essential for designing, implementing, and deploying scalable software solutions that meet customer requirements and support high availability environments. The role involves collaborating with engineering teams to develop software components using technologies such as virtualization, microservices, software-defined networking, network functions virtualization, and broadband device management. This position requires independent development of software components and understanding system protocols, data flows, and technology interactions, including those supporting broadband customer premises equipment (CPE). Success is measured by the ability to deliver technical solutions, produce clear documentation, and contribute to technology strategy and innovation. The work impacts the organization by enabling advanced software systems that improve operational efficiency and support business goals.

* Develop software solutions that support engineering projects and meet customer requirements, including developing and maintaining embedded software components and device management services for broadband CPE.

* Create clear documentation for software code, system designs, and business requirements, including device data models and software behavior.
* Contribute to technology strategy by understanding current technologies and supporting business goals, including improvements to device software testing, diagnostics, and development processes.
* Present innovative ideas to improve systems, processes, or services based on industry research, including improvements to device software reliability and troubleshooting.
* Also responsible for other duties/projects as assigned by business management as needed.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree plus 3 years of related work experience OR advanced degree with 1 year of related work experience OR combination of education and experience deemed equivalent.
* Acceptable areas of study include Computer Science or Engineering.
* 2-4 years of technical engineering experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* C and C++ development on embedded Linux.
* Strong Wi-Fi knowledge: 802.11 standards and generations, band and channel behavior, client association and steering, and practical troubleshooting.
* Strong grounding in the IP stack and network technologies: TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, NAT, routing and bridging.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Description:

The Systems Engineer is the lead technical resource for our Lenexa, KS location. This person owns IT at the site from end to end: the local network, servers, desktops, printers, and the software used in production and in the office. Beyond the site, they help look after the company-wide network and cloud environment, and triage incoming IT support requests, resolving them directly or routing them to the right team. This is a hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable at a user's desk as in a server room or working a support queue.

**Location IT Ownership**

* Serve as the primary on-site IT resource for the Lenexa location, owning its network, servers, desktops, and software.
* Build, configure, and maintain on-site servers, including setup, patching, backups, and hardware replacement.
* Manage the location network, including switches, firewalls, wireless, cabling, and internet connectivity.
* Install, configure, and support location software, including production, prepress, and print-related applications.
* Manage IT equipment for the site, including inventory, setup, and retirement, and provide input on purchases.
* Work with vendors and service providers to resolve site issues and coordinate repairs.

**Desktop and End-User Support**

* Provide hands-on support for desktops, laptops, printers, phones, mobile devices, and peripherals.
* Set up and image new computers, and handle user onboarding and offboarding, including accounts, access, and equipment.
* Troubleshoot operating system, Microsoft 365, and business application issues for on-site and remote users.
* Guide and train users on the effective use of company technology.

**Service Desk and Support Triage**

* Monitor the IT support queue, triage incoming requests, and set priorities.
* Resolve issues directly where possible, and route others to the right internal team or vendor with clear notes.
* Act as an escalation point for complex technical problems.
* Track tickets through to resolution and keep users informed.
* Spot recurring issues and fix the underlying cause, not just the symptom.

**Company Network and Infrastructure**

* Help maintain the company-wide network, including multi-site connectivity, VPN, and remote access.
* Support cloud infrastructure and services, including Microsoft 365, Azure, and identity management.
* Support network and security appliances such as firewalls, load balancers, and web application firewalls.
* Monitor system health, performance, and availability, and respond to alerts and outages.
* Carry out patching, upgrades, and technology refresh work across servers and endpoints.

**Security, Backup and Continuity**

* Maintain endpoint protection, user access controls, and security best practices.
* Manage backups and help test disaster recovery and business continuity plans.
* Take part in security incident response and remediation.

**Documentation and Reporting**

* Maintain documentation for systems, network diagrams, configurations, and procedures.
* Provide status updates and ad hoc reports to management.
* Take part in after-hours maintenance and on-call support as needed.

Requirements:

**Education and Experience:**

* 3+ years of IT experience covering desktop support, systems administration, and networking.
* Experience as the main IT resource for a site or small team preferred.
* Experience supporting manufacturing, printing, or production environments is a plus.
* Technical certifications preferred.

**Qualifications, Skills, Abilities and Competencies:**

**Technical Skills**

* Windows desktop and server administration, including building and maintaining servers.
* Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and cloud identity administration.
* Networking, including switching, routing, firewalls, wireless, VPN, and remote access.
* Virtualization, backup, and recovery tools.
* Cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure.
* Endpoint management and security tools.
* Help desk and ticketing systems.
* PowerShell or other scripting experience is a plus.
* Basic SQL knowledge is a plus.

**Competencies**

* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent customer service with users at all technical levels.
* Able to explain technical issues in plain language, to individuals and to groups.
* Able to prioritize and handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment with frequent interruptions.
* Self-motivated and able to work independently as the on-site IT lead, while collaborating with the wider IT team.
* Keeps clear and accurate documentation.
* Contributes to a strong, positive team spirit and aligns with GSP values.

**Physical Demands:**

* Work on site at the Lenexa location, in both office and manufacturing areas.
* Occasional travel to other company locations as needed.
* Extended periods of computer work.
* Lift and move equipment up to 50 pounds.
* Stand, walk, bend, kneel, and reach when installing or servicing equipment.
