jobs.description:
**Description**

Would you be excited to build communications/networking architectures across hardware/firmware/software boundaries?

Are you interested in trying novel, creative, and risky approaches for communications systems to solve and overcome mission critical challenges?

Would you enjoy rapid prototyping of ideas on both novel and deployed RF hardware/systems?

If so, we’re looking for someone like you to join our team at APL!

The Networked Systems and Integrated Fires group is seeking a Communications Systems Engineer to contribute to communications system design, implementation, hardware test/evaluation, firmware, real-time embedded software, and more. As part of our team, you will make critical contributions to both new and legacy communications systems and work on a variety of projects in a fast-paced team environment.

**As a Communications Systems Engineer, you will:**

* Work with multi-disciplinary teams in designing, implementing, and analyzing systems/algorithms for future resilient, secure, and adaptive communications networks operating in highly contested environments
* Develop FPGA firmware (VHDL) from concept through implementation, evaluation, and deployment
* Contribute to MATLAB modeling and simulation
* Validate and analyze performance of prototypes and tactical systems against complex operational scenarios
* Work as part of a team to design novel solutions and approaches for size/weight/power/cost (SWaP-C) constrained communications concepts
* Provide status updates, analysis results, and algorithms in written reports and in presentations to internal APL staff, program contractors, and government sponsors
* Support occasional field tests for hardware testing

  
**Qualifications**

**You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you…**

* Have a BS degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline
* Have 3+ years of experience in FPGA/firmware development in VHDL or Verilog
* Have demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a multi-disciplinary team
* Can effectively communicate ideas and results
* Have professional experience in at least **one** of the following:
* Implementing digital signal processing (DSP) algorithms on FPGA
* C/C++ embedded programming on FPGA System-on-Chip (SoC) devices
* RF systems link analysis or communications algorithm modeling/simulation in Python or MATLAB
* Strong knowledge of RF (Radio Frequency) hardware design/test principles, with hands-on experience using test equipment
* Are able to obtain an Interim Secret security clearance by your start date and can ultimately obtain a Secret security clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

**You’ll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you…**

* Have a MS degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline
* Have experience implementing advanced concepts on FPGA such as adaptive filtering techniques, error correction codes, etc.
* Have hands-on experience implementing high speed ADC/DAC interfaces on FPGA
* Have experience with current military links (e.g. CDL, Link 16 / MIDS)
* Have an active Top Secret security clearance

  
  
**About Us**

**Why Work at APL?**

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. While we are dedicated to solving complex challenges and pioneering new technologies, what makes us truly outstanding is our culture. We offer a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere where you can bring your authentic self to work, continue to grow, and build strong connections with inspiring teammates.

At APL, we celebrate our differences of perspectives and encourage creativity and bold, new ideas. Our employees enjoy generous benefits, including a robust education assistance program, unparalleled retirement contributions, and a healthy work/life balance. APL’s campus is located in the Baltimore-Washington metro area. Learn more about our career opportunities at https://www.jhuapl.edu/careers.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, occupation, marital or familial status, political opinion, personal appearance, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. APL is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals of all abilities, including those with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the hiring process, please contact Accessibility@jhuapl.edu.

The referenced pay range is based on JHU APL’s good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level with consideration for internal parity. For salaried employees scheduled to work less than 40 hours per week, annual salary will be prorated based on the number of hours worked. jobs.title: Principal Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Who we are**

With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility.

**What we need**

Symbotic’s vision is automation at large scale, carried by physical AI. It starts in the warehouse, where robots see, decide, and move goods at extraordinary speed and density — and extends to new platforms and applications still taking shape. As that vision grows, so does the challenge: turning intelligence into physical action through the power, sensing, compute, harnesses, and electrical integration that bring Physical AI to life.

Symbotic is seeking a Principal Electrical Engineer to drive electrical design for automated material-handling robots and related platforms. In this role you will lead the conceptualization, architecture, design, analysis, fabrication, integration, and test of complex electrical systems — not only PCBAs and cables, but the full bot-level electrical system — from concept through production.

You will set technical direction for other electrical designers, work through Symbotic’s Product Development Process (PDP), and partner with PLM and contract manufacturers so designs can be built, qualified, and released at volume.

**What we do**

The Electrical Engineering – Bot Hardware team is part of Symbotic’s Hardware Engineering organization and develops the electrical hardware that powers and connects our robotic systems. Our team designs PCB-based electronics, harnesses, and electrical interfaces that support power distribution, sensing, compute, communications, and control across our automation platforms. We partner closely with mechanical, firmware, test, manufacturing, and other engineering teams to integrate these designs into reliable, manufacturable robotic products and support them from development through production.

**What you'll do**

* Lead technical solutions to complex electrical problems that require regular ingenuity and creativity, at board, harness, and system-integration level (power, sensing, compute, interconnect, grounding, and interfaces to mechanical, firmware, and controls).
* Drive designs from concept through production: architecture, schematic, PCB layout, prototype, DVT, design freeze, production release, and sustaining.
* Follow and lead others through the PDP — phase gates, design reviews, requirements, verification, and release discipline — so the team ships on a repeatable path.
* Design schematics and PCB layouts in Altium — not layout guidance only. Own stackup, placement, routing, SI/PI, EMC-aware layout, and DFM through release.
* Apply DfX (DFM, DFA, DFT, DFS, and related) so designs are manufacturable, testable, serviceable, and cost-capable at the contract manufacturer.
* Work in PLM (BOMs, ECOs/ECNs, item and document release) and with contract manufacturers to enable builds, first article, and production ramp.
* Write requirements and test plans; plan and execute the testing needed to validate safety, function, and robustness of the design, including support of EMC/EMI bring-up and mitigation.
* Investigate issues and failures in the lab and at customer or manufacturing sites; lead containment and corrective design when the product is in the field or in ramp.
* Research and qualify electro-mechanical components (connectors, sensors, power devices, compute modules) for robotics / automation / automotive-class environments.
* Mentor electrical designers and raise the bar on reviews, documentation, and release quality.
* Travel to customer sites, CMs, and test houses to support bring-up, installation, and failure analysis as required.

**What you'll need**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline; advanced degree a plus.
* 12+ years of electrical design experience, with a record of taking products from concept to production.
* Expertise in Altium schematic capture and strong PCB layout design (or equivalent high-end ECAD with demonstrated willingness to work in Altium).
* Expertise in automation robotics and/or automotive platforms — mobile robots, AGVs/AMRs, or automotive electronic systems in harsh electrical and mechanical environments.
* Demonstrated system-level integration of electronics, not PCBA- or cable-only ownership: interconnect, grounding, power distribution, sensors, and partner-subsystem interfaces.
* Working knowledge of safety standards applied to automation and robotic platforms (ability to work with Functional Safety and interpret product safety requirements; prior SIL / ISO 13849 / IEC 61508 or equivalent experience a plus).
* Working knowledge of EMC/EMI and best design practices (grounding, filtering, shielding, return paths, cable and enclosure effects) and ability to debug to a passing result.
* Expertise in DfX and a track record of designs that contract manufacturers can build and test at volume.
* Familiar with a formal PDP / phase-gate process and able both to follow it and to lead a team through it.
* Familiar with PLM and with working through contract manufacturers to enable production (BOMs, ECOs, first article, process feedback).
* Ability to work in a results-oriented, project-driven team, prioritize across programs, and deliver quality under tight constraints.
* Strong interpersonal skills; works collaboratively with mechanical, firmware, test, operations, safety, and supply chain.

**Physical and Environment Requirements**

* Wilmington, MA (lab and cross-functional presence).
* 10% Travel to customer sites, CMs, and test facilities as required.

**About Symbotic**

Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end-to-end, AI-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food & beverage companies. Applyin

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid's proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our "Compromise Nothing™" approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what's possible and shape the future of mobility.

**Senior Controls Engineer – Motion Controls Architecture**

We are currently seeking a **Senior Controls Engineer** motivated by the application of control theory to achieve desired powertrain performance and vehicle dynamics.  
In this role, you will have the opportunity to architect and design control systems that help elevate vehicle ride and handling attributes via the actuation of motors, brakes, steering and the suspension system.  
Our ideal candidate exhibits a can-do attitude and approaches problem solving with vigor and determination. Candidates will be expected to demonstrate excellence in their respective fields, to possess the ability to learn quickly and to strive for perfection within a fast-paced environment.

**The Role:**

* Application of concepts in control theory to a variety of domains like vehicle longitudinal dynamics, handling dynamics, ride dynamics and NVH to achieve desired vehicle attributes

* Application of digital signal processing, digital controls and communication protocols to arrive at the best possible controls architecture on hardware and in software

* Employ linear analysis techniques and frequency domain analysis

* Perform system analysis of the controls architecture to identify noise factors and potential failure modes

* Develop requirements and related test cases for features modeled in Matlab/Simulink

* Assist integration of features into the controller code base

* Good understanding of vehicle handling and ride dynamics

* Good understanding of state estimation and sensor fusion techniques

* Expertise in control theory concepts like classical control theory, modern control theory, MRAC, non-linear control theory, robust control

jobs.title: Senior Android Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
**Position Description:**
  
We are seeking an experienced Android Full-Stack Engineer to join our platform stability team. In this role, you will be responsible for diagnosing, debugging, and resolving complex Android stability issues spanning the entire Android stack both above (System Partition) and below (Vendor Partition) the Treble boundary. You will work deep within Android framework internals, reverse-engineering issues from source code, providing technical direction for ambiguous problems, and ensuring overall platform robustness across Android version upgrades. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who thrives on solving the hardest, least-understanding problems in the Android ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and develop middleware and Android background services for platform-level functionality
* Debug and reverse-engineer complex issues directly from Android Open-Source Project (AOSP) source code Own overall Android platform stability and reliability
* Resolve Android upgrade and integration issues across releases
* Diagnose and fix bugs in system server components (Activity Manager, Window Manager, Package Manager, etc.), Car Service, and Surface Flinger
* Investigate and resolve black screen, boot failure, and ANR (Application Not Responding) issues 6. Resolve and provide technical direction and root-cause analysis for unknown or hard-to-reproduce issues
* Address and resolve compliance test failures across CTS, VTS, ATS, and STS

**Primary Skills Required:** Kotlin, C++ and Java

**Experience Required:**

* 3+ years of hands-on Android platform/framework development experience.
* Proven experience in designing and developing middleware and Android background services (long-running/foreground service) that expose feature-rich interfaces (AIDL/Binder, APIs) to applications.
* Demonstrated track record of resolving complex, low-level Android stability issues.
* Experience contributing to or modifying AOSP source code
* Proven experience working across the full Android stack (framework, native services, vendor layers)

**Additional Experience Preferred:**

* Experience with Android Automotive OS (AAOS) and Car Service.
* Familiarity with HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) and vendor integration.
* Experience with CTS, VTS, ATS, and STS compliance frameworks.
* Knowledge of Android graphics stack and display subsystems
* Experience with native debugging tools (gdb, lldb, perfetto, systrace, logcat analysis).
* Familiarity with Android build systems (Soong/Make) and partition architecture.
* Experience working with SoC/silicon vendors on platform bring-up

**Additional Context for Suppliers:**

* This role requires a deep-dive, problem-solving mindset and the ability to operate independently on ambiguous, high-impact issues.
* The ideal candidate is comfortable being the technical authority for the most challenging stability problems and can provide direction for other engineers.
* Experience in the automotive or embedded Android domain is a strong plus given to our focus on system server, car service and platform stability.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Role Summary**
----------------

The **Systems Engineer** is an entry-level engineering position supporting the development, integration, and validation of automotive 12V electrical systems and components.

In this role, you will work closely with experienced system, component, and validation engineers to set up, coordinate, perform, monitor, and document both vehicle-level and laboratory validation testing. Key responsibilities include preparing engineering work orders, supporting the development of validation test plans and procedures, collecting and analyzing empirical test data, and assisting with the root-cause investigation and resolution of vehicle electrical system issues.

This position covers components and subsystems within the low-voltage power domain, including:

* 12V lead-acid batteries (Flooded and AGM technologies)
* Alternators and intelligent charging systems
* DC/AC power inverters
* Battery Monitoring Sensors (BMS) and smart sensing devices
* Power control relays and related power switching hardware

**Key Responsibilities & Deliverables**
---------------------------------------

### **Systems Integration & Laboratory Validation**

* **Validation Setup & Testing:** Set up, execute, and monitor laboratory bench tests and vehicle-level validation procedures for 12V power components and systems.
* **Documentation & Work Orders:** Prepare engineering work orders (EWOs), author test reports, and document detailed validation results against technical performance specifications.
* **Data Collection & Analysis:** Collect, process, and analyze electrical measurement data (voltage, current, thermal, network signal logs) to verify functional compliance.

### **Root-Cause Analysis & Issue Resolution**

* **Troubleshooting:** Assist lead engineers with identifying, logging, and resolving electrical system anomalies, parasitic draws, and communication errors during vehicle testing.
* **Requirements & Test Plan Support:** Collaborate with cross-functional teams to continuously refine test procedures, acceptance criteria, and environmental test profiles.

### **Basic Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related engineering discipline from an accredited university.
* **Experience Level:** 0–2 years of engineering experience (entry-level or applicable engineering internship/co-op experience).
* **Technical Fundamentals:**

  + Fundamental understanding of electrical circuits, Ohm's law, DC power distribution, and component-level electronics.
  + Hands-on experience with standard electrical measurement equipment (multimeters, oscilloscopes, current clamps, data acquisition systems).
  + Interest or background in automotive 12V power management, battery technology, and charging logic.
* **Core Skills:**

  + Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  + Excellent written and verbal communication skills for documenting technical reports.
  + High accountability and eager to learn in a hands-on, fast-paced vehicle testing environment.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with automotive vehicle testing, bench testing, or vehicle electrical troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with automotive vehicle communication networks (CAN, LIN).
* Knowledge of lead-acid battery chemistries (Flooded/AGM), charging strategies, or DC/AC power conversion.
* Experience writing or executing test plans and validation scripts.
* Background in MATLAB, Python, CANoe/CANalyzer, or similar data analysis and signal-logging tools.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Lead the design, development, board layout, testing, and system integration of complex printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) and custom hardware components.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

· Hardware Architecture & Circuit Design: Design digital, analog, mixed-signal, and power distribution hardware architectures. Select components, perform worst-case analyses, use design tools such as Altium Designer or KiCad.

· System Design and Integration: Inform design and product management using application requirements for target markets, competing and complimentary power electronics products, and downstream system standards and requirements.

· PCB Layout & Routing: Perform or directly supervise multi-layer PCB layouts, taking into account signal integrity (SI), power integrity (PI), thermal management, and strict Design for Manufacturing/Assembly (DFM/DFA) guidelines.

· Prototyping & Board Bring-Up: Lead hands-on assembly, testing, debugging, and verification of initial hardware prototypes using laboratory equipment (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, dynamic loads).

· Firmware & Software Collaboration: Partner closely with embedded firmware, software, and mechanical engineering teams to define interface protocols, pinouts, mechanical enclosures, and system test points.

· Regulatory & Compliance: Design for Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC/EMI), ESD protection, and environmental compliance (UL, CE, FCC, RoHS). Prepare and support hardware for third-party compliance testing.

· Manufacturing & Supply Chain Support: Generate comprehensive manufacturing documentation (Gerber files, drill charts, BOMs, schematic PDF packages, assembly drawings). Collaborate with vendors and contract manufacturers (CMs) to resolve component obsolescence or DFM issues.

· Collaboration & Quality Standards: Establish and promote internal hardware design standards, review peer schematics and PCB layouts, work with support teams to perform analysis and troubleshooting on products in the field, and mentor junior engineers.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

· Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE), Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.

· 5+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in electronics engineering and hardware development.

· Proven track record of designing, layout routing, and releasing multi-layer PCBs (4+ layers, high-speed routing, controlled impedance, thermal management, and/or rigid-flex experience preferred).

· Proficiency in industry-standard schematic capture and PCB layout tools (e.g., Altium Designer, Cadence Allegro, KiCAD, PADS).

· Advanced proficiency with bench tools including digital storage oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and precision multimeters.

· Solid understanding of common hardware protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, Ethernet, USB, PCIe) and power supply architectures (buck/boost regulators, LDOs, battery management).

· Demonstrated understanding of IPC standards (IPC-2221, IPC-A-610), manufacturing processes, component sourcing, and Gerber generation.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

● Experience with wireless standard implementations (Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, LoRa, or Cellular hardware integration).

● Knowledge of signal integrity (SI) and power integrity (PI) simulation tools (e.g., Ansys, HyperLynx).

● Scripting capability (Python, C/C++) for laboratory test automation and hardware validation.

● Prior experience working in regulated industries (automotive, aerospace, medical devices, or energy storage).

**Robotics Engineer**

*Robotic Manipulation and Embodied AI*

Richtech Robotics is seeking a Robotics Engineer to develop and deploy autonomous robotic systems. This role combines strong robotics fundamentals with hands-on experience in vision-guided manipulation, vision-language-action (VLA) models, and world models. You will own complete workflows, from perception and motion planning to execution on real hardware, and improve their accuracy, reliability, and ability to handle changing conditions.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop manipulation workflows for grasping, pick-and-place, assembly, and interaction with equipment.
* Implement and optimize forward and inverse kinematics (IK), coordinate transforms, motion planning, collision avoidance, and trajectory execution; resolve reachability, singularity, and joint-limit issues.
* Build vision-guided robotics pipelines using RGB or depth cameras, object detection, segmentation, 6D pose estimation, camera calibration, hand-eye calibration, and tool center point (TCP) calibration.
* Integrate robot arms, grippers, cameras, sensors, and device APIs into reliable systems with feedback, fault handling, and recovery.
* Collect and prepare robot demonstration data; train or fine-tune VLA policies and evaluate their performance in simulation and on physical robots.
* Develop and evaluate world models or learned dynamics models for predicting action outcomes, planning, or improving robot learning.
* Measure task success, positioning error, cycle time, and robustness; diagnose failures across perception, calibration, control, and learned policies, and support deployment.

**Required qualifications**

* Master's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field
* Demonstrated ownership of working robotic manipulation systems deployed and tested on physical hardware.
* Strong understanding of kinematics, rigid-body transformations, robot control, motion planning, and the relationship between perception accuracy and manipulation performance.
* Hands-on experience with vision-guided robotics, including calibration and converting camera observations into executable robot motions.
* Practical VLA experience covering dataset preparation, model training or fine-tuning, inference integration, and evaluation beyond a pretrained demo.
* Hands-on experience implementing or adapting world models or learned dynamics models, with experiments that assess their usefulness for robotics tasks.
* Strong Python and C++ skills, experience with ROS 2 and Linux, and proficiency with PyTorch or an equivalent learning framework.
* Ability to turn research into tested implementations, debug across software and hardware, and document results clearly.

**Preferred experience**

Experience with Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or equivalent simulators; simulation-to-real transfer; imitation or reinforcement learning; force or impedance control; and mobile or dual-arm manipulation.

**Application materials:** Please include project examples, videos, code, or publications that show your individual contribution, the hardware used, measured results, and how you resolved failures.

Pay: $80,000.00 - $100,000.00 per year

Benefits:

Led by Founder & CEO, Rob Roy, we believe in revolutionary innovation, operational excellence and the principle of karma. Switch is where talented people come together to EVOLVE the digital world.

**The Role: Controls Engineer III**

As a Controls Engineer III, you lead deployment, programming, optimization, and support of Building Management Systems across Switch data centers. You own complex controls projects from design through commissioning. You ensure systems operate reliably, efficiently, and in compliance with safety and change management standards. This role requires strong HVAC controls expertise and independent technical judgment in mission-critical environments.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop and implement sequences of operation for HVAC and power-related control systems.
* Program, install, and commission BMS control devices and supporting infrastructure.

* Maintain BMS databases, graphics, trends, and technical documentation.

jobs.description:
At Nestlé Health Science, we believe that nutrition, science, and wellness must merge, not collide. Here, we embrace the intrinsic connections of these three pillars, harnessing their collective strength to empower healthier lives. Our broad product portfolio includes renowned brands like Garden of Life®, Nature's Bounty®, Vital Proteins®, Orgain®, Nuun®, BOOST®, Carnation Breakfast Essentials®, Peptamen®, Compleat Organic Blends®, and more. We also have extensive pharmaceutical expertise, offering innovative medicines that aim to prevent, manage, and treat gastrointestinal and metabolic-related diseases.

At Nestlé Health Science, we bring our best for better lives. Our people are challenged to bring fresh, diverse views and make bold moves to empower healthier lives through nutrition. We know brilliant ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. Here we embrace the entrepreneurial spirit and collaborate with teams that champion focused and forward thinking. We are committed to fostering professional growth and celebrating the achievements of our people along the way. We offer dynamic career paths, robust development, opportunities to learn from talented colleagues around the globe, and benefits that support physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

Join us to innovate for impact and reimagine the future of health and nutrition for patients and consumers.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

As a Lead Digital and Automation Engineer at Nestlé Nutrition & Health, your mission is to identify, develop and scale automation and digital manufacturing solutions that strengthen performance across the Nutrition & Health manufacturing network. At our R&D center in Bridgewater, US, we develop science-proven nutrition products, processes and packaging, while providing technical support to Nestlé Nutrition & Health factories worldwide. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with factory, engineering, quality, operations, research and development, digital and automation teams, technology partners and strategic suppliers. This is an opportunity to grow your expertise and deliver meaningful results that help improve lives through nutrition innovation worldwide. You can expect travel both domestically and internationally up to 30% of the time.

**JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Leading the identification, development, technical support and global deployment of digital manufacturing and automation solutions that improve reliability, efficiency and operational performance across factories.
* Driving the standardization and continuous improvement of automation, process control, manufacturing execution systems and operational technology solutions across Nutrition and Health sites.
* Building strong partnerships with factories, project teams and technology suppliers to turn emerging automation and digital technologies into scalable business value.
* Delivering expert guidance in the field of electrical, automation and digital for investment projects, from design and commissioning to qualification, validation and handover to operations.
* Enabling secure, reliable and actionable manufacturing data through data integration and engineering initiatives that support digital transformation.
* Coaching teams and sharing best practices that strengthen digital and automation capabilities across a global manufacturing community.

**EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS**

* Bringing strong expertise in automation, process control and digital technologies applied to manufacturing, supported by a Master’s, Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Engineering with a background in automation and digital technologies.

**EXPERIENCE & SKILLS REQUIREMENTS**

* 8+ years of experience in automation, process control, digital manufacturing solutions, AI and robotics, manufacturing execution systems (DMO/MES), and digital engineering, preferably within manufacturing or food industry environments.
* Use solid knowledge of process mastery applications, control system platforms such as Rockwell, Wonderware or AVEVA, and process simulation tools Siemens SIMIT / Tecnomatix to strengthen operational performance.
* Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams to deliver engineering projects, commissioning, start-up and continuous improvement in manufacturing facilities, ideally within aseptic Ready to Drink and Oral Solid Dose (VMS) supplement manufacturing processes.
* Demonstrate courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer I
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  
What it’s like to be a Systems Engineer beginning your career within BAE Systems? Rewarding. As part of our Systems Engineering team, you will be designing. Integrating and testing the world’s most advanced communication systems for the United States DoD and international customers. You will be among the brightest minds, working on the aerospace and defense industry’s most difficult problems. Drawing strength from our differences, we’re innovating for the future. And you can, too.
  
  
Sound like a team you want to be a part of? We are seeking an entry level systems engineer to fill a variety of systems engineering positions based on your educational background. An exciting future at BAE Systems awaits and it starts with Year One— a unique experience to jumpstart your engineering career.
  
  
With a 9/80 schedule, and every other Friday off, our flexible work environment provides you a chance to change the world without giving up your personal life. We put our customers first – exemplified by our missions: “We Protect Those Who Protect Us®” and “We Innovate For Those Who Move The World™.”
  
  
For those candidates in their first year after graduation, BAE Systems’ Year One experience provides recent college graduates with a unique opportunities to jumpstart their engineering career. The program offers opportunities to gain diverse experience in different aspects of the discipline and company. You also develop skills by receiving immediate mentorship from experienced managers and engineers, and participate in classes and workshops to expand your knowledge of yourself, technology and our company. Finally, you network and collaborate to make lasting connections with peers, co-workers and leadership.
  
  
We offer competitive compensation, and an excellent benefits package that includes tuition reimbursement for advanced degrees.
  
  
Because of the need for consistent, in-person collaboration and/or the requirement to perform all work onsite due to the nature of this particular role, it will be performed fulltime on site. This means work will be conducted on location at a BAE Systems facility 100% of the time.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* BS Degree in Electrical, Computer, Systems or Aerospace Engineering
* Must be eligible to obtain security clearance
* Ability to utilize effective technical skills and desire to take on increased roles.
* Demonstrate organizational skills and collaborative nature.
* Ability to work independently and in partnership with others
  

  
  
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* MSEE, or other advanced degree
* Internship with a technology based company
* Familiarity with MSBE
* Familiarity with system analysis techniques such as link budget, latency, calibration, timing and synchronization
* Familiarity with digital and/or RF test equipment (e.g. Keysight, Tektronix)
  

  
  
**Pay Information**
  
Full-Time Salary Range: $70828 - $120408
  
  
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
  
  
Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.  
  
  
  
**About BAE Systems, Inc.**
  
BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.
  
  
Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.

----------------

  

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

* Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwide

* Generous vacation, strong medical and other benefits, competitive 401k, learning opportunities, relocation assistance and amenities aimed at creating a solid work/life balance\*

World-changing technologies. Life-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov

Our team is seeking a highly motivated Research and Development Systems Engineer. You will work closely with a multi-disciplinary staff and team to include software engineers, electronic engineers, and Microwave Engineers. As part of Sandia's Electronic Warfare initiatives, you will work closely with managers, other project leads/engineers, teams and customer to help with planning, requirements, integration and communications. At any given time, you may be asked to help update development backlogs, plan for upcoming releases, support strategic initiatives and work to coordinate and integrate tasks across a team to meet project deliverables.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

* Employ an agile engineering approach that supports the integration and testing of Electronic Warfare (EW) Systems
* Support the representation of the EW Systems with customer organizations and operational organizations.
* Track and document development progress for the EW System Development.
* Coordinate with project leads and technical staff in the activities needed to develop, test, and deploy EW systems.
* Integrate and coordinate with external stakeholders for the testing and operations of EW systems

$117,500 - $235,700

**Qualifications We Require**
-----------------------------

* A Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline and five (5) years of directly relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of directly relevant education and engineering or scientific experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and ability to perform independent research and development

**Qualifications We Desire**

jobs.title: High Voltage Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Install, commission, service, and troubleshoot advanced industrial X-ray inspection systems — in-house and at customer sites worldwide. You'll be the primary technical contact for customers, working with a cross-disciplinary engineering team (mechanical, electrical, software, imaging) to keep high-voltage systems running safely and reliably.

**What You'll Do**

* Install and commission industrial X-ray systems: setup, beam alignment, geometric calibration, detector integration
* Commission microfocus open-tube systems — tube conditioning, vacuum validation — plus imaging software and CT acquisition setup
* Run Factory and Site Acceptance Testing (FAT/SAT)
* Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on microfocus X-ray sources, high-voltage generators (90kV–450kV), and LINAC systems, plus HV power supplies, cooling, vacuum, and motion subsystems
* Diagnose arcing, beam instability, focal spot drift, vacuum failures, and HV breakdown; perform root cause analysis and corrective action
* Troubleshoot HV, control, and electromechanical subsystems using oscilloscopes, multimeters, and diagnostic software
* Handle radiation safety: surveys, leakage testing, interlock verification, regulatory inspection support
* Train customer operators and maintenance staff; provide phone/email/remote support; maintain service documentation
Support system upgrades and retrofits  

**Must-Haves**

* Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Applied Physics, or related field
* 5+ years servicing industrial X-ray systems, high-voltage systems, and/or vacuum technology
* Hands-on experience with at least one of: microfocus X-ray sources, HV generators (90kV–450kV), or LINAC systems
* Ability to read electrical schematics and technical drawings
* Diagnostic tool experience (oscilloscopes, digital multimeters)
* Working knowledge of radiation safety practices and regulatory compliance
* U.S. citizen, able to pass background/security checks for government and military site clearance
* Clean, valid driver's license; able to pass a drug test
* Comfortable lifting/installing components of 55+ lbs and working around high-voltage and radiation-generating equipment
  

  

**Nice-to-Haves**

* NDT, DR, or CT inspection system service experience
* Vacuum systems (turbo/roughing pumps), motion control, or industrial automation
* CE/UL regulatory compliance; LINAC RF/accelerator systems
Embedded/microcontroller troubleshooting, soldering, MRP/ERP basics

jobs.title: Lead Controls Software Engineer
jobs.description:
As a member of this world class team, the Lead Controls Engineer will lead and execute the protection and control aspects of Flexible AC (Alternating Current) Transmission System (FACTS) projects. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, testing, start-up and commissioning of the protection and control aspects of Fixed Series Capacitors(FSC) and Synchronous Condenser (SC) solutions within GE Vernova’s Flexible AC Transmission Systems(FACTS) portfolio.

**Job Description**
===================

**Position Overview:**

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Lead Controls Software Engineer to join our GSI FACTS Controls Software team in Saratoga Springs, NY. In this role, you will lead the design and implementation of advanced control systems for Synchronous Condensers, which provide inertia, steady state and dynamic support to the power system.

  
  

The Lead Controls Engineer will bring expertise in power system controls, strong experience with simulation and real-time testing in both the lab and field, the ability to lead and mentor a team of engineers, and interface with customers and cross-functional stakeholders.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design, development, and implementation of control systems for FACTS devices, including power generation, transmission, and distribution.
* Participate in the testing and validation of control systems, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including electrical engineers, software developers, and project managers, to ensure the successful integration of control systems.
* Prepare technical documentation, including design specifications, test plans, and user manuals.
* Conduct system modeling, simulation, and analysis to optimize control strategies and improve system performance.
* Develop and maintain coding libraries for both system software and HMI.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and support their professional development.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to control systems.
* Stay current with the latest advancements in control systems engineering and power systems technology.
* Support business development activities by providing technical expertise and contributing to proposal development.
* Participate in Lean training and lead Lean initiatives
* Lead problem solving efforts for field issues, using tools such as Root Cause Analysis or Problem Solving Reports.
  

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, control systems engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum of 4 years of experience in control systems engineering, with a focus on power transmission systems.
  

  

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Must be able to work in the FACTS office 4 days per week located in Saratoga Springs, NY. No fully remote options available for this role.
* Ability and willingness to travel 20% of the time, including international, and must comply with all relevant company travel and tax policies.
  

  

**Desired Characteristics:**

* Strong knowledge of control theory, power system dynamics, and real-time control systems.
* Proficient with GE Vernova’s MarkVIe product family including Toolbox ST and Cimplicity software (SCADA)
* Familiar with GE Vernova Excitation systems, such as EX2100E
* Expert in PLC programming
* Experience with industrial/utility-grade protection relays and protective relaying coordination
* Working knowledge of grid interconnection requirements (NERC/FERC)
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think analytically and strategically.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* Proven track record of successfully leading and managing engineering projects.
* Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

jobs.title: Data and Systems Engineer - IndyCar
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
====================

Team Penske is seeking a Data & Systems Engineer to join our IndyCar engineering group, with responsibility for electronic, communications, and data acquisition systems across the race car and engineering operation. The role combines hands-on operation and maintenance with systems integration and continuous improvement.

The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting on-track performance through the development and reliability of vehicle electronics, sensors, telemetry, data systems, and engineering tools. Working closely with race engineers, performance engineers, mechanics, IT, and external suppliers, this individual will contribute to race operations, testing, development programs, and long-term technology initiatives.

This is a hands-on engineering position that combines electrical systems, data acquisition, diagnostics, software tools, and vehicle performance support.

**Primary Responsibilities**
============================

**Data, Vehicle Systems, and Electronics**
------------------------------------------

* Develop, maintain, and support all vehicle data acquisition, telemetry, and engineering systems to ensure accurate, reliable, and actionable performance data throughout race and test operations.
* Support vehicle preparation, sensor calibration, and systems validation throughout assembly & operation
* Specify, evaluate, and integrate sensors, electronic hardware, data systems, and related technologies in collaboration with suppliers and technical partners.
* Develop engineering hardware and software tools including test equipment, fixtures, harnesses, analysis utilities, reporting systems, and automated workflows that improve engineering efficiency, system reliability, and data accessibility.
* Design and maintain electrical schematics, wiring standards, communication architectures, validation processes, and engineering documentation.
* Participate in engineering meetings, assembly meetings, technical reviews, and long-term technology planning.

**Race & Test Support**
-----------------------

* Support race and test operations as a member of the traveling engineering group.
* Monitor vehicle systems and diagnose issues during race weekends, tests, simulator sessions, and development activities.
* Analyze system health, communications, and data quality throughout all engineering sessions to identify reliability and data-quality issues.
* Partner with IT to manage, maintain, and continuously improve trackside technology infrastructure, including timing stands, telemetry systems, radio communications, networking hardware, and engineering workstations.
* Conduct field repairs for any vehicle and support equipment electronics and wiring
* Support fuel strategy calculations and race operations through accurate collection and analysis of performance data.
* Contribute to development testing, wind tunnel testing, simulator activities, and special engineering projects.

**Development Projects**
------------------------

* Lead assigned engineering projects from concept through implementation.
* Document testing methodologies, calibration procedures, and engineering standards.
* Work collaboratively across vehicle performance, simulation, software, and systems engineering disciplines.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve vehicle reliability, data quality, operational efficiency, and engineering workflows.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Strong understanding of electrical systems, sensors, data acquisition, vehicle electronics, and communication networks.
* Experience troubleshooting complex systems using a structured, analytical engineering approach.
* Experience working with engineering data and interpreting vehicle and system performance.
* Understanding of CAN networks, communications protocols, and electronic diagnostics.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced engineering environment.
* Ability to travel and support race and testing operations.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience in professional motorsports (IndyCar, NASCAR, IMSA, Formula One, Formula E, WEC, or equivalent).
* Experience with Cosworth, MoTeC, McLaren, Bosch, or similar motorsport electronics and data systems.
* Practical experience with CAN communication, including CANalyzer, CANoe, or related tools.
* Proficiency with MATLAB, Simulink, Python, LabVIEW, or similar engineering software.
* Experience developing engineering software tools, automation scripts, or data analysis workflows.
* Familiarity with databases, Power BI, engineering dashboards, or data reporting systems.
* Experience with telemetry systems, radio communications, and trackside networking.
* Experience designing circuit boards, test fixtures, and embedded electronic devices.
* Experience with Arduino, Raspberry Pi, microcontrollers, or rapid prototyping platforms.
* CAD experience including Siemens NX, CATIA, SolidWorks, or similar platforms.
* Motorsport wiring and motorsport electrical assembly experience.

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

AECOM is seeking a **Senior Industrial Electrical Engineer** to lead power system designs for large-scale manufacturing facilities within our Advanced Manufacturing practice. This role is responsible for the design and coordination of facility electrical infrastructure, including utility interconnections, medium-voltage distribution, process equipment power systems, and reliability planning. Working directly with clients, utilities, equipment vendors, and multidisciplinary teams, you will provide technical leadership from concept development through construction, commissioning, and energization. Our project portfolio includes semiconductor, battery, energy and nuclear fuel, defense, and aerospace sectors.

* Design power quality and reliability systems: UPS, voltage-sag ride-through (SEMI F47), standby generation, parallelling generators, BESS and redundant (N+1, 2N) architectures.

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering and 6 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of education and/or experience.

jobs.description:

You want to make an impact in the world. At Eaton, we’re solving some of the toughest challenges on the planet. Our Early Career Programs open up an exciting world of opportunities for you to make a difference on a global scale. Your assignments are more than tasks and busy work; they're your chance to drive innovation in intelligent power management and shape the future of our company. You'll team up with seasoned leaders, gaining diverse experiences that'll drive you forward to define and reach your career goals.

**What sets our Early Career Programs apart:**

* **Personalized Program Experience:** We’re committed to energizing your career and empowering your impact. No two participants share the same experience or set of responsibilities.
* **Global Perspectives:** Diverse work locations and comprehensive customer portfolios are a required part of the adventure, enhancing your learning and maximizing program benefits.
* **Role Exploration:** Gain insight into various careers within Eaton through extensive services that ensure safe, efficient, and reliable power systems at every stage.
* **Strategic Networking:** Benefit from networking and mentorship opportunities within one of North America's largest and most experienced power distribution service organizations.
* **Tangible Learning:** See firsthand how Eaton is powering the future of Power Distribution through real world application and customer service.
* **In a Power System Controls role,** you’ll develop automation and control solutions for systems powering critical infrastructure, from concept through commissioning. You’ll work on complex control architectures and real-world applications, building technical expertise in programming, system design, and implementation.

**It’s time to make connections, get energized, and power ahead.**

Eaton provides a competitive total rewards package commensurate with applicable skills, knowledge, and experience and consistent with internal and external market practices. The annual salary for this role is $82,000 with a one-time $6,000 signing bonus.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

**Position Overview:**

**Eaton's Electrical Services & Systems** team offers a comprehensive portfolio of services tailored for every stage of a power system’s life cycle—whether it’s design, build, or support. Our services integrate and optimize the elements of a power system to make sure it’s aligned with business goals. We can help keep your power system safe, efficient, reliable, and up-to-date.

The **Power Systems Solution** group is a full-service systems integrator with the capabilities to integrate the necessary equipment and technologies, to provide a complete, power automation solution. This team of engineers and technicians brings extensive skills and experiences with a variety of leading HMI software packages enabling us to design graphically rich, easy-to-use operator interfaces that take advantage of the latest standalone or web-based technologies. Our experience transcends a multitude of equipment manufacturers, software packages, and network architectures, including all major OEMs HMI’s and components. We offer single point responsibility, a high level of engineering and systems integration expertise, and a unified focus on cost effective solutions, seamless integration, HMI development, energy management tools, and professional turnkey system design and implementation.

**In this role, you will:**

  

* Program Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC’s)
* Write and deploy complex power transfer and other control schemes including Main-Tie-Main transfer schemes, load shedding/ peak shaving schemes, breaker control schemes, SCADA system development, and generator control.
* Validate system contains proper controls, metering and monitoring. Controls include Power meters, automation equipment (PLC/HMI), protective relays, load sharing, synchronization, etc. per approved drawing package while in factory setting.
* Support customer-facing system startup and commissioning efforts.

This role is designed to prepare you for both technical and future leadership roles at Eaton. As a new engineer, you will be provided with a structured training and development curriculum; a blend of instructor-led, virtual classrooms, eLearning courses, and on-the-job training provided by expert mentors and team members to assist you in developing your career.

**Team Benefits:**

  

* Guaranteed 40-hour base pay, eligible for premium pay and travel premiums
* Career growth, mentorship and safety training
* Company vehicle, toolkit, and phone
* Tuition assistance for ongoing learning
* Leads program with bonus pay
* Opportunities across 32 service branches

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Required (Basic) Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering from an accredited institution, with graduation date before August of 2027

We are seeking a motivated individual with strong instrumentation and controls experience to join our team as a Control Systems Engineer. The purpose of this position is to identify, recommend, and implement control and instrumentation changes to increase factory throughput and sugar recovery in addition to reducing processing costs. Optimize current automation of factory operations and assist in needs assessment, analysis, recommendation, development, and installation of future factory automation capital projects.

**The principal accountabilities of these positions include, but are not limited to:**

* Lead and promote a positive work culture through Company Values of Safety, Integrity, Quality, Teamwork, and Accountability.
* Designs instrumentation and control systems; develops the electrical design for batch and continuous process controls, specifications for process instrumentation, VFD, and control valves. Develops control systems documentation, including Process and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), loop wiring diagrams, specifications, manuals, PLC programs, and HMI configuration. This position works with OPC communication between factory and business systems and industrial device networks.
* Researches and recommends methods to enhance the utilization of automation and computer control systems. Consults with the Factory Engineer and/or Process Engineer on capital process improvements and make appropriate recommendations and program changes. Also consults with the Maintenance Engineer and Electrical & Instrumentation Supervisor regarding the maintenance of control systems and Process Engineers to achieve optimum processing efficiency. Provides technical expertise in the maintenance of control systems.

The automation of factory operations involves participation in the needs assessment analysis, recommendation, development, and installation of future factory automation capital projects. * Works with the factory maintenance and other engineers to analyze, recommend equipment specifications and selection, install new equipment, recommend process improvements, and debug processes. Evaluates projects and equipment to determine life cycle benefits and return-on-investment.

**About Fluidstack**
====================

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

  

**We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!**

**How We Operate**
==================

* **Be a barrel.** Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.
* **Insane urgency.** We drive everything forward as fast as possible.
* **Reason from first principles.** Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.
* **Love of the game.** The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.
* **Build something that actually matters.** If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

**The Production Engineering Team**
===================================

**Examples of key exciting problems the team is working on**

* **Turn every network fault from a mystery into a closed ticket:** link diagnostics across router-router and NIC-to-router paths, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows exactly what's broken and why. At this scale, debugging has to be systematic, not artisanal.
* **Build the network repair pipeline that runs itself:** from automated fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver lifecycle tracking, and return to service, across DC fabric, edge, and host-to-network layers. When a new site comes online every six months, manual repair doesn't keep up.
* **Build the network monitoring platform for a fleet that never stops growing:** define requirements, alerting lifecycle, and health dashboards from scratch, for infrastructure spanning multiple hyperscale sites today and 10s to 100s of GWs ahead. It doesn't exist yet. We're building it.

**Role Scope**
==============

* **Own network fleet health end to end.** Define the realtime monitoring requirements, build the alerting lifecycle, and ship the dashboards that give every on-call engineer a true picture of network state across all sites.
* **Build active debugging tooling.** Link diagnostics, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization — the tools that turn a network fault from a mystery into a solvable problem, fast.
* **Turn repair into a pipeline, not a procedure.** Build the automation that takes a network failure from detection through parts management and return to service. Ticket integration, repair lifecycle pipelines, transceiver and optics tracking — owned, not improvised.
* **Own network qualification and validation**. Build the frameworks that gate new sites and hardware into production. You define what a healthy network looks like before it carries traffic.
* **Own end-to-end reliability, scalability, and operation of the network at-scale.** Fluidstack is building one of the largest datacenter networks in the world and that can only be accomplished with aggressive automation, tooling, and incident discipline.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

**The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly,** **tell us where you would.**

* You treat toil as a bug. If diagnosing a link failure requires SSHing into boxes and running commands by hand, you build the tool that does it for you.
* You think in systems. You understand how a transceiver fault, a misconfigured route, and a power event each propagate differently — and you build tooling that can tell them apart.
* You move toward ambiguity, not away from it. You walk into the fog, build the map, and explain it to everyone else.
* You learn at a steep slope. You reach real competence in an unfamiliar domain fast. We value this over existing expertise.
* You carry a pager without flinching. You run the incident, write the postmortem, fix the systemic cause, and move on.
* You're fluent with AI tooling. LLM APIs, MCP servers

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Asylon is building the future of automated physical security

Founded by aerospace engineers out of MIT, Asylon exists to solve one of the world’s most fundamental problems: protecting people, property, and assets at scale. We design and deploy integrated robotics, software, and AI systems that operate continuously in the real world—where reliability is critical and failure is not an option. Our technology is already protecting lives and infrastructure every day.

The Asylon team brings deep roots in aerospace, defense, and mission-critical engineering, with experience spanning military aviation, naval defense platforms, and advanced commercial systems. That heritage shapes how we work: high standards, disciplined execution, and uncompromising integrity. We build and operate systems that deliver real outcomes for real customers.

We are assembling a team of engineers, operators, and leaders who want their work to matter—people who thrive in demanding environments, take pride in craftsmanship, and take ownership of results. At Asylon, you will help build category-defining technology, push the boundaries of what autonomous systems can do, and set the standard for an entirely new industry.

**Our Product - Automated Physical Security**

Our full-stack solution enables autonomous aerial and ground robots to operate persistently alongside human security teams—providing continuous situational awareness, rapid response capabilities, and actionable intelligence at scale. We believe the future of security is not humans or machines. It is humans + machines + AI working together—amplifying coverage, improving decision-making, and reducing risk.

Our platform transforms robots from experimental tools into dependable security assets. Deployed at customer sites today, Asylon systems conduct routine patrols, respond to incidents, and integrate directly into security operations—extending the reach of teams and fundamentally changing how physical security is delivered.

We are building the software infrastructure layer for the automated security economy. The work is exciting, and the mission is real.

**Position**

Asylon is looking for a software engineer to build and maintain the infrastructure services that power our robotic systems. You'll develop Kubernetes-based services that run on edge devices deployed with our robots, on on-prem servers in air-gapped customer environments, and in cloud infrastructure — handling everything from telemetry ingestion and fleet coordination to video processing and alerting. This role bridges the gap between cloud, on-prem, and the physical world — you should be comfortable writing backend services and have enough hardware awareness to understand the constraints and realities of deploying software on robots in the field.

Due to the nature of some projects worked on in this position, applicants must be a U.S. Citizens

**Primary duties include:**

* Design, develop, and maintain containerized services deployed via Kubernetes (K3s on edge, on-prem clusters in air-gapped environments, and managed clusters in cloud)
* Build and operate data pipelines for robot telemetry, video, and sensor data across edge, on-prem, and cloud environments
* Develop and maintain APIs and internal tooling used by robotics and operations teams
* Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting infrastructure to ensure system reliability across deployed fleets
* Collaborate with embedded and robotics engineers to define service interfaces and integration points between edge devices and cloud systems
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for service deployment, testing, and rollout
* Contribute to infrastructure-as-code for provisioning and managing cloud, on-prem, and edge resources
* Debug and resolve issues that span the full stack — from containerized services on a robot in the field to cloud backends

**Required Skills and Experience:**

* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience
* Strong with a high-level language such as Python, Java, Go, or Rust for building backend services and automation
* Proficient with Kubernetes, including deploying, debugging, and operating containerized workloads
* Familiar with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — provisioning infrastructure, managing services, and working with object storage, messaging, and databases. Some deployments run on-prem in air-gapped environments, so comfort working without cloud dependencies is a plus
* Background in CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, building, and deploying services
* Proficient with Linux as a development and deployment environment
* Comfortable with Git and collaborative development workflows

**Bonus Points**

* Exposure to K3s or lightweight Kubernetes on edge — running services on resource-constrained hardware in the field
* Has worked with robotics or IoT systems, particularly bridging edge devices and cloud infrastructure
* Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code tools such as OpenTofu, Terraform, Pulumi, or Ansible
* Familiarity with message brokers and streaming (MQTT, NATS, Kafka, or similar) for real-time data pipelines
* Experience with observability stacks — Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or similar monitoring and alerting tools
* Comfortable with networking fundamentals — DNS, firewalls, VPNs, and debugging connectivity issues between edge and cloud
* Has worked with video streaming or processing pipelines in a production environment
* Comfortable getting hands-on with hardware — you don't need to be an embedded expert, but you should be the kind of person who's built robots in a college club, tinkered with a Raspberry Pi, or isn't afraid to plug into a serial console and debug a device on a bench
* Experience with Bazel or similar build systems for managing complex, multi-language codebases

Salary Range: $105,000.00-150,000.00 per year

The salary range for this role is an estimate and reflects base salary only. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as experience

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Perry Weather**

Perry Weather is the weather safety standard for organizations that operate outdoors. We combine on-site weather hardware with a software platform that automates alerts, siren activations, and safety decisions for more than 3,000 organizations — from the PGA of America, the NFL, and MLB to Turner Construction, thousands of school districts, cities, and golf courses. We've grown 80%+ annually for five consecutive years, and are continuing to grow.

We're headquartered in Dallas at The Centrum, in the Oak Lawn neighborhood, where our teams work together every day to help organizations make faster and safer decisions when weather puts people, assets, and operations at risk.

**About the role**

Perry Weather builds field-deployed weather monitoring and outdoor warning hardware —lightning detection, weather sensors, sirens, and strobe warning units. These units run unattended on solar and battery power through extreme weather, and when something fails, it fails at a customer site, not on a bench.

We're hiring an Electrical Engineer to join and contribute to the hardware platform: PCB verification and manufacturing readiness, component sourcing and obsolescence management, power system design, and root-cause investigation when field hardware misbehaves.

**Responsibilities**

* **Schematic capture & PCB layout execution.** Work in Altium Designer on new revisions and design changes under the Staff Engineer's architectural review — not from a blank sheet, but with real ownership of the layout and component placement.
* **Impedance & DFM verification.** Confirm controlled-impedance nets (e.g. USB differential pairs at 90Ω, Ethernet at 100Ω) against fab documentation, and manage the CM / Fab House submission and review process — including catching placement/conversion errors in PnP/CPL files before they become a bad board run.
* **Component sourcing & BOM management.** When parts go obsolete or out of stock, find and validate drop-in or near-equivalent replacements (electrical spec + footprint), and keep the BOM current as revisions ship.
* **Power system design.** Prototype and characterize 12V/24V power architectures, select load-switch/eFuse ICs for new switched rails, and run battery/solar runtime characterization (current draw across operating modes, worst-case load estimation).
* **Protocol-level hardware integration.** Bring new sensors and peripherals onto the Custom PCB Carrier through its approved expansion interfaces — GPIO, Modbus RS-485, I²C, and Ethernet/IP — working within the platform's defined GPIO/bus budget rather than requesting ad hoc hardware revisions.
* **Field hardware RCA.** Reproduce field-reported hardware issues (siren/strobe not clearing, speaker output degradation, sensor readings out of range) on the bench using scopes, DMMs, and electronic loads/shunts, isolate root cause, and drive the fix into the next design or manufacturing revision.
* **Manufacturing process improvement.** Own discrete process problems end-to-end — e.g. grounding/ESD compliance fixes on the line, reducing manual bottlenecks in assembly/configuration steps, and building out the automated manufacturing test fixture (hardware harness + pass/fail criteria) the team doesn't have yet.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience.
* 5-7 years of hands-on electrical/hardware engineering, ideally on field-deployed products.
* Real experience in Altium Designer (or similar) for schematic capture and PCB layout — this should be work you've shipped, not coursework.
* Comfort verifying board designs against fab constraints: controlled impedance, differential pairs, power trace sizing.
* Experience selecting components from datasheets, including sourcing alternates under supply constraints.
* Working knowledge of power electronics fundamentals: regulation, load switching, battery/solar-powered system design.
* Practical familiarity with I²C, RS-485/Modbus, and Ethernet/IP at the level of integrating a real device, not just protocol theory.
* Bench instrumentation skills: oscilloscope, DMM, electronic load, and comfort measuring current/voltage under dynamic or switched load.
* Experience with root-cause analysis on returned or field-failed hardware.
* Direct experience working with contract manufacturers or PCB fab houses (DFM/DFT, build readiness, process improvement).

**Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with embedded C/C++ and embedded Linux (U-Boot, device tree, board bring-up) — useful for reading firmware well enough to help isolate whether a failure is hardware or firmware, not for owning the codebase.
* Exposure to OTA update/bootloader concepts.
* Experience with cellular modems (Quectel or similar).
* Basic scripting (Python) for test automation or tooling.
* Exposure to outdoor/ruggedized enclosure design, solar/battery systems, or safety-critical/regulated hardware.

**Benefits**

* **You'll want to come into the office.** Our Oak Lawn office isn't just a place to sit — it's where ideas move fast and culture stays strong. The whole team is here Monday through Friday, which means real collaboration, no chasing people down over Slack, and a genuinely fun place to spend your work days.
* **Your wellbeing is covered.** Competitive health insurance, 401(k) with employer matching, and a full suite of voluntary benefits, because you shouldn't have to think twice about the basics.
* **Good people, good times.** Monthly All-Hands, Office Olympics, happy hours, and more. We take the work seriously and the culture seriously too.
* **You're getting in early, and that matters.** We're growing fast, but the biggest opportunities are still ahead. The people joining now will help shape what Perry Weather becomes.
