**Description**
---------------

**Sr Principal Modeling Engineer**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced RF GaN Transistor Modeling Engineer to join our Modeling Team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the analysis, and development of accurate and predictive compact and behavioral models for Gallium Nitride (GaN) High Electron Mobility Transistors (HEMTs) used in high-frequency and high-power applications. This role involves close collaboration with process engineers, circuit designers, and product development teams to ensure our GaN technologies meet the highest performance and reliability standards for next-generation wireless communication systems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Device Characterization:** Define on-wafer and packaged device characterization plans, including DC, capacitance-voltage (CV), small-signal RF (S-parameters), noise, and large-signal measurements (e.g., load-pull, pulsed I-V).
* **Model Development & Extraction:** Develop and refine accurate, physics-based compact models for GaN HEMTs using industry-standard modeling tools and techniques (e.g., MVSG, ASM-HEMT, Angelov).
* **Simulation & Validation:** Utilize TCAD and circuit simulation tools (e.g., Keysight ADS, Cadence AWR/Spectre, Synopsys, Silvaco) to perform simulations, analyze data, and validate model accuracy against hardware measurements.
* **PDK Development:** Collaborate with the PDK Team and provide support for both internal and external customers.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with process engineers to link device performance to fabrication parameters, with reliability engineers to understand long-term device stability, and with circuit designers to ensure models meet their design requirements.
* **Analysis & Troubleshooting:** Conduct in-depth analysis of test data, identify device or measurement issues, and propose solutions for performance and yield improvement.
* **Documentation & Reporting:** Prepare detailed technical reports, documentation, and application notes for model usage and limitations.
* **Innovation & Mentorship:** Research and develop novel modeling solutions and characterization techniques, and mentor junior engineers or team members.

**Required Experience and Skills**
----------------------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** Master's or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, or a related field with a focus on semiconductor devices.
* **Experience:** 15+ years of experience in semiconductor device characterization and modeling, specifically with RF GaN HEMT technologies.
* **Technical Skills:**
  + Deep theoretical and practical understanding of GaN device physics and materials science.
  + Proficiency with RF characterization equipment (network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, load-pull systems, probe stations).

**Desired Experience and Skills**
---------------------------------

* Expertise in industry-standard RF simulation and modeling tools (Keysight ADS, Cadence AWR, TCAD tools, etc.).
Strong programming and data analysis skills (e.g., Python, MATLAB, C++) for automation and data interpretation.

===========================

**Firefly Aerospace is a space and defense technology company that enables our world to launch, land, and operate in space – anywhere, anytime. As the partner of choice for critical space missions, Firefly is the only commercial company to launch a satellite to orbit with 24-hour notice and the only company to achieve a successful Moon landing. Firefly Electrical Engineers in the Interconnect team are responsible for developing the electrical wiring interconnect systems (EWIS) that distribute power and electrical signals within avionics hardware, instrumentation, and payloads. In this role, you will work in small, collaborative groups through all stages of the component and system design, manufacturing, and testing. Additionally, you will take ownership of your projects and collaborate with the team to conduct the design, analysis, manufacturing, testing, and final integration of components on launch vehicles and spacecraft.

jobs.title: Test Systems Engineer, Test Excellence
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

  

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

  
  

**What We Offer**

  

Salary:

$116,000.00 - $159,500.00

Location:

Austin,TX, Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits .

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Find the test gaps that matter.** Use field failures, factory nonconformances, failure analysis, 8D findings, FMEA/FMECA risks, and test data to identify where existing assurance methods failed to detect risk before shipment.
* **Translate failure mechanisms into testable requirements.** Convert complex failure signatures and real-world operating conditions into specific, measurable, and defensible requirements that engineering teams and suppliers can execute.
* **Engineer system-representative test coverage.** Define the functional, parametric, stress, burn-in, thermal, RF, high-voltage, leak, particle, interlock, and other tests needed to expose targeted failure modes before they reach an Applied factory or customer.
* **Challenge assumptions with evidence.** Question legacy test methods, inherited limits, and accepted practices when they are not supported by data. Use engineering judgment, structured problem solving, and experimentation to determine what the evidence requires.
* **Own the test solution from concept through sustained deployment.** Evaluate feasibility, develop the technical concept, define the specification and statement of work, establish cost and schedule, and lead design, sourcing, build, bring-up, validation, and production implementation.
* **Prove that the test works.** Establish correlation, repeatability, reproducibility, measurement capability, calibration requirements, and acceptance criteria. Demonstrate with objective evidence that the solution detects the intended failure mode under production-representative conditions.
* **Deploy capability where it prevents the greatest risk.** Bring test systems into operation at suppliers and Applied factories. Resolve implementation issues, coordinate engineering changes, and ensure the solution is practical, scalable, and ready for production use.
* **Preserve test effectiveness throughout the lifecycle.** Establish the preventive-maintenance, calibration, out-of-tolerance response, configuration control, data retention, and performance-monitoring requirements necessary to keep deployed test systems reliable and effective.
* **Measure outcomes, not activity.** Monitor detection effectiveness, test-system performance, false failures, escapes, NCs, DMRs, and other relevant quality and operational indicators. Use the results to verify effectiveness and identify the next improvement opportunity.
* **Prevent recurrence at the source.** Apply lessons from escapes to improve supplier test mandates, Functional Requirements Documents, FMEA/FMECA, Design for Testability, and applicable product-lifecycle deliverables so that prevention becomes part of how future products are developed.
* **Lead across organizational boundaries.** Drive multiple complex initiatives across suppliers, factories, Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Supplier Engineering, NPI Quality, Product Quality & Reliability, and business-unit teams. Communicate technical conclusions, risks, decisions, and business impact with clarity.
* **Build scalable Test Excellence capability.** Create reusable requirements, methods, standards, specifications, and validation practices. Mentor other engineers, transfer knowledge, and raise the organization’s ability to find the right problems and solve them permanently.
  

  

You will turn real-world failures and emerging risks into test solutions that prevent defects from reaching our factories and customers. From defining system-representative requirements to developing, validating, and deploying test fixtures, you will own the solution from insight to sustained impact. jobs.title: Electrical Engineer – LV Power Distribution
jobs.description:
**About Valar Atomics**

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

**The Team**

You will be joining Valar Atomics' Electrical Engineering team, embedded within the broader Fuel Manufacturing engineering group. The team delivers the electrical infrastructure that powers Valar's fuel manufacturing facilities, including process area LV distribution, motor control, and emergency power. You will work alongside I&C, mechanical, and nuclear safety engineers in a collaborative environment that demands technical precision and a strong safety culture. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to some of the most technically interesting power distribution challenges in the advanced nuclear sector.

**The Role**

Valar Atomics is seeking an Electrical Engineer to support the design and delivery of low voltage electrical systems for nuclear fuel manufacturing facilities. The role will contribute to LV system design, power system studies, equipment selection, drawings, specifications and field support while working closely with senior electrical engineers and multidisciplinary teams. This is an opportunity to work on first-of-a-kind industrial facilities and develop hands-on experience with complex electrical systems in the nuclear industry.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Develop and maintain electrical load lists and support power system studies, including load flow, short circuit, voltage drop, motor starting and harmonic analysis, using SKM Power Tools, ETAP, EasyPower or equivalent.
* Support arc flash hazard analysis and labeling in accordance with IEEE 1584 and NFPA 70E.
* Support grounding and bonding design for LV systems in accordance with NEC Article 250 and IEEE 142.
* Assist with sizing and selection of LV switchboards, MCCs, panelboards, dry-type transformers, cables, bus duct, VFDs, UPS systems, batteries and standby generators.
* Develop and update single line diagrams for LV distribution systems, from the secondary of the unit substation through MCCs and final distribution equipment.
* Prepare and maintain electrical equipment layouts, cable schedules, tray routing and duct bank designs.
* Support specifications and data sheets for LV electrical equipment and industrial control panels to UL 508A / IEC 61439.
* Support electrical area classification drawings and selection of equipment for hazardous locations in accordance with NEC Articles 500/505 or IEC 60079.
* Assist with LV protective device coordination studies, time-current curves and breaker trip unit settings.
* Develop and review electrical drawings, including MCC control wiring diagrams, DC control schematics, panel arrangements and distribution details.
* Support technical evaluations of electrical equipment and vendor bids, and review vendor drawings, calculations and technical documentation.
* Support electrical installation specifications and participate in pre-commissioning and commissioning activities, including insulation resistance testing, continuity checks, trip unit testing and equipment energization.
* Coordinate with I&C engineers on motor, VFD and control interfaces, and with civil and structural engineers on equipment foundations, cable routing and penetrations.
* Participate in design reviews, HAZOPs, constructability reviews and other multidisciplinary engineering activities, and support resolution of technical questions from vendors, contractors and field teams.
* Prepare engineering calculations, reports, drawings and specifications under the direction of senior electrical engineers, applying applicable codes and standards.

  

**Basic Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
* 1+ years of electrical engineering experience, preferably in industrial, process, power generation or other complex facilities.
* Understanding of LV electrical distribution systems and fundamental electrical engineering principles.
* Familiarity with power system analysis software such as SKM Power Tools, ETAP, EasyPower or equivalent.
* Familiarity with electrical design deliverables, including single line diagrams, load lists, equipment specifications, cable schedules and electrical layouts.
* Working knowledge of the NEC, NFPA 70E, IEEE, ANSI and NEMA standards.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

  

* EIT designation or active pursuit thereof.
* Experience with LV switchboards, MCCs, VFDs, UPS systems or standby power systems.
* Experience performing or supporting short circuit, arc flash or protective device coordination studies.
* Familiarity with hazardous location classification and static electricity control (NFPA 77).
* Experience with industrial control panel design or review to UL 508A or IEC 61439.
* Experience with DC systems and battery sizing.
* Familiarity with nuclear quality requirements (e.g., ASME NQA-1) or nuclear fuel facility design.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive base salary
* Equity ownership in a rapidly growing advanced energy company
* Comprehensive medical benefits
* Unlimited PTO
* Free daily lunch
* Generous PPE stipend
* High-impact startup environment with significant ownership and autonomy
* Opportunities for rapid career growth and internal advancement
* Direct collaboration with experienced operators, engineers, and industry leaders
* The opportunity to help build and scale transformative energy technology from the ground up

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**

* Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Electrical Engineering.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptable power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Innovators wanted! Are you an entrepreneur? A builder? A dreamer? This role is part of an Amazon Special Projects team that takes the company’s Think Big leadership principle to the highest levels. We focus on creating entirely new products and services with a goal of positively impacting the lives of our customers. No industries or subject areas are out of bounds. We launched products such as Comprehend Medical, Echo Frames and Amazon Explore. If you’re interested in innovating at scale to address big challenges in the world, this is the team for you.  
As the Sr. Systems Engineer, you will own the agent daemon that runs on compute nodes, the runtime sandbox that isolates workloads, and the local storage and caching layer that determines which assets are resident and ready to serve. You will build the detection logic that manages node availability, and the GPU capability reporting that tells the scheduler exactly what each node can handle. Your work directly determines whether the platform can deliver low-latency ML inference — and whether it can do so reliably at scale.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and implement the agent daemon on Linux, including GPU discovery, availability detection, and sandboxed container execution for ML inference workloads.
* Architect the local caching system — eviction policies, versioned manifests, disk budget management, and efficient update mechanisms that minimize data transfer for large model files.
* Build VRAM management and graceful workload migration logic.
* Integrate hardware attestation with the security engineer and support diverse hardware configurations and fleet onboarding automation.

  
About the team  
Amazon Special Projects is a small, high-autonomy team building new-to-Amazon infrastructure from scratch. The systems component is where software meets hardware: you will build the on-node runtime — the agent, sandbox, GPU manager, and local storage layer — that makes a compute node reliable, secure, and performant. This is systems engineering at its most tangible — your code runs on real hardware and must be resilient to everything the real world throws at it.

* Demonstrated ability to build software that runs reliably on heterogeneous hardware

* Experience designing caching systems with constrained storage budgets (LRU, ARC, or custom policies)
* Background in edge computing, fleet management, or embedded systems engineering
* Familiarity with hardware attestation (TPM, TEE) from the device side

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. **The Role**

  

We are seeking a Principal Electrical Engineer to join the TeraWave team at Blue Origin. jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

#### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The LatticeOS Team builds the foundational software-defined operating system that powers our family of autonomous systems, sensors, and third-party integrations. Our work spans edge devices, robotic platforms, and cloud infrastructure, creating a unified operating environment for system orchestration, secure data distribution, and real-time execution. As a core engineering capability, LatticeOS directly enables mission-critical operations across all domains, powering both internal products and external developer partners integrating through the Lattice SDK. Our solutions are designed for real-world deployment in the most demanding operational environments, where reliable middleware, high availability, and seamless hardware-software integration make the difference between mission success and failure.

#### 

#### **ABOUT THE JOB**

As a Senior Software Engineer working in the ProtoKV domain you will design and build the core distributed key-value infrastructure that underpins state sharing across Lattice OS, focusing on performance, reliability, and consistency guarantees at the edge. They'll own the protobuf schema evolution strategy and API surface, ensuring that services across the mesh can safely publish and consume typed state without breaking contracts. A significant portion of the role involves optimizing for the unique constraints of tactical environments — low-bandwidth links, intermittent connectivity, and strict latency requirements — where traditional distributed systems assumptions don't hold. You'll also collaborate closely with teams across Lattice to understand consumption patterns, debug cross-service state issues, and evolve ProtoKV's replication and conflict-resolution mechanisms as the platform scales to new mission sets.

  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or relevant field, or equivalent experience

jobs.description:
**Astronics Advanced Electronic Systems** (AES) is seeking a passionate and driven **Senior Electrical Engineer, Product Support – Power Electronics Systems** to join our **Airborne Power Control (APC) Product Team** in **Redmond, WA**.

**This role is primarily on-site**, but we value flexibility and allow occasional remote work based on project requirements.

**JOB SUMMARY**

As a Senior Electrical Engineer on our Product Support Team, you will be integral in providing electrical engineering support in the design, development, production, and customer support of Aircraft Power Control (APC) power electronics systems.

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

The successful Sr. Electrical Engineer, Product Support will leverage their education and experience to support the design and production of new technology electrical power systems. This includes addressing the resolution of manufacturing and field related problems, suggesting and evaluating design and process improvements, addressing component obsolescence, and conducting verification testing associated with design changes. Specific job duties include:

* Actively participates in problem prevention and resolution. Identifies the root cause of problems and determines and leads the appropriate corrective action
* Review, prepare, design, analyze, and test data to ensure their accuracy and appropriateness.
* Coordinate, prepare, and review technical drawings, documents and data items related to the incorporation of alternative components
* Operate standard lab equipment to perform design verification and circuit testing and the ability to use engineering software tools
* Coordinate, organize, and participate in analysis, design, development and qualifications as assigned

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education:**

* Requires a bachelor's degree in **Electrical/Electronics Engineering** from an accredited institution.

**Experience:**

* **Demonstrates competency - typically 5 or more years of direct experience in relevant areas, particularly power electronics, power supply design, motor control, and analog design.**
* Demonstrates sound knowledge of electronic/electrical circuits and components with ability to view schematics and describe the operations of various circuits.
* Adept understanding of Ohm's Law & Op Amps
* Possess some knowledge of and experience designing to DO-160 and other standards.
* Proficient at using schematic tool, enterprise tools, and standard simulation tool.

**EMPLOYMENT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS**

* This position may involve access to items subject to U.S. export-control laws. Employment is contingent upon the employee's authorization to access such items under applicable law. The company does not guarantee and is under no obligation to seek such authorization if it would be necessary.
* **Background Check & Drug Screening:** Employment is contingent on successfully passing a **pre-employment background check** and a **drug test** (including screening for **cannabis**).

**Compensation & Benefits**

Factors such as education, experience, skills, market conditions and peer equity influence the actual salary. It is not typical to be hired at or near the top of the range.

* **Bonus:** Highly competitive Quarterly Profit Sharing Bonus.

**Comprehensive Benefits Package:**

* **Health & Well-Being:** Includes medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance, plus optional plans for critical illness, accident prevention, and hospital indemnity coverage.
* **Financial Security:** Access to our 401(k) plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program.
* **Work-Life Balance:** Flexible hybrid work arrangements (for eligible positions), access to an Employee Assistance Program, and a culture committed to helping employees strike a healthy balance between life and career.
* **Generous PTO:** Start with 120 hours of paid time off annually, plus 12 paid holidays per year.

jobs.title: Software Engineer III-Matrix Fitness
jobs.description:
Description:

**WHO WE ARE**

Johnson Health Tech is one of the world’s largest and fastest-growing fitness equipment manufacturers, delivering innovative solutions that help people live healthier lives. Through our award-winning portfolio of commercial and residential brands, we serve customers in more than 60 countries worldwide.

**MISSION STATEMENT**

To delight and excite our customers through truly innovative products, unsurpassed quality, and best-in-class customer experience provided by a world-class organization.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

Under the direction of the Engineering Manager – KT Innovation, the Software Engineer III will conduct engineering research and development projects to support Key Technology (KT) and New Product Development (NPD) of Fitness Equipment. The role is considered a generalist and spans the full range of software found in connected fitness products, from embedded firmware and device software to mobile, desktop, web, and cloud applications.

The Software Engineer III owns PoCs or subsystems end to end and makes design decisions. This position requires a creative and flexible individual who can stretch to support the specific needs of the development situation and manufacturing environment. The successful candidate will be willing to move fast, fail early, iterate, and consistently deliver.

This is a non-supervisory position.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Understand and integrate potential new technologies, features, modalities/ergonomics into Johnson products
* Design, implement, test, and debug software across the product stack, from embedded firmware to mobile, web, and cloud applications
* Create proof-of-concepts (PoC) and partner with the Product Management team for review and refinement
* Evaluate and test for viability and risk mitigation
* Feed new product development by successfully and smoothly transitioning PoC’s to engineering teams based on Asia sourcing and manufacturing
* Develop and document design and specifications
* Lead code reviews
* Contribute to new intellectual property and intellectual property workarounds
* Guide and support junior engineers
* Other projects as assigned

*Marginal Job Functions:*

* Other projects as needed.

Requirements:

*Education:*

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering or equivalent experience

*Required Experience:*

* Typically, 5-8 years of professional software development experience, or equivalent
* Proficiency in two or more programming languages such as C++, C#, Java, Kotlin, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript
* Understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and design patterns
* Version control (i.e. Git)
* Write clear technical documentation
* Ability to pick up new languages and/or frameworks as needed for a given project
* Ability to interact with, program, and debug physical hardware
* Application development in mobile (Android/iOS), desktop, or web
* Continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD)
* Basic networking knowledge (ports, sockets, REST)

*Bonus Qualifications:*

* Exposure to embedded systems and development in C/C++
* Linux application development, driver development, and OS building
* Automated testing and unit testing
* Development in React native or React web
* Exposure to cloud services
* Exposure to machine learning
* Exposure to single-board computers (i.e. Raspberry Pi)

*Other Requirements:*

* Strong and creative problem-solving skills
* Ability to work well with numerous diverse groups and individuals
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Willingness to travel internationally as needed; approximately 1-2 trips to Asia annually
* Ability to write code without AI assistance
* AI co-development fluency (i.e. Claude Code, Codex, Copilot)

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORK ENVIRONMENT**

*Physical Requirements*

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for extended periods, use hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, phone, and other standard office equipment. Will be required to communicate both verbally and in writing, view a computer monitor, and perform tasks requiring close vision with the ability to adjust focus. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, reach, bend, stoop, kneel, or crouch to access files, supplies, or other office equipment. The employee must occasionally lift, carry, push, or pull materials weighing up to 20 pounds. Repetitive hand, wrist, and finger motion is required for keyboarding and other clerical tasks.

*Work Environment*

This position will require working on-site. The employee must be able to maintain concentration in a variety of work environments and sustain attention to detail while managing multiple priorities. The position requires the ability to reason, analyze information, and make sound decisions promptly. The employee must also be capable of working both independently and collaboratively, interacting professionally with colleagues, leadership, and external partners.

**BENEFITS & PERKS**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Company-paid life insurance and AD&D coverage
* 401(k) retirement savings plan
* Paid time off (PTO)
* FSA and HSA options
* Employee product discounts, wellness resources, and employee assistance programs

  
*Equal Opportunity Employer, including Protected Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities.*

Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in electrical engineering resources to design and develop leadership in electronic capabilities; something unique within the industry. And we’re pushing the limits in firmware engineering, power electronics, embedded systems, machine learning, and the use of artificial intelligence.

Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.

Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE .

* Work to design, model, simulate, and implement advanced control algorithms independently and under the supervision of senior engineers.

* Develop, analyze, maintain, and document control system architecture.

* Develop and execute test plans and procedures for firmware applications and subsystems.

* Use laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, and data acquisition systems.

* Conduct experiments, perform simulations, and draw concise, logical conclusions by analyzing data.

* 2+ years of experience with embedded C/C++ or a comparable programming language for embedded systems.

* Working knowledge of closed loop control theory.

* Experience with one or more of the following: DevOps, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), hardware in the loop (HIL), unit testing.

* Experience with software configuration management tools, defect tracking tools, and peer reviews.

* Excellent problem-solving skills, exercises independent judgement and works well under pressure in a dynamic environment.

* Self-motivated, organized, efficient, process oriented with a strong work ethic.

* Exceptional verbal and writing skills.

Ability to travel 10% of the time (domestic and international).

* “Bare metal” C/C++ programming experience outside of an OS/RTOS.

* Familiarity with model-based control development, code generation, and automated testing utilizing design tools such as MATLAB/Simulink.

* Working knowledge of vector control, pulse width modulation, control loop tuning, and stability analysis.

* Familiarity with three phase motor control and/or power control applications.

* Ability to read power electronics schematics and component data sheets.

Experience with CAD tools, particularly those relevant to electrical/PCB design.  



**We provide these great perks and benefits:**

* Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans.

* Generous 401 (K) savings plan.

* Education assistance.

* On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Valinor is a new type of defense and government tech company focused on solving the problems others don't.** Our unique model of centralized go-to-market and decentralized engineering allows us to move with unparalleled efficiency to identify unmet needs, build right-sized solutions, and get products where they matter most: in the hands of users.

Backed by General Catalyst, Founders Fund, and Friends & Family Capital, Valinor was founded in 2024 and has established strategic partnerships with Palantir, Anduril, and Helsing. We are building the dream team, and we want you on it.

**About The Role**
------------------

**Valinor Reflex** is looking for an **Embedded Software Engineer** to join our small, hands-on team in Washington, D.C., building a low-profile smart optics system that brings real-time computing and embedded intelligence into a wearable form factor.  
  
You’ll own software close to the hardware, from bringing up new boards and developing Linux drivers to debugging difficult firmware and system-level issues. This role is ideal for an engineer who likes working at the hardware/software boundary, enjoys getting deep into how chips and systems work, and is comfortable moving between low-level firmware and the user-space software built on top of it.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Develop low-level embedded software and firmware in C/C++ and Python
* Bring up new boards and hardware platforms from initial prototype through reliable operation
* Develop and debug Linux device drivers, BSPs, and Device Tree configurations
* Develop, configure, and debug low-level DDR initialization firmware
* Work closely with electrical engineers to understand schematics, interfaces, pin routing, and how software requirements translate to the circuit board
* Debug across hardware and software using logs, schematics, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other bench equipment
* Develop and maintain embedded Linux systems using Yocto or similar build systems
* Contribute to user-space software, tooling, and Python applications when needed
* Help shape the embedded architecture as Reflex moves from prototype hardware toward reliable, field-ready systems

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 5+ years of experience in embedded software, firmware, or a related field
* Strong experience developing low-level software in C/C++
* Hands-on experience with embedded Linux, board bring-up, BSP development, and device drivers
* Deep understanding of processors, memory, peripherals, and how software interacts with underlying hardware
* Ability to debug difficult firmware and system-level problems from first principles
* Comfortable reading schematics and working closely with electrical and mechanical engineers
* Experience with common embedded interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, USB, CAN, or similar
* Ability to contribute outside the firmware layer when needed, including Python and user-space software
* Comfortable working in a fast-moving, build-first environment with significant ownership and ambiguity

**What Valinor Offers**
=======================

* Competitive salary, equity packages, and benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance - fully covered for employees, 401(k), development stipends, among others.
* Unlimited PTO and two-week company holiday at the end of every calendar year.
* We are a pro-mental health and pro-family company - we actually encourage employees to spend time with themselves and their families. Valinor also provides fertility benefits to those just beginning that journey.
* Fun work environment - we like to laugh and take care of each other, but we also deeply respect the mission in front of us.

*This role requires the candidate be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. Active clearance preferred, but not required.*

*Valinor is an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. The Valinor team is made up of incredibly talented and unique individuals, who together are disrupting industry norms by creating new paths towards the future of defense and government technology. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, Veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law, including those with a criminal history, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the CA Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. We actively encourage members of recognized minorities, women, Veterans, and those with disabilities to apply, and we work to create a welcoming and supportive environment for all applicants throughout the interview process. If you are someone passionate about working on problems that have a real-world impact, we'd love to hear from you!*

jobs.title: SLCM-N On-site Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  
BAE Systems has an immediate need for a highly qualified On-site Systems Engineer to support our work as a prime contractor on the US Navy’s Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE) Strategic Systems Programs (SSP) Sea-Launched Cruise Missile-Nuclear (SLCM-N) Program. The candidate will have extensive knowledge and understanding of Systems Engineering for complex system of systems to successfully deliver major programs in alignment with the DoD 5000 Acquisition framework.
  
The On‑Site Systems Engineer provides authoritative systems engineering and integration expertise across the SLCM-N portfolio. The role supports the chief engineer customer as an embedded technical representative with technical branches, ensuring successful integration of complex strategic weapon system elements. This role ensures subsystem elements are synthesized into a coherent system architecture that meets requirements and preserves SSP mission design principles. The engineer will interface daily with government, BAE Systems, and prime contractor personnel. The On-site Systems Engineer will assist in the development of instructions and guidance to execute systems engineering management functions to support Systems Engineering Technical Review (SETR) milestone event planning and execution. This role involves facilitating critical acquisition milestones, ensuring compliance with exit/entry criteria, and providing expert analysis to minimize technical risk at the system level.
  
  
The On-site Systems Engineer will report to the Systems Engineering Supervisor for SLCM-N Technical Planning and Execution and will be onsite with the subsystem technical branch representatives. This role will provide expert technical guidance and system perspective to multidisciplinary teams (Requirements, Architecture, Verification, Integration, Test, Safety, Cybersecurity, etc.) to ensure seamless integration and interoperability of strategic deterrence components and subsystems.
  
  
Key responsibilities of the On-site Systems Engineer include, but are not limited to:
  
Technical Oversight and Integration:

* + Advising and overseeing technical branches and prime contractors on systems engineering activities across the full acquisition lifecycle, from concept and requirements definition through design, development, testing, deployment, and sustainment for DoD/DoW programs.
  + Support and coordinate technical reviews, leveraging training and experience to provide informed analysis and recommendations.
  + Collaborate with engineering, logistics, testing, and contracting teams to ensure a comprehensive technical analysis and evaluation is performed.
  + Utilize various digital engineering tools to evaluate and integrate sub-system content with system-level requirements and architecture (functional and physical).
  + Support the development and maintenance of program documentation, technical assessments (e.g., SRRs, PDRs, Milestone A, and other reviews), and decision memos.
  + Participate in subsystem SETR events to identify system impacts and facilitate working groups to resolve technical issues.

Risk Management:

* + Collaborate with subsystem prime contractors to identify, track, and resolve system-level risks, issues, and opportunities.
  + Perform technical risk assessments, identify potential risks (and opportunities), and establish comprehensive mitigation strategies for critical systems.
  + Coordinate with cross-functional teams to implement mitigation strategies for identified risks.

Documentation:

* + Manage program documentation, ensuring white papers, status briefings, and technical assessments remain accurate and accessible.
  + Support the configuration management and change management of program artifacts and documentation through change control boards (CCB) and engineering change processes (ECP).

  
#LI-VW1
  
#LI-Onsite
  
  
**About the program**
  
Our organization has supported the U.S. Navy’s PAE Strategic Systems Programs (SSP) continually since the program’s inception in the 1950s. SSP developed the first sea-based, underwater-launched Strategic Weapon System (SWS), a defense system that is truly critical to our national security. For more than six decades, SSP has maintained and upgraded this weapon system, and we have been there every step of the way. The sea-based SWS is the ultimate stealthy weapon system and is the first leg of the U.S. nuclear triad. With over 70% of our nation’s nuclear arsenal under its control, its importance in maintaining world peace cannot be overstated. The development of Columbia, the most advanced nuclear-powered, nuclear-armed submarine ever designed, as well the next D5LE2 weapon system is under way and will begin to be rolled out over the next decade. The Navy projects this system to be operational through 2084, meaning the program will have a total life span of more than 120 years. This is a unique program and BAE Systems employees on this program understand they are part of an important legacy.
  
In response to global threats, SSP is continuing to defend our nation by adding a second nuclear defense system option to their mission responsibilities with the SLCM-N Program. SSP is building this modular, survivable cruise missile system that will be outfitted on some submarines and surface ships. SSP is responsible for designing, developing, building, and deploying the SLCM-N, while BAE Systems supports our customer in the pre-development activities for the SLCM-N Program.
  
As a decades-long, sole-source partner on multiple contracts on behalf of our customer, our program offers remarkable stability while simultaneously experiencing significant growth. Combined, these factors provide ample opportunity for professional growth and development for capable and talented individuals on our team. BAE Systems, Inc. is the wholly owned U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc.

In this role, you will drive firmware design from inception to customer deployment, ensuring seamless hardware validation and integration. This is a unique opportunity to leverage your expertise in embedded systems, multi-chip package environments, and high-speed SerDes to shape the future of optical interconnect.

  

**Essential Functions:**

  

* Design, develop, and optimize embedded firmware for controlling high-speed SerDes interfaces and electronic/photonic subsystems.
  
* Collaborate closely with analog/mixed-signal, digital, and photonic block designers to develop and implement sophisticated control algorithms for our photonic circuits and establish the micro-architecture and embedded requirements for our multi-chip package systems.
  
* Write unit tests and integration tests for firmware modules; participate in firmware code reviews; maintain high-quality firmware through CI/CD practices.
  
* Develop and execute firmware test code to support initial silicon power-on and bringup activities; debug hardware-firmware interactions at first silicon.
  
* Partner effectively with hardware, validation, systems, and software teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
  
* Maintain clear technical documentation including APIs, firmware architecture documents, module specifications, and build/release notes

  

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's in Electrical/Computer Engineering or a related field with 3+ years of relevant industry experience.
  
* Proven expertise in bare-metal embedded firmware development, with strong programming skills in C.
  
* Experience with various microcontrollers and firmware debugging tools.
  
* Proficiency with modern version control workflows (e.g., Git), modern firmware development tools, and CI/CD tools.
  
* Hands-on, proactive approach with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment.
  
* Silicon bring-up experience.
  
* Experience in scripting with high level language like Python.
  
* Experience with Make-based build flows.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Ability to own architecture and development of firmware modules from scratch.
  
* Experience in embedded firmware development for high-speed electronics and photonics applications.
  
* Silicon bring-up experience for high-speed SerDes and photonics applications.
  

**Principal Engineer: Silicon Validation**

In this role, you will lead the silicon validation of our optical chiplets. You will define and drive the validation strategy from initial silicon power-on through block and chip level signoff. We move fast, think big, and combine start-up agility with aerospace expertise to design, build, and scale aircraft in ways the industry has never seen. Our team leverages automation, AI-driven tools, and a fully connected digital backbone to accelerate innovation and reduce barriers to production.*

*Here, you won't just take a job — you'll help reinvent how the world flies. If you're ready to solve complex problems, push technology further, and work alongside some of the brightest minds in aerospace, this is your chance to make a real impact.*

We are seeking a Principal Electrical Engineer to provide technical leadership in the architecture, design, and qualification of high-integrity electronic control systems across Neon's product portfolio.

This role is focused on the controller and system-electronics side of the architecture: command/monitor architecture, flight control computers and LRUs, embedded compute, sensing, communications, fault detection, redundancy, and the electrical interfaces that tie complex products together. It is complementary to our Principal Engineer – High Voltage Power Electronics role, which owns high-voltage motor-drive and power-stage design.

This is a deeply hands-on individual contributor role. You will develop system architectures, block diagrams, schematics, interface definitions, safety concepts, and the analysis behind them. You will work directly with embedded software, motor control, systems, mechanical, power electronics, test, manufacturing, and certification teams to bring high-reliability electronic systems from concept through qualification and production.

This role does not require direct people management, but it requires principal-level technical leadership, mentoring, and ownership of difficult cross-functional decisions.

**Why This Role Matters**

* Own electrical system architecture for high-integrity controller electronics, FCCs, LRUs, actuator controllers, avionics/compute platforms, sensing systems, and related embedded hardware.
* Architect command/monitor, active-active, simplex, duplex, or other redundant control architectures based on system safety, integrity, availability, and cost requirements.
* Define partitioning between command processors, monitoring processors, motor-control electronics, power electronics, sensors, communications, and vehicle-level interfaces.
* Translate system requirements and safety objectives into practical electronic architectures, hardware requirements, interface definitions, and verification strategies.
* Select microcontrollers, processors, FPGAs, memories, communication devices, supervisors, watchdogs, isolation components, and sensor interfaces appropriate for high-reliability applications.
* Design and review embedded digital, analog, and mixed-signal electronics, including low-voltage power supplies, power sequencing, reset architecture, discrete I/O, signal conditioning, protection, and health monitoring.
* Architect fault detection, fault containment, redundancy management, cross-monitoring, heartbeat, synchronization, and safe-state mechanisms.
* Define communication architecture and physical layers for interfaces such as CAN / CAN FD, ARINC 825, ARINC 429, Ethernet, RS-422/485, SPI, and similar embedded or aerospace buses.
* Own electrical interface definitions and collaborate with systems and software teams on ICDs, timing assumptions, diagnostic coverage, degraded modes, and hardware/software partitioning.
* Establish grounding, shielding, isolation, EMI/EMC, signal-integrity, and power-integrity approaches across boards, harnesses, sensors, and enclosures.
* Lead schematic development and critical PCB design reviews using Altium or equivalent ECAD tools.
* Personally perform or direct worst-case circuit analysis, tolerance analysis, derating, signal-integrity analysis, power-budget analysis, and fault analysis.
* Lead board bring-up, system integration, lab debugging, and root-cause investigations for issues spanning hardware, firmware, software, sensors, communications, and power electronics.
* Define hardware verification strategies and support qualification testing for environmental, EMC, electrical power, and fault conditions.
* Support certification-oriented development including requirements traceability, design assurance, configuration control, verification evidence, and hardware change management.
* Drive DFM, DFT, DFA, production test strategy, and manufacturing readiness for controller electronics and LRUs.
* Mentor electrical engineers through architecture reviews, schematic reviews, design analysis, bring-up, and debugging while remaining deeply hands-on.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
* 12+ years of experience developing and shipping complex electronic systems.
* Demonstrated ownership of system-level electrical architecture for embedded control, avionics, industrial control, automotive, robotics, medical, aerospace, or similarly high-reliability products.
* Deep hands-on experience with embedded digital and mixed-signal hardware, including microcontroller-based systems, sensing, communications, and board-level power architecture.
* Strong proficiency with schematic capture and PCB design using Altium or equivalent ECAD tools.
* Strong understanding of processor selection, watchdog and reset architecture, communication interfaces, sensor interfacing, low-voltage power conversion, grounding, isolation, and EMI/EMC.
* Experience designing fault-tolerant or redundant electronic architectures and reasoning about failure detection, fault containment, and safe-state behavior.
* Experience bringing electronic assemblies from concept through prototype, qualification, industrialization, and production.

new_jobs.title: Mechatronics Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**About Astera**
----------------

Astera Institute is a private foundation supporting ambitious work in science and technology through grants, investments, and in-house research. Its research programs combine the pace and autonomy of a startup with the freedom to pursue difficult scientific questions. Learn more about Astera’s mission at astera.org/vision.

**About the Robotics Lab**
--------------------------

We are building a frontier robotics lab at Astera Institute. We believe neuroscience and AI will converge in embodied intelligence: animals and robots face shared challenges of perceiving their surroundings, navigating, manipulating objects, and using memory and reasoning to accomplish tasks in the physical world. Robotics provides a powerful testbed for investigating how biological neural circuits solve these challenges and for developing AI systems that turn perception, learning, and cognition into effective action.

Our strategy starts with making robots useful, while developing a mechanistic understanding of how neural circuits can generate intelligent behavior. We aim to continually expand the repertoire of behaviors a robot can perform reliably in real environments, while improving its ability to learn new skills, adapt to changing conditions, and recover from failure. These practical capabilities provide both measurable outcomes and a foundation for investigating deeper principles of intelligence.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

We are looking for a hands-on mechatronics engineer to design and build the mechanisms, electronics, and sensing systems our robots use to interact with the world. You will take hardware from concept and CAD through fabrication, board bring-up, integration, and testing on physical robots.

Based in our Robotics Lab in Emeryville, California, you will work closely with learning and control researchers on manipulators, dexterous hands, and humanoids. The role combines mechanical and electrical engineering with careful physical experimentation: understanding how a design behaves under load, finding the source of a failure, and improving the hardware.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* **Design and build robot mechanisms.** Design mechanisms, end-effectors, arm–hand interfaces, and experimental fixtures; create CAD assemblies, fabrication drawings, and working prototypes.
* **Develop robot electronics.** Design and bring up PCBs for sensing, embedded interfaces, and power distribution, including component selection, schematic capture, layout, and board debugging.
* **Integrate actuation and sensing.** Integrate motors, drives, encoders, force/torque sensors, and tactile sensors with embedded firmware and robot control systems.
* **Characterize and troubleshoot hardware.** Measure and troubleshoot backlash, compliance, friction, drift, latency, thermal behavior, and other effects that influence robot motion and manipulation.
* **Collaborate on robot design.** Work with learning and control researchers to improve geometry, actuation, and sensor placement based on experiments with real robots.
* **Make hardware reproducible and maintainable.** Build repeatable bench and robot tests, document design decisions, and maintain the CAD, PCB, firmware, and assembly files needed to reproduce and service the hardware.
* **Explore AI-assisted engineering.** Explore AI-assisted CAD scripting, firmware development, and test automation, with engineering review and physical validation.

**Desired Qualifications**
--------------------------

* **Electromechanical systems experience.** Experience delivering complete electromechanical systems, with substantial personal responsibility for design, integration, and debugging.
* **Mechanical design and prototyping.** Strong CAD and mechanical design skills, including tolerancing, fabrication, assembly, and hands-on prototyping.
* **PCB design and bring-up.** Hands-on PCB experience from schematic capture and layout through board bring-up and troubleshooting.
* **Actuation and electronics.** Practical knowledge of motors, encoders, sensor electronics, power distribution, and embedded interfaces.
* **Programming and firmware.** Python, C/C++, or microcontroller programming skills for hardware integration, testing, and data collection.
* **Experimental judgment and collaboration.** A careful, measurement-driven approach to debugging and the ability to collaborate across hardware, controls, and machine learning.
* **Robotics hardware experience.** Robot manipulators, dexterous hands, compliant mechanisms, or contact-rich manipulation. Helpful, but not required.
* **Sensing and test experience.** Force/torque or tactile sensing, actuator characterization, and instrumented test fixtures. Helpful, but not required.
* **Hardware and learning integration.** Hardware iteration informed by control or learning experiments, and AI-assisted engineering workflows. Helpful, but not required.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

Shape the physical systems through which robots learn and interact with the world. Your work will connect mechanical design, electronics, and sensing directly to the capabilities of manipulators, dexterous hands, and humanoids.

You will work closely with learning and control researchers, using real robot experiments to inform hardware decisions. This is an opportunity to build complete systems and explore how the robot’s body and its intelligence can be developed together.

Compensation Range: $180K - $280K

new_jobs.description:
**Electrical Engineer II: Job Posting**

RESOLVEM Inc. | Irvine, CA / Carlsbad, CA (On-site) | Full-time | Mid-level

**Apply here directly: https://resolvem.com/careers*****(****Do not apply via indeed****)***

**About the job**

At RESOLVEM Inc., you'll work across multiple medical device clients and product types, which means you'll accumulate range that engineers at a single-product company simply don't get. You'll take designs into actual field operation of medical line test equipment and medical products, drive root cause investigations when things fail, and grow into the engineer customers ask for by name.

**Why RESOLVEM?**

We're an engineering services firm specializing in R&D design support of new products and transferring product designs to design control and manufacturing. We help medical device companies bring their designs under design control, prepare them for mass manufacturing, and support their pilot manufacturing and transition to commercial-scale production. Because we work across multiple clients and products, you won't spend years on one subsystem. You'll build breadth and depth, fast, and you'll be trusted with real ownership from day one.

**What you'll do**

We'll be straight with you: this is regulated-industry work, and a real share of it is documentation. In medical devices paperwork is part of the product. An undocumented change is an unapproved change that could harm a patient. If that sounds like a chore rather than a craft, this isn't the right role. If you want to be an engineer whose design record holds up under an audit, read on.

Also, a board that works on the bench is not good enough. Our products are electromechanical systems, and you'll own how your design behaves inside the enclosure, on the harness, and inside the rest of the system. You will need to understand mechanical concepts, bills of materials, and how the electrical fits into a wider system.

* **Keep the design record airtight.** You'll author and process Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) on behalf of customers, redline drawings and specifications, compare design revisions, maintain BOMs, purchasing specifications, and obsolescence plans, route changes through approval, and keep the Design History File current and traceable.
* **Own electrical designs.** Lead schematic capture and PCB layout for analog, digital, power, and mixed-signal circuits, including sensor interfaces and microcontroller-based subsystems. Drive component selection, stack-up and layout strategy, signal integrity and power integrity considerations, and design-for-manufacturability/testability (DFM/DFT). Validate with LTspice/PSpice simulation before committing to hardware.
* **Take it from bring-up to production.** Own board bring-up, debug, and characterization. Build custom benchtop test equipment and fixtures, and automate test and data acquisition with Python, MATLAB, or LabVIEW. Support design transfer, pilot builds, and the handoff to contract manufacturers.
* **Lead investigations.** Drive electrical failure analysis and root cause analysis on complex issues. Author investigation reports, propose and verify corrective actions, and present findings to internal teams and customers.
* **Work fluently in the regulated world.** Execute within a certified quality management system (ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR 820) and design control processes. Own Design History File (DHF) deliverables and requirements traceability for your subsystems. Apply ISO 14971 risk management (DFMEA, hazard analysis), support IEC 62304 software lifecycle activities, and lead EMI/EMC design and pre-compliance testing toward IEC 60601-1-2 and IEC 60601-1 certification.
* **Own verification and validation.** Define V&V strategy for your subsystems; author and execute protocols and reports; support test method validation (TMV), process development, inspection criteria, statistical data analysis, and equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ).
* **Support firmware and system integration.** Develop or guide firmware for microcontroller-based designs using C/C++ and protocols such as I2C, SPI, and UART, and integrate electrical subsystems with mechanical, software, and systems engineering.
* **Raise the team.** Mentor interns and Electrical Engineer I staff, review their work, and serve as a technical point of contact for customers and contract manufacturers on assigned projects.

**Apply here directly: https://resolvem.com/careers**

**Do not apply via LinkedIn EZApply**

**You bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university
* Minimum of 3-5 years of hands-on experience in schematic capture and PCB design, with demonstrated ownership of boards from concept through fabrication and bring-up
* Working understanding of mechanical and electromechanical systems: enclosures, connectors and cable harnesses, sensors, and thermal and vibration considerations, including the ability to read a mechanical drawing, reason about how a board fits and performs inside a real assembly, and work through fit, tolerance, grounding, and serviceability questions with mechanical engineers
* Proficiency with PCB design software (Altium Designer preferred; OrCAD, PADS, or KiCad acceptable) and circuit simulation tools (LTspice, PSpice, or equivalent)
* Strong benchtop skills: oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, power meters, DMMs, and programmable supplies/loads
* Solid grounding in analog and digital circuit design and troubleshooting, including power supplies, signal conditioning, and noise mitigation
* Demonstrated experience leading electrical failure analysis and root cause investigations, including written reports
* Proficiency in at least one of MATLAB, Python, or C/C++
* Strong written and verbal technical communication; comfortable presenting in design reviews and to customers
* Ability to work independently on moderately complex projects and to collaborate across disciplines

**Apply here directly: https://resolvem.com/careers*

new_jobs.title: Electrical Engineer - Mission Critical
new_jobs.description:
**Who we are**

Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We're changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don't just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

  

**What you'll do**

  

* Lead electrical system design and analysis — power distribution, service entrance design, panel/switchgear sizing, lighting, and emergency/standby power — for new and retrofit facilities across Atoms' portfolio.
* Prepare electrical calculations, drawings, and specifications for permit submittal across multiple jurisdictions.
* Design power distribution and charging circuits for EV/AV charging and support infrastructure, including coordinating transformer and service upgrades.
* Partner with utility providers to secure power availability, service upgrades, and timely energization for new sites.
* Partner with Structural, Building Design, Civil, and MEP consultant teams to resolve system conflicts and keep designs constructible and cost-effective.
* Review and respond to plan check comments from Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs) and utility providers to keep permitting and energization on schedule.
* Evaluate vendor and manufacturer electrical equipment submittals (switchgear, EV charging hardware, backup power systems) for code compliance and site suitability.
* Support construction administration, including RFIs, submittal review, and field observation for electrical systems.
* Build and refine standardized electrical details and design templates that can be reused across Atoms' different business lines to support rapid, repeatable deployment.

  

**What we're looking for**

* 7–10 years of electrical engineering experience, including design for commercial, industrial, or high-power facilities
* Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred; ability to obtain additional state licensure/reciprocity as needed
* Demonstrated experience with power distribution, service entrance, and panel/switchgear design
* Working knowledge of NEC, NFPA 70/70E, and local utility interconnection requirements

**Why join us**

At Atoms, you'll work on one of the defining challenges of our time—bringing automation into the physical world to drive real, lasting impact. ### **Overview**

The Senior Sustaining Controls Engineer will play a crucial role in the success of our product automatically and reliably fulfilling customers’ electricity demand. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to diagnose and resolve issues, differentiate between mechanical, electrical, and software-related problems, and document solutions to increase product reliability and reduce maintenance needs. In this role, you will act as an electromechanical generalist, bridging the gap between hardware and software across our linear generator fleet, lab operations, and manufacturing processes. Following our rapid transition from R&D to full production, you will take a structured, methodical approach to untangling complex legacy issues and clearing the issue backlog. Applying a strong foundation in physics and systems engineering, you will trace root causes across C++ software, electrical circuits, and mechanical components, using these insights to develop targeted sustaining features that improve long-term product stability and fleet performance.

### **Responsibilities**

* Manage, document, and resolve fleet issues ensuring clear communication and follow-up on resolutions and improving the process
* Diagnose root causes of system issues, distinguishing between mechanical, electrical, and software-related problems
* Categorize, systematize, and address gaps in automated system behavior
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to provide technical support and enhance system behavior
* Debug and troubleshoot existing control algorithms to improve system performance and reliability
* Analyze and understand C++ code to interpret behavior
* Implement fixes to field issues in C++ code, and test them in simulation and laboratory environments
* Adjust feature designs to address field issues
* Use Python for data analysis, scripting, and system diagnostics
* Tune control gains and calibrate systems, documenting the process for future reference
* Identify and address gaps in system performance, ensuring continuous improvement
* Support reliability and manufacturing testing, contributing to the system's life cycle maintenance

### **Qualifications**

* Experience in successful root cause analysis of complex software-mechatronic systems
* Driven and self-directed systems-thinker responsible for creating or improving effective sustaining engineering processes
* Excellent communicator with demonstrated collaboration across multidisciplinary teams

**About Valar Atomics**

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

  

**The Team**

You will be joining Valar Atomics' Automation and Controls team within the Instrumentation, Control & Electrical (IC&E) organization. Automation and Controls own the logic and data layer PLC and DCS application code, ISA-88 batch sequences, SCADA and HMI applications, historian infrastructure, and enterprise integration across the reactor program and fuel manufacturing operations. You will work alongside I&C Hardware, electrical, process, and nuclear safety engineers in an environment that blends traditional control systems with modern software and data integration practice. As a staff engineer, you will be one of the technical anchors of this team: the engineer others come to when the problem is novel, ambiguous, or high-consequence. The team values operator-focused design, data integrity, disciplined documentation, and a safety-first culture.

  

**The Role**

Valar Atomics is seeking Staff Automation and Controls Engineers to serve as discipline technical authorities for control system software across our reactor and nuclear fuel manufacturing facilities. The role spans the full controls software domain: PLC and DCS programming, SCADA and HMI applications, ISA-88 batch control, alarm management, safety logic, historians, enterprise integration, and OT infrastructure, from capital project execution through ongoing plant operations. This is a staff position: in addition to owning the most complex controls software scope end-to-end, you will set the coding standards, template libraries, and configuration management practices the discipline runs on, lead resolution of first-of-a-kind plant control problems where no established solution exists, review and approve the work of other engineers, and provide technical direction and mentorship across the software team. You are accountable not only for your own code, but for the technical quality and consistency of controls software across projects and sites.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Leadership and Discipline Ownership**

* Serve as the responsible engineer and discipline technical authority for controls software on assigned systems; review and approve PLC/DCS application code, SCADA applications, safety logic, and test documentation produced by other engineers, contractors, and integrators.

* Establish, maintain, and enforce discipline software standards including application coding standards, template and UDT libraries, the ISA-101/HPHMI display style guide, alarm philosophy implementation standards, testing standards, and the software configuration management and change control practice used across projects and sites.

* Lead control strategy and software architecture development for first-of-a-kind plant control problems where no established solution exists, including control approach trade studies, platform capability evaluation, prototyping, and validation planning.

* Lead controls software participation in interdisciplinary design reviews, HAZOP studies, control narrative reviews, and licensing-support activities; represent the discipline's position and own the resolution of cross-discipline technical conflicts.

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. **The Team**

You will be joining Valar Atomics' I&C and Controls Engineering team within the Fuel Manufacturing group. I&C Engineers at Valar own the full controls stack — from PLC logic and batch sequences at the field level to SCADA displays, historian data infrastructure, and enterprise integration at the supervisory level. You will work alongside process, electrical, and nuclear safety engineers in a hands-on environment where the quality of your control system engineering directly supports production reliability and nuclear safety. The team values technical depth, disciplined documentation, and a safety-first culture.

**The Role**

Valar Atomics is seeking a Staff Instrumentation and Controls (I&C) Engineer to design, develop, commission, and maintain control systems for nuclear fuel manufacturing facilities. The role spans the full controls stack — PLC and DCS programming, SCADA and HMI development, ISA-88 batch control, safety instrumented systems, historian and enterprise integration, and field commissioning — with senior responsibility for technical leadership of complex projects, contractor oversight, and mentorship of junior engineers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain PLC and DCS programs using platforms such as Rockwell ControlLogix/CompactLogix, Siemens S7/TIA Portal, Emerson, or equivalent; program in ladder logic, function block, structured text, and sequential function chart per IEC 61131-3.
* Develop and configure SCADA applications on platforms such as Ignition, Rockwell FactoryTalk, Wonderware AVEVA System Platform, Siemens WinCC, or equivalent; build and maintain tag databases, communication drivers, scripting, and alarm configuration.
* Design HMI displays at both the local panel level (Rockwell PanelView, WinCC, or equivalent) and the supervisory SCADA level in accordance with ISA-101 and High-Performance HMI (HPHMI) principles.
* Develop batch control sequences in accordance with ISA-88; configure phase logic, unit procedures, and recipe management; monitor batch execution, unit status, and recipe progress at the supervisory layer.
* Configure and manage alarm systems to ISA-18.2 including setpoints, priorities, suppression logic, and alarm KPI monitoring.
* Configure and commission safety instrumented functions (SIFs) on SIS platforms (Rockwell GuardLogix, Siemens F-CPU, Triconex, or equivalent) in accordance with IEC 61511.
* Configure plant historian systems (OSIsoft PI / AVEVA PI, Ignition Historian, Rockwell FactoryTalk Historian, or equivalent); build process data dashboards and reports; support ISA-95 enterprise-control integration including data exchange interfaces between control systems and MES, ERP, or LIMS.
* Tune PID and advanced regulatory control loops; commission instrumentation including flow, pressure, temperature, and level devices; support loop calibration and documentation.
* Own instrument engineering scope including sizing and specification of field devices (transmitters, control valves, flow elements), instrument index and hook-up drawing development, and hazardous area classification for new and modified installations; review instrument specifications prepared by junior engineers and contractors.
* Implement and configure industrial communication protocols (OPC-UA, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, Modbus TCP/RTU, DeviceNet); configure interfaces between PLCs, SCADA, historian, and third-party systems.
