Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  
  
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.  
  
In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:  

* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
* Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
* Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
* Maternity Leave (Short-Term Disability + Baby Bonding): 28-30 weeks
* Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
* Holidays: 13 paid days per year

  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Jose, CA, USA; Kirkland, WA, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA; Seattle, WA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience programming in C++.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.
* 3 years of experience with Android OS Internals.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, or related technical field.
* 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* 3 years of experience with performance, large-scale systems data analysis, visualization tools, or debugging.
* 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

  
The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Write and test product or system development code.
* Review code developed by other engineers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.
* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

new_jobs.description:
Whether you're a recent grad or a seasoned professional, you can experience meaningful career growth at Rosendin. We offer a wide range of job opportunities, competitive compensation, full benefits, an Employee Stock Ownership Plan and more.

**Why Rosendin?**
-----------------

**Committed. Innovative. Engaged.**
-----------------------------------

If you're looking to take your career to the next level and work with some of the best and brightest in the industry, we want to hear from you. Since our founding over 100+ years ago, Rosendin has been driven to positively impact the communities where we live and work. We are an organization built on integrity and we have a culture that empowers people, embraces diversity, and inspires everyone to do their best. As one of the largest EMPLOYEE-OWNED electrical contractors in the United States, you will have the unique benefit of being a shareholder at a company that is experiencing tremendous growth and success. When our people succeed and fuel our success, we reward them. We'd love to have you as a shareholder!

**YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY:**
--------------------------

The Engineer IV is a senior engineering position responsible for providing **advanced-level technical engineering support** for applicable codes, industry standards, best practices, and all essential underlying engineering/physics aspects of all projects or tasks. * Generate detailed project specifications for complex/intricate equipment and systems (specifications that are not standard form specs).
* Advanced knowledge of equipment and system testing and commissioning.
* Resolve various complex problems (i.e., conflicting design requirements, unsuitability of conventional materials, difficult coordination requirements).

* Ability to interact effectively and professionally with all levels of employees, both management and staff alike, vendors, clients, and others

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager, Agentic Infrastructure
new_jobs.description:
We're a team at Apple building the next generation of Private Cloud Compute inference and agentic services. Our work sits at the intersection of cloud services, machine learning, software experiences, and future Apple silicon. We deliver the server software that powers Apple Intelligence. We are seeking a deeply experienced software engineering manager to help drive our technology roadmap and software delivery.  
  
**Description**  
  
In this role, you will lead and grow a highly talented engineering organization responsible for designing and building agentic systems and the developer experiences around them. The work encompasses design of the core agentic architecture, the integration of various cloud services, and developer tooling. You will partner closely with cross-functional leaders across software experiences, ML research, hardware, system software, security, privacy, and SRE to define technical strategy and deliver production-grade systems running in the cloud. As a senior leader, you will not only guide complex technical architecture decisions but also shape the organizational culture, drive engineering excellence, and influence how AI-assisted workflows are adopted across the broader Apple ecosystem. You will be responsible for scaling successful prototypes into foundational production systems that the broader organization depends on. This position requires a self-motivated individual with strong technical depth, exceptional people management skills, and the ability to navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced, startup-like environment.","responsibilities":"Build, mentor, and manage an inclusive organization of high-performing engineers.  
  
Dedicate time to fostering talent, driving hiring and onboarding, managing performance, and prioritizing overall team health and growth paths.

Drive the execution of complex, multi-year projects end-to-end, balancing rapid iteration with long-term architectural stability.  
  
Partner closely with cross-functional product and cloud teams to enable delivery of seamless, secure, and delightful AI experiences.  
  
Foster a culture of engineering excellence and build for scale and performance, focusing on system reliability, scalable cloud architecture, observability, throughput and latency, cost efficiency, and robust evaluation metrics.  
  
Champion the adoption of generative AI tools and agentic workflows across the broader software organization to improve developer productivity and software quality.

Champion the security and privacy of user content, ensuring the team consistently applies secure-by-design and privacy-by-design principles in all architecture and delivery.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Strong working proficiency and conceptual understanding of generative AI, foundation models, and agentic workflows, with hands-on experience bringing AI systems to production at scale.  
  
Experience leading organizations through periods of significant growth or technical transformation, including building and evolving team structures to match scaling demands.  
  
Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with a genuine interest in software evaluation and using metrics to drive product and architectural decisions.  
  
Experience with Private Cloud Compute, on-device/cloud ML inference pipelines, or Apple silicon-adjacent infrastructure.  
  
Familiarity with secure-by-design and privacy-by-design principles as applied to cloud-based AI services.  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
10+ years of engineering management experience, with a proven track record of delivering complex, large-scale engineering projects across multiple teams or organizations.  
  
Solid technical foundation in software engineering, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure, with an ability to engage deeply with system design trade-offs.  
  
Demonstrated experience building and scaling developer tools, ML infrastructure, or AI systems from concept to production.  
  
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with high emotional intelligence and the ability to influence across all levels, from executive partners to individual contributors.  
  
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and handle rapidly shifting priorities without losing trust or execution discipline.  
  
Bachelor's, Master's, or equivalent professional experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, On-Device Health Agentic Systems
new_jobs.description:
We are seeking a senior iOS Software Engineer with deep experience building applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs). This is a hands-on development role focused on creating the next generation of intelligent on-device experiences for Apple users.  
  
You will be responsible for building cutting-edge iOS applications that serve as the primary interface for on-device AI. A key part of your role will be to explore and define the software architecture for a scalable, high-performance system that seamlessly integrates powerful LLM agents into the Apple ecosystem, all while prioritizing user privacy and on-device performance. This role is for an expert iOS developer passionate about building the foundational architecture for AI-driven applications.  
  
This is a unique opportunity to define the future of intelligent applications at Apple. You will be at the center of building a new class of on-device experiences, setting the architectural foundation for how millions of users will interact with AI on a daily basis.  
  
**Description**  
  
What you'll build:  
  

* AI-Powered iOS Applications: Architect and build innovative, high-performance on-device apps that showcase the power of intelligent LLM agents.

  

* Scalable On-Device Architecture: Design the client-side frameworks and architectural patterns for integrating LLM systems efficiently on iOS.

  

* LLM Agent Integration: Implement the software that connects user-facing applications to on-device and hybrid AI reasoning and planning engines.

  

* Interactive AI Prototypes: Rapidly build and iterate on application prototypes to explore new user interactions and architectural options.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Experience with on-device ML frameworks like Core ML, Foundation Model, etc.  
  
Experience in SwiftUI and modern iOS architectural patterns.  
  
Knowledge of model quantization, caching, and other on-device optimization techniques.

About us:

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.

What you'll do:

As a Senior Systems Engineer on the ACT team, you’ll turn early ideas into working prototypes — spanning satellite communications, PNT, and related systems — to test technical and operational hypotheses. You’ll own the front-end analysis — trade studies, feasibility assessments, and system architecture — that shapes what we build, and you’ll produce the clear artifacts that let a concept move forward for execution at scale. As the team’s senior systems engineer, you’ll be the technical anchor for the system model — driving how it’s structured and built, guiding the engineers doing the hands-on build, and keeping architecture, interfaces, and analysis coherent as prototypes evolve. This is a fast-paced, integrative role focused on prototyping, not production hardening.

The day-to-day:

* Run trade studies and feasibility analysis to compare concepts and recommend an approach.
* Develop system and subsystem concepts and architectures, and define interfaces (ICDs) across RF, digital, software, and timing — including for components sourced from different groups, aligned to representative open-architecture interfaces.
* Model and analyze system performance in MATLAB and/or Python (for example, link budgets, RF cascades, and error budgets).
* Perform quantitative modeling and analysis of signal, propagation, and geometry effects to support PNT, signals-of-opportunity, and communications concepts.
* Produce clean specifications, models, and hand-off artifacts so prototypes can transition for build-out at scale.
* Work closely across signal processing, embedded, FPGA, software, and integration & test to keep the integrated system coherent and performing — supporting prototype bring-up and testing, and keeping the system model current as the design evolves.

What you'll need:

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 8+ years of systems engineering or related experience.
* Systems engineering fundamentals: requirements development, trade studies, interface definition, and analysis.
* Proficiency in MATLAB and/or Python for modeling, simulation, and analysis.
* Working knowledge of RF, SATCOM/communications, or PNT domains.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including clear diagrams and documentation.
* Self-motivated and comfortable driving from concept to prototype implementation — working independently within your area while collaborating across disciplines.
* US citizenship required, with the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret clearance.

new_jobs.description:
Mechatronics Engineer

**About Us**
============

Schweid & Sons is a family-owned and operated premium ground beef company with a proud heritage spanning four generations. We supply top-quality beef to Retail, Foodservice, and National Account customers across the U.S. and are committed to quality, customer service, and innovation in protein manufacturing.

**The Role**
============

The Mechatronics Engineer is a professional engineering position responsible for researching, designing, developing, and testing automation, intelligent systems, and industrial control systems used in Schweid & Sons’ food manufacturing operations. Applying principles of mechanical, electrical, controls, and engineering, the Mechatronics Engineer designs and implements automated solutions and electromechanical and control-system improvements that increase the reliability, safety, quality, and throughput of production and facility systems. The position leads engineering analysis of equipment performance and failures, and provides technical direction to maintenance technicians and contractors in implementing engineered solutions.

**What You’ll Work On**
=======================

* **Automation Design.** Design, develop, and implement engineering systems and control solutions for the automation of industrial tasks, including the automated transfer, handling, processing, and packaging of materials, components, and finished goods.
* **Controls Engineering.** Design, develop, program, and implement control circuits, algorithms, and PLC, HMI, servo, and motion-control programs for electromechanical, pneumatic, and hydraulic devices and systems.
* **Component Selection.** Research, select, and apply sensors, communication technologies, industrial networks, and control devices for motion control, position sensing, pressure sensing, and electronic communication, and identify materials appropriate for mechatronic system designs, including sanitary-design requirements.
* **Equipment Upgrades and Design Documentation.** Upgrade the design of existing production equipment by adding mechatronic elements; create mechanical design documents, electrical drawings, and specifications for parts, assemblies, and modifications using computer-aided design (CAD) software.
* **Modeling, Testing, and Commissioning.** Create models or simulations to evaluate mechatronic design concepts; implement, test, and commission design solutions; and document qualification test results before release to production.
* **Feasibility and Cost Analysis.** Determine the feasibility, costs, and performance benefits of new mechatronic equipment and capital or continuous-improvement projects; prepare engineering cost estimates and project justifications, and monitor project and equipment-related costs against budget.
* **Engineering Analysis and Process Improvement.** Analyze existing manufacturing procedures and equipment performance, downtime, and failure data; lead engineering root-cause analysis; and recommend and implement design or process improvements that increase reliability, safety, quality, throughput, and maintainability.
* **Calibration and Optimization.** Monitor and calibrate automated systems, industrial control systems, and system components to maximize efficiency of production.
* **Reliability Engineering.** Define the engineering requirements of preventive and predictive maintenance programs for automated production equipment, utilities, and facility systems; evaluate equipment condition and lifecycle; and recommend repairs, replacements, upgrades, and lifecycle plans.
* **Technical Troubleshooting Support.** Provide engineering support in diagnosing complex mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, instrumentation, robotics, PLC, HMI, servo, sensor, and controls failures, and direct the restoration of safe operation to minimize downtime.
* **Technical Direction and Training.** Provide technical guidance, consultation, and training on mechatronics and automated control to maintenance technicians, operations personnel, and management; assign, schedule, and review the technical work of maintenance technicians in accordance with company policies.
* **Contractor Oversight.** Oversee the work of contractors, integrators, and vendors in accordance with project requirements, including scope, specifications, schedule, safe work practices, quality, and acceptance testing.
* **Technical Records.** Maintain technical project files and publish engineering reports documenting design details; maintain electrical drawings, control-program backups, technical documentation, spare-parts specifications, and standard operating procedures.
* **Standards and Compliance.** Ensure designs and work comply with applicable electrical and mechanical codes and standards, workplace safety requirements (including lockout/tagout), food-safety and sanitary-design practices, company procedures, and regulatory requirements.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration.** Partner with Operations, Quality, Safety, and vendors to define equipment requirements, prioritize engineering work, and plan shutdowns and project execution.
* **On-Call Engineering Support.** Participate in an on-call rotation and provide after-hours engineering support when required by operational needs.
* Complete additional responsibilities as assigned, consistent with the professional engineering nature of the position.

**What You Bring**
==================

**Must-Haves**
--------------

* Bachelor’s degree, or foreign equivalent (including a Mexican licenciatura or Canadian baccalaureate degree), in Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation or Controls Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline.
* At least 3 years of professional engineering experience designing, programming, testing, or improving automated manufacturing equipment, including PLC-controlled electromechanical systems.
* At least 2 years of experience leading technical project tea

Rainforest is an early stage payments-as-a-service startup that has developed a solution that makes monetizing payments for vertically focused software platforms fair and simple.

We're looking for a hands-on Software Engineer to help build agentic products for our customers. You’ve worked end-to-end, from scoping the work to shipping it and keeping it reliable as usage grows. Become a part of ENERCON as a Senior or Principal Instrumentation and Controls Design Engineer. We are seeking talented I&C Engineers to join our Nuclear Design Group.

Our Instrumentation & Controls Engineer career path has many options. You can bring your experience to our mid-level and senior roles, or step into a principal engineer position where you’ll lead and mentor others. We continually invest in our employees and provide training and tools for advancement, development, and career progression—whether you prefer a path to become a subject matter or technical expert, a people leader, a project manager, or a leader in business development. We are currently hiring for full-time roles in the following locations:

* Glendale, AZ
* San Luis Obispo, CA
* Kennewick, WA
* Chattanooga, TN
* Kennesaw, GA (Suburb of Atlanta)
* Naperville, IL (Suburb of Chicago)
* Overland Park, KS
* Ft Worth, TX
* Baton Rouge, LA
* Palm Beach Gardens, FL
* Birmingham, AL
* Pensacola, FL
* Tampa, FL
* Huntsville, AL
* Oak Ridge, TN
* Charlotte, NC
* King of Prussia, PA

We are looking for Instrumentation and Control Systems Engineers to be part of multi-discipline project teams that perform upgrades and modifications to nuclear power plants. The subject matter will be in the following areas:

* Digital Systems, such as PLCs, DCSs, Human System Interfaces, network devices, and similar control systems
* Sensing instruments and transmitters for level, pressure, flow, temperature, reactivity, vibration, position, and speed.
* Functional Requirements and Procurement Specifications for instrumentation and control systems
* Design change package preparation and review/design verification per industry and client standards
* Provide guidance as a mentor in the development of less experienced nuclear instrumentation and controls design engineers

Responsibilities:

As a key member of our engineering department, you'll collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to support the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of commercial nuclear power facilities. A typical day may include conducting electrical assessments, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, updating plant drawings and documentation, reviewing vendor submittals, and implementing innovative solutions to enhance plant reliability and safety.

* **Develop Engineering Deliverables:** Produce precise and error-free drawings, calculations, and analyses that exceed industry codes, standards, and client expectations, ensuring every project is built on a solid foundation of accuracy
* **Set the Standard:** Develop engineering documents that not only meet but surpass client, ENERCON, and regulatory requirements, adhering to processes that guarantee excellence every step of the way
* **Stay on the Cutting Edge:** Continuously enhance your expertise in industry codes, safety culture principles, and advanced design techniques, staying ahead in the dynamic nuclear sector
* **Drive Quality & Precision:** Deliver exceptional engineering solutions that align with rigorous quality assurance programs and consistently raise the bar for project performance
* **Cultivate Strong Client Connections:** Build trust and lasting relationships through clear communication, professional engagement, and the consistent delivery of superior engineering results
* **Collaborate Across Disciplines:** Partner seamlessly with multidisciplinary teams to create integrated, well-rounded designs that meet diverse project requirements
* **Provide Field Support:** Take your expertise on-site, engaging directly with client personnel, performing detailed plant walkdowns, and ensuring all structures, systems, and components meet the highest engineering standards #LI-MB1

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Computer, Mechanical, Nuclear Engineering, or related field in Engineering or equivalent education/experience
* A minimum of 6 years of experience in design engineering of instrumentation and control systems; preferably for nuclear power, 10+ years experience for Principal Level
* Experience with power plant instrumentation and controls systems design for either BWR or PWR units, including turbine/feedwater controls, radiation monitoring, HVAC/chiller controls, reactor protection, plant process computers, and human system interfaces
* Experience in preparing, marking up, and reviewing design drawings, instrument data sheets, and software/cyber security documents
* Experience developing system requirement/ procurement specifications, design descriptions/control narratives, test plans/test procedures, and requirements traceability matrixes
* Must have experience in power generation, nuclear power or government (DOE) projects directly or with an engineering/design consulting firm
* Good writing, presentation and communication skills
* Ability to be an individual contributor and work effectively in teams
* Proficient in Word and Excel
* Due to Federal Contract Requirements, US Citizenship is required
* Approximate travel of 10% as needed

Pay Range: USD $107,200.00 - USD $192,100.00 /Yr. Additional Information:

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

-------------------

new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

This entry level/early career professional, applied science position utilizes the core competencies of thermal and fluid sciences, using and advancing analytical and experimental approaches to answer key questions about the performance and architecture of a system or component. This drives decisions and creates technical content which ultimately leads to state of the art, highly effective, environmentally friendly, and competitive products.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Investigates product, system, and/or technology problems that are related to thermal and fluid sciences, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution and documents results with guidance from more experienced team members. Applies and supports the improvement of processes such as Pre Program Planning, (PPP), Product Preceding Technology, (PPT), Value Package Introduction (VPI), or Value Package Change, (VPC), Engineering Standard Work, (ESW), Functional Excellence Practice (FEP) and tools related to thermal and fluid sciences such as GT-Suite, Boost, Fluent, Converge, Concerto, CyberApps (virtual application model), Cummins Data Analysis Tool (CDAT), Mach, test data calculation, DARTS, test data storage, Calterm, Electronic Control Module (ECM) calibration tool, Emissions data system, Integrity, and ACCEPTS ECM in-loop test bench required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making. Obtains input and negotiates with immediate stakeholders, such as team members, technical managers, project leaders, other Thermal Sciences engineers, product and manufacturing engineers, and supplier partners and delivers information and recommendations to support project decisions, or to provide input related to further analysis, design optimization, feasibility studies, or architecture definition. Makes decisions in the areas of day to day project details, such as conducting analysis, testing, and communication with stakeholders that impact and support the successful progression of projects. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role.

**Competencies:**

Applies Principles of Fluid Dynamics and Heat Transfer - Interprets and predicts the performance of fluid and thermal systems by leveraging a quantitative and intuitive comprehension of the flow of liquids and gases, the transfer of thermal energy between elements of a system, and the application of modeling and experimental tools, to answer key questions about the system or component.

Applies Principles of Thermodynamics and Energy Conversion Systems - Interprets and predicts the performance of energy conversion systems such as IC engines, gas turbines, fuel cells, and batteries, by leveraging a quantitative and intuitive comprehension of thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, modeling tools, controls, and experimental tools to answer key questions about the system or component.

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged

T-Mobile Home Internet is one of our fastest growing businesses, and the software this team builds runs on every gateway and mesh extender we put in a customer's home. We're a small development team on a large program, so you'll contribute to meaningful software development work from the start.  
  
You'll develop the device agents that manage, monitor, and troubleshoot our broadband customer premises equipment. They're written in C and C++ against the Broadband Forum's open USP standards and run on the RDK-B platform. The agent uses a microservice architecture, and you'll develop and maintain assigned services within the established architecture.  
  
Your agents will interface with the device's Wi-Fi and cellular subsystems through RDK and RBUS. You won't be writing Wi-Fi drivers or modem firmware, but understanding those technologies, and how RDK components talk to each other, is central to doing this job well.

* Build and maintain the containerized services that run on the device, delivered through a Kubernetes-based packaging and deployment pipeline.

This role is essential for designing, implementing, and deploying scalable software solutions that meet customer requirements and support high availability environments. The role involves collaborating with engineering teams to develop software components using technologies such as virtualization, microservices, software-defined networking, network functions virtualization, and broadband device management. This position requires independent development of software components and understanding system protocols, data flows, and technology interactions, including those supporting broadband customer premises equipment (CPE). Success is measured by the ability to deliver technical solutions, produce clear documentation, and contribute to technology strategy and innovation. The work impacts the organization by enabling advanced software systems that improve operational efficiency and support business goals.

**Main Responsibilities**

* Develop software solutions that support engineering projects and meet customer requirements, including developing and maintaining embedded software components and device management services for broadband CPE.
* Collaborate with technical teams to deliver effective technical solutions and continuously learn new technologies, including supporting software debugging, testing, release verification, and defect investigation with OEM partners.

* Also responsible for other duties/projects as assigned by business management as needed.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree plus 3 years of related work experience OR advanced degree with 1 year of related work experience OR combination of education and experience deemed equivalent.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Develop FPGA firmware (VHDL) from concept through implementation, evaluation, and deployment

Symbotic’s vision is automation at large scale, carried by physical AI. It starts in the warehouse, where robots see, decide, and move goods at extraordinary speed and density — and extends to new platforms and applications still taking shape. As that vision grows, so does the challenge: turning intelligence into physical action through the power, sensing, compute, harnesses, and electrical integration that bring Physical AI to life.

Symbotic is seeking a Principal Electrical Engineer to drive electrical design for automated material-handling robots and related platforms. In this role you will lead the conceptualization, architecture, design, analysis, fabrication, integration, and test of complex electrical systems — not only PCBAs and cables, but the full bot-level electrical system — from concept through production.

You will set technical direction for other electrical designers, work through Symbotic’s Product Development Process (PDP), and partner with PLM and contract manufacturers so designs can be built, qualified, and released at volume.

The Electrical Engineering – Bot Hardware team is part of Symbotic’s Hardware Engineering organization and develops the electrical hardware that powers and connects our robotic systems. Our team designs PCB-based electronics, harnesses, and electrical interfaces that support power distribution, sensing, compute, communications, and control across our automation platforms. new_jobs.description:
**Position Description:**
  
We are seeking an experienced Android Full-Stack Engineer to join our platform stability team. In this role, you will be responsible for diagnosing, debugging, and resolving complex Android stability issues spanning the entire Android stack both above (System Partition) and below (Vendor Partition) the Treble boundary. You will work deep within Android framework internals, reverse-engineering issues from source code, providing technical direction for ambiguous problems, and ensuring overall platform robustness across Android version upgrades. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who thrives on solving the hardest, least-understanding problems in the Android ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and develop middleware and Android background services for platform-level functionality
* Debug and reverse-engineer complex issues directly from Android Open-Source Project (AOSP) source code Own overall Android platform stability and reliability
* Resolve Android upgrade and integration issues across releases
* Diagnose and fix bugs in system server components (Activity Manager, Window Manager, Package Manager, etc.), Car Service, and Surface Flinger
* Investigate and resolve black screen, boot failure, and ANR (Application Not Responding) issues 6. Resolve and provide technical direction and root-cause analysis for unknown or hard-to-reproduce issues
* Address and resolve compliance test failures across CTS, VTS, ATS, and STS

**Primary Skills Required:** Kotlin, C++ and Java

**Experience Required:**

* 3+ years of hands-on Android platform/framework development experience.
* Proven experience in designing and developing middleware and Android background services (long-running/foreground service) that expose feature-rich interfaces (AIDL/Binder, APIs) to applications.
* Demonstrated track record of resolving complex, low-level Android stability issues.
* Experience contributing to or modifying AOSP source code
* Proven experience working across the full Android stack (framework, native services, vendor layers)

**Additional Experience Preferred:**

* Experience with Android Automotive OS (AAOS) and Car Service.
* Familiarity with HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) and vendor integration.
* Experience with CTS, VTS, ATS, and STS compliance frameworks.
* Knowledge of Android graphics stack and display subsystems
* Experience with native debugging tools (gdb, lldb, perfetto, systrace, logcat analysis).
* Familiarity with Android build systems (Soong/Make) and partition architecture.
* Experience working with SoC/silicon vendors on platform bring-up

**Additional Context for Suppliers:**

* This role requires a deep-dive, problem-solving mindset and the ability to operate independently on ambiguous, high-impact issues.
* The ideal candidate is comfortable being the technical authority for the most challenging stability problems and can provide direction for other engineers.
* Experience in the automotive or embedded Android domain is a strong plus given to our focus on system server, car service and platform stability.

new_jobs.description:
**Role Summary**
----------------

The **Systems Engineer** is an entry-level engineering position supporting the development, integration, and validation of automotive 12V electrical systems and components.

In this role, you will work closely with experienced system, component, and validation engineers to set up, coordinate, perform, monitor, and document both vehicle-level and laboratory validation testing. Key responsibilities include preparing engineering work orders, supporting the development of validation test plans and procedures, collecting and analyzing empirical test data, and assisting with the root-cause investigation and resolution of vehicle electrical system issues.

This position covers components and subsystems within the low-voltage power domain, including:

* 12V lead-acid batteries (Flooded and AGM technologies)
* Alternators and intelligent charging systems
* DC/AC power inverters
* Battery Monitoring Sensors (BMS) and smart sensing devices
* Power control relays and related power switching hardware

**Key Responsibilities & Deliverables**
---------------------------------------

### **Systems Integration & Laboratory Validation**

* **Validation Setup & Testing:** Set up, execute, and monitor laboratory bench tests and vehicle-level validation procedures for 12V power components and systems.
* **Documentation & Work Orders:** Prepare engineering work orders (EWOs), author test reports, and document detailed validation results against technical performance specifications.
* **Data Collection & Analysis:** Collect, process, and analyze electrical measurement data (voltage, current, thermal, network signal logs) to verify functional compliance.

### **Root-Cause Analysis & Issue Resolution**

* **Troubleshooting:** Assist lead engineers with identifying, logging, and resolving electrical system anomalies, parasitic draws, and communication errors during vehicle testing.
* **Requirements & Test Plan Support:** Collaborate with cross-functional teams to continuously refine test procedures, acceptance criteria, and environmental test profiles.

### **Basic Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related engineering discipline from an accredited university.
* **Experience Level:** 0–2 years of engineering experience (entry-level or applicable engineering internship/co-op experience).
* **Technical Fundamentals:**

  + Fundamental understanding of electrical circuits, Ohm's law, DC power distribution, and component-level electronics.
  + Hands-on experience with standard electrical measurement equipment (multimeters, oscilloscopes, current clamps, data acquisition systems).
  + Interest or background in automotive 12V power management, battery technology, and charging logic.
* **Core Skills:**

  + Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  + Excellent written and verbal communication skills for documenting technical reports.
  + High accountability and eager to learn in a hands-on, fast-paced vehicle testing environment.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with automotive vehicle testing, bench testing, or vehicle electrical troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with automotive vehicle communication networks (CAN, LIN).
* Knowledge of lead-acid battery chemistries (Flooded/AGM), charging strategies, or DC/AC power conversion.
* Experience writing or executing test plans and validation scripts.
* Background in MATLAB, Python, CANoe/CANalyzer, or similar data analysis and signal-logging tools.

new_jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

Lead the design, development, board layout, testing, and system integration of complex printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) and custom hardware components.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

· Hardware Architecture & Circuit Design: Design digital, analog, mixed-signal, and power distribution hardware architectures. Select components, perform worst-case analyses, use design tools such as Altium Designer or KiCad.

· System Design and Integration: Inform design and product management using application requirements for target markets, competing and complimentary power electronics products, and downstream system standards and requirements.

· PCB Layout & Routing: Perform or directly supervise multi-layer PCB layouts, taking into account signal integrity (SI), power integrity (PI), thermal management, and strict Design for Manufacturing/Assembly (DFM/DFA) guidelines.

· Prototyping & Board Bring-Up: Lead hands-on assembly, testing, debugging, and verification of initial hardware prototypes using laboratory equipment (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, dynamic loads).

· Firmware & Software Collaboration: Partner closely with embedded firmware, software, and mechanical engineering teams to define interface protocols, pinouts, mechanical enclosures, and system test points.

· Regulatory & Compliance: Design for Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC/EMI), ESD protection, and environmental compliance (UL, CE, FCC, RoHS). Prepare and support hardware for third-party compliance testing.

· Manufacturing & Supply Chain Support: Generate comprehensive manufacturing documentation (Gerber files, drill charts, BOMs, schematic PDF packages, assembly drawings). Collaborate with vendors and contract manufacturers (CMs) to resolve component obsolescence or DFM issues.

· Collaboration & Quality Standards: Establish and promote internal hardware design standards, review peer schematics and PCB layouts, work with support teams to perform analysis and troubleshooting on products in the field, and mentor junior engineers.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

· Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE), Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.

· 5+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in electronics engineering and hardware development.

· Proven track record of designing, layout routing, and releasing multi-layer PCBs (4+ layers, high-speed routing, controlled impedance, thermal management, and/or rigid-flex experience preferred).

· Proficiency in industry-standard schematic capture and PCB layout tools (e.g., Altium Designer, Cadence Allegro, KiCAD, PADS).

· Advanced proficiency with bench tools including digital storage oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and precision multimeters.

· Solid understanding of common hardware protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, Ethernet, USB, PCIe) and power supply architectures (buck/boost regulators, LDOs, battery management).

· Demonstrated understanding of IPC standards (IPC-2221, IPC-A-610), manufacturing processes, component sourcing, and Gerber generation.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

● Experience with wireless standard implementations (Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, LoRa, or Cellular hardware integration).

● Knowledge of signal integrity (SI) and power integrity (PI) simulation tools (e.g., Ansys, HyperLynx).

● Scripting capability (Python, C/C++) for laboratory test automation and hardware validation.

● Prior experience working in regulated industries (automotive, aerospace, medical devices, or energy storage).

Pay: $115,000.00 - $175,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

**Robotics Engineer**

*Robotic Manipulation and Embodied AI*

Richtech Robotics is seeking a Robotics Engineer to develop and deploy autonomous robotic systems. This role combines strong robotics fundamentals with hands-on experience in vision-guided manipulation, vision-language-action (VLA) models, and world models. You will own complete workflows, from perception and motion planning to execution on real hardware, and improve their accuracy, reliability, and ability to handle changing conditions.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop manipulation workflows for grasping, pick-and-place, assembly, and interaction with equipment.
* Implement and optimize forward and inverse kinematics (IK), coordinate transforms, motion planning, collision avoidance, and trajectory execution; resolve reachability, singularity, and joint-limit issues.
* Build vision-guided robotics pipelines using RGB or depth cameras, object detection, segmentation, 6D pose estimation, camera calibration, hand-eye calibration, and tool center point (TCP) calibration.
* Integrate robot arms, grippers, cameras, sensors, and device APIs into reliable systems with feedback, fault handling, and recovery.
* Collect and prepare robot demonstration data; train or fine-tune VLA policies and evaluate their performance in simulation and on physical robots.
* Develop and evaluate world models or learned dynamics models for predicting action outcomes, planning, or improving robot learning.
* Measure task success, positioning error, cycle time, and robustness; diagnose failures across perception, calibration, control, and learned policies, and support deployment.

**Required qualifications**

* Master's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field
* Demonstrated ownership of working robotic manipulation systems deployed and tested on physical hardware.
* Strong understanding of kinematics, rigid-body transformations, robot control, motion planning, and the relationship between perception accuracy and manipulation performance.
* Hands-on experience with vision-guided robotics, including calibration and converting camera observations into executable robot motions.
* Practical VLA experience covering dataset preparation, model training or fine-tuning, inference integration, and evaluation beyond a pretrained demo.
* Hands-on experience implementing or adapting world models or learned dynamics models, with experiments that assess their usefulness for robotics tasks.
* Strong Python and C++ skills, experience with ROS 2 and Linux, and proficiency with PyTorch or an equivalent learning framework.
* Ability to turn research into tested implementations, debug across software and hardware, and document results clearly.

**Preferred experience**

Experience with Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or equivalent simulators; simulation-to-real transfer; imitation or reinforcement learning; force or impedance control; and mobile or dual-arm manipulation.

* Knowledge of MATLAB, Simulink, or Python for modeling, analysis, and algorithm development. Ada programming is a plus.

*Total compensation may also include equity in the form of restricted stock units.*

  

**About Fluidstack**
====================

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

  

**We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!**

**How We Operate**
==================

* **Be a barrel.** Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.
* **Insane urgency.** We drive everything forward as fast as possible.
* **Reason from first principles.** Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.
* **Love of the game.** The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.
* **Build something that actually matters.** If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

**The Production Engineering Team**
===================================

**Examples of key exciting problems the team is working on**

* **Turn every network fault from a mystery into a closed ticket:** link diagnostics across router-router and NIC-to-router paths, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows exactly what's broken and why. At this scale, debugging has to be systematic, not artisanal.
* **Build the network repair pipeline that runs itself:** from automated fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver lifecycle tracking, and return to service, across DC fabric, edge, and host-to-network layers. When a new site comes online every six months, manual repair doesn't keep up.
* **Build the network monitoring platform for a fleet that never stops growing:** define requirements, alerting lifecycle, and health dashboards from scratch, for infrastructure spanning multiple hyperscale sites today and 10s to 100s of GWs ahead. It doesn't exist yet. We're building it.

**Role Scope**
==============

* **Own network fleet health end to end.** Define the realtime monitoring requirements, build the alerting lifecycle, and ship the dashboards that give every on-call engineer a true picture of network state across all sites.
* **Build active debugging tooling.** Link diagnostics, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization — the tools that turn a network fault from a mystery into a solvable problem, fast.
* **Turn repair into a pipeline, not a procedure.** Build the automation that takes a network failure from detection through parts management and return to service. Ticket integration, repair lifecycle pipelines, transceiver and optics tracking — owned, not improvised.
* **Own network qualification and validation**. Build the frameworks that gate new sites and hardware into production. You define what a healthy network looks like before it carries traffic.
* **Own end-to-end reliability, scalability, and operation of the network at-scale.** Fluidstack is building one of the largest datacenter networks in the world and that can only be accomplished with aggressive automation, tooling, and incident discipline.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

**The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly,** **tell us where you would.**

* You treat toil as a bug. If diagnosing a link failure requires SSHing into boxes and running commands by hand, you build the tool that does it for you.
* You think in systems. You understand how a transceiver fault, a misconfigured route, and a power event each propagate differently — and you build tooling that can tell them apart.
* You move toward ambiguity, not away from it. You walk into the fog, build the map, and explain it to everyone else.
* You learn at a steep slope. You reach real competence in an unfamiliar domain fast. We value this over existing expertise.
* You carry a pager without flinching. You run the incident, write the postmortem, fix the systemic cause, and move on.
* You're fluent with AI tooling. LLM APIs, MCP servers

new_jobs.title: Hardware Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**About Perry Weather**

Perry Weather is the weather safety standard for organizations that operate outdoors. We combine on-site weather hardware with a software platform that automates alerts, siren activations, and safety decisions for more than 3,000 organizations — from the PGA of America, the NFL, and MLB to Turner Construction, thousands of school districts, cities, and golf courses. We've grown 80%+ annually for five consecutive years, and are continuing to grow.

We're headquartered in Dallas at The Centrum, in the Oak Lawn neighborhood, where our teams work together every day to help organizations make faster and safer decisions when weather puts people, assets, and operations at risk.

**About the role**

Perry Weather builds field-deployed weather monitoring and outdoor warning hardware —lightning detection, weather sensors, sirens, and strobe warning units. These units run unattended on solar and battery power through extreme weather, and when something fails, it fails at a customer site, not on a bench.

We're hiring an Electrical Engineer to join and contribute to the hardware platform: PCB verification and manufacturing readiness, component sourcing and obsolescence management, power system design, and root-cause investigation when field hardware misbehaves.

**Responsibilities**

* **Schematic capture & PCB layout execution.** Work in Altium Designer on new revisions and design changes under the Staff Engineer's architectural review — not from a blank sheet, but with real ownership of the layout and component placement.
* **Impedance & DFM verification.** Confirm controlled-impedance nets (e.g. USB differential pairs at 90Ω, Ethernet at 100Ω) against fab documentation, and manage the CM / Fab House submission and review process — including catching placement/conversion errors in PnP/CPL files before they become a bad board run.
* **Component sourcing & BOM management.** When parts go obsolete or out of stock, find and validate drop-in or near-equivalent replacements (electrical spec + footprint), and keep the BOM current as revisions ship.
* **Power system design.** Prototype and characterize 12V/24V power architectures, select load-switch/eFuse ICs for new switched rails, and run battery/solar runtime characterization (current draw across operating modes, worst-case load estimation).
* **Protocol-level hardware integration.** Bring new sensors and peripherals onto the Custom PCB Carrier through its approved expansion interfaces — GPIO, Modbus RS-485, I²C, and Ethernet/IP — working within the platform's defined GPIO/bus budget rather than requesting ad hoc hardware revisions.
* **Field hardware RCA.** Reproduce field-reported hardware issues (siren/strobe not clearing, speaker output degradation, sensor readings out of range) on the bench using scopes, DMMs, and electronic loads/shunts, isolate root cause, and drive the fix into the next design or manufacturing revision.
* **Manufacturing process improvement.** Own discrete process problems end-to-end — e.g. grounding/ESD compliance fixes on the line, reducing manual bottlenecks in assembly/configuration steps, and building out the automated manufacturing test fixture (hardware harness + pass/fail criteria) the team doesn't have yet.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience.
* 5-7 years of hands-on electrical/hardware engineering, ideally on field-deployed products.
* Real experience in Altium Designer (or similar) for schematic capture and PCB layout — this should be work you've shipped, not coursework.
* Comfort verifying board designs against fab constraints: controlled impedance, differential pairs, power trace sizing.
* Experience selecting components from datasheets, including sourcing alternates under supply constraints.
* Working knowledge of power electronics fundamentals: regulation, load switching, battery/solar-powered system design.
* Practical familiarity with I²C, RS-485/Modbus, and Ethernet/IP at the level of integrating a real device, not just protocol theory.
* Bench instrumentation skills: oscilloscope, DMM, electronic load, and comfort measuring current/voltage under dynamic or switched load.
* Experience with root-cause analysis on returned or field-failed hardware.
* Direct experience working with contract manufacturers or PCB fab houses (DFM/DFT, build readiness, process improvement).

**Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with embedded C/C++ and embedded Linux (U-Boot, device tree, board bring-up) — useful for reading firmware well enough to help isolate whether a failure is hardware or firmware, not for owning the codebase.
* Exposure to OTA update/bootloader concepts.
* Experience with cellular modems (Quectel or similar).
* Basic scripting (Python) for test automation or tooling.
* Exposure to outdoor/ruggedized enclosure design, solar/battery systems, or safety-critical/regulated hardware.

**Benefits**

* **You'll want to come into the office.** Our Oak Lawn office isn't just a place to sit — it's where ideas move fast and culture stays strong. The whole team is here Monday through Friday, which means real collaboration, no chasing people down over Slack, and a genuinely fun place to spend your work days.
* **Your wellbeing is covered.** Competitive health insurance, 401(k) with employer matching, and a full suite of voluntary benefits, because you shouldn't have to think twice about the basics.
* **Good people, good times.** Monthly All-Hands, Office Olympics, happy hours, and more. We take the work seriously and the culture seriously too.
* **You're getting in early, and that matters.** We're growing fast, but the biggest opportunities are still ahead. The people joining now will help shape what Perry Weather becomes.

**Who We Are**

  

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

  
  

**What We Offer**

  

Salary:

$116,000.00 - $159,500.00

Location:

Austin,TX, Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits .

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Find the test gaps that matter.** Use field failures, factory nonconformances, failure analysis, 8D findings, FMEA/FMECA risks, and test data to identify where existing assurance methods failed to detect risk before shipment.
* **Translate failure mechanisms into testable requirements.** Convert complex failure signatures and real-world operating conditions into specific, measurable, and defensible requirements that engineering teams and suppliers can execute.
* **Engineer system-representative test coverage.** Define the functional, parametric, stress, burn-in, thermal, RF, high-voltage, leak, particle, interlock, and other tests needed to expose targeted failure modes before they reach an Applied factory or customer.
* **Challenge assumptions with evidence.** Question legacy test methods, inherited limits, and accepted practices when they are not supported by data. Use engineering judgment, structured problem solving, and experimentation to determine what the evidence requires.
* **Own the test solution from concept through sustained deployment.** Evaluate feasibility, develop the technical concept, define the specification and statement of work, establish cost and schedule, and lead design, sourcing, build, bring-up, validation, and production implementation.
* **Prove that the test works.** Establish correlation, repeatability, reproducibility, measurement capability, calibration requirements, and acceptance criteria. Demonstrate with objective evidence that the solution detects the intended failure mode under production-representative conditions.
* **Deploy capability where it prevents the greatest risk.** Bring test systems into operation at suppliers and Applied factories. Resolve implementation issues, coordinate engineering changes, and ensure the solution is practical, scalable, and ready for production use.
* **Preserve test effectiveness throughout the lifecycle.** Establish the preventive-maintenance, calibration, out-of-tolerance response, configuration control, data retention, and performance-monitoring requirements necessary to keep deployed test systems reliable and effective.
* **Measure outcomes, not activity.** Monitor detection effectiveness, test-system performance, false failures, escapes, NCs, DMRs, and other relevant quality and operational indicators. Use the results to verify effectiveness and identify the next improvement opportunity.
* **Prevent recurrence at the source.** Apply lessons from escapes to improve supplier test mandates, Functional Requirements Documents, FMEA/FMECA, Design for Testability, and applicable product-lifecycle deliverables so that prevention becomes part of how future products are developed.
* **Lead across organizational boundaries.** Drive multiple complex initiatives across suppliers, factories, Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Supplier Engineering, NPI Quality, Product Quality & Reliability, and business-unit teams. Communicate technical conclusions, risks, decisions, and business impact with clarity.
* **Build scalable Test Excellence capability.** Create reusable requirements, methods, standards, specifications, and validation practices. Mentor other engineers, transfer knowledge, and raise the organization’s ability to find the right problems and solve them permanently.
  

  

You will turn real-world failures and emerging risks into test solutions that prevent defects from reaching our factories and customers. From defining system-representative requirements to developing, validating, and deploying test fixtures, you will own the solution from insight to sustained impact. You will challenge assumptions with evidence, work across suppliers and engineering teams, and help build the methods and standards that define Test Excellence globally.

Yes

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. You will be joining Valar Atomics' Electrical Engineering team, embedded within the broader Fuel Manufacturing engineering group. The team delivers the electrical infrastructure that powers Valar's fuel manufacturing facilities, including process area LV distribution, motor control, and emergency power. You will work alongside I&C, mechanical, and nuclear safety engineers in a collaborative environment that demands technical precision and a strong safety culture. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to some of the most technically interesting power distribution challenges in the advanced nuclear sector.

**The Role**

Valar Atomics is seeking an Electrical Engineer to support the design and delivery of low voltage electrical systems for nuclear fuel manufacturing facilities. The role will contribute to LV system design, power system studies, equipment selection, drawings, specifications and field support while working closely with senior electrical engineers and multidisciplinary teams. This is an opportunity to work on first-of-a-kind industrial facilities and develop hands-on experience with complex electrical systems in the nuclear industry.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Develop and maintain electrical load lists and support power system studies, including load flow, short circuit, voltage drop, motor starting and harmonic analysis, using SKM Power Tools, ETAP, EasyPower or equivalent.

* Support grounding and bonding design for LV systems in accordance with NEC Article 250 and IEEE 142.

* Support specifications and data sheets for LV electrical equipment and industrial control panels to UL 508A / IEC 61439.
* Support electrical area classification drawings and selection of equipment for hazardous locations in accordance with NEC Articles 500/505 or IEC 60079.

**Basic Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
* 1+ years of electrical engineering experience, preferably in industrial, process, power generation or other complex facilities.
* Understanding of LV electrical distribution systems and fundamental electrical engineering principles.
* Familiarity with power system analysis software such as SKM Power Tools, ETAP, EasyPower or equivalent.
* Familiarity with electrical design deliverables, including single line diagrams, load lists, equipment specifications, cable schedules and electrical layouts.
* Working knowledge of the NEC, NFPA 70E, IEEE, ANSI and NEMA standards.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

  

* EIT designation or active pursuit thereof.
* Experience with LV switchboards, MCCs, VFDs, UPS systems or standby power systems.
* Experience performing or supporting short circuit, arc flash or protective device coordination studies.
* Familiarity with hazardous location classification and static electricity control (NFPA 77).
* Experience with industrial control panel design or review to UL 508A or IEC 61439.
* Experience with DC systems and battery sizing.
* Familiarity with nuclear quality requirements (e.g., ASME NQA-1) or nuclear fuel facility design.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive base salary
* Equity ownership in a rapidly growing advanced energy company
* Comprehensive medical benefits
* Unlimited PTO
* Free daily lunch
* Generous PPE stipend
* High-impact startup environment with significant ownership and autonomy
* Opportunities for rapid career growth and internal advancement
* Direct collaboration with experienced operators, engineers, and industry leaders
* The opportunity to help build and scale transformative energy technology from the ground up

You will work alongside I&C Hardware, process, and nuclear safety engineers in an environment that blends traditional control systems with modern software and data integration practice. Valar Atomics is seeking a Senior Automation and Controls Engineer to develop, configure, test, and commission the control system software for nuclear fuel manufacturing facilities. * Configure and troubleshoot industrial communication protocols in software including OPC-UA, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, Modbus TCP/RTU, and DeviceNet; configure server and client endpoints, tag mapping, and interfaces between SCADA and PLC, DCS, SIS, historian, and third-party systems.

Serco seeks a Cyber Systems Engineer for its Combat Air Force Distributed Mission Operations (CAF DMO) 3.0 program in Hampton, VA. The CAF DMO 3.0 program, via its Distributed Mission Operations Network (DMON), provides world-class integration training in large force and small team formats to combat units around the globe against cutting-edge threats in a boundless virtual battlespace. The U.S. Air Force can only utilize its full capability against modern threats in a virtual environment. Be a part of that environment and continue to make the USAF the best air force in the world. You will be part of a focused team of engineers to perform test, integration, and evaluation of disparate M&S systems and applications to support 5th and 6th generation training interoperability. The team will work closely with the DoD customer and other Serco teams at Langley AFB and Orlando, FL to deliver quality test services.

**This position is contingent upon your ability to maintain/transfer a DoD Secret Security clearance and eligible to obtain a TS/SCI and SAP/SAR.**

As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptable power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. new_jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer, Amazon Special Projects
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Innovators wanted! Are you an entrepreneur? A builder? A dreamer? This role is part of an Amazon Special Projects team that takes the company’s Think Big leadership principle to the highest levels. We focus on creating entirely new products and services with a goal of positively impacting the lives of our customers. No industries or subject areas are out of bounds. We launched products such as Comprehend Medical, Echo Frames and Amazon Explore. If you’re interested in innovating at scale to address big challenges in the world, this is the team for you.  
As the Sr. Systems Engineer, you will own the agent daemon that runs on compute nodes, the runtime sandbox that isolates workloads, and the local storage and caching layer that determines which assets are resident and ready to serve. You will build the detection logic that manages node availability, and the GPU capability reporting that tells the scheduler exactly what each node can handle. Your work directly determines whether the platform can deliver low-latency ML inference — and whether it can do so reliably at scale.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and implement the agent daemon on Linux, including GPU discovery, availability detection, and sandboxed container execution for ML inference workloads.
* Architect the local caching system — eviction policies, versioned manifests, disk budget management, and efficient update mechanisms that minimize data transfer for large model files.
* Build VRAM management and graceful workload migration logic.
* Integrate hardware attestation with the security engineer and support diverse hardware configurations and fleet onboarding automation.

  
About the team  
Amazon Special Projects is a small, high-autonomy team building new-to-Amazon infrastructure from scratch. The systems component is where software meets hardware: you will build the on-node runtime — the agent, sandbox, GPU manager, and local storage layer — that makes a compute node reliable, secure, and performant. This is systems engineering at its most tangible — your code runs on real hardware and must be resilient to everything the real world throws at it.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 6+ years of programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby experience
* 6+ years of non-internship professional software development experience

Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

#### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The LatticeOS Team builds the foundational software-defined operating system that powers our family of autonomous systems, sensors, and third-party integrations. Our work spans edge devices, robotic platforms, and cloud infrastructure, creating a unified operating environment for system orchestration, secure data distribution, and real-time execution. Our solutions are designed for real-world deployment in the most demanding operational environments, where reliable middleware, high availability, and seamless hardware-software integration make the difference between mission success and failure.

As a Senior Software Engineer working in the ProtoKV domain you will design and build the core distributed key-value infrastructure that underpins state sharing across Lattice OS, focusing on performance, reliability, and consistency guarantees at the edge.
